rgyal sras thogs med rin po che'i rnam par thar pa dad pa'i gsal 'debs/slob dpon nam seng la/ brgyad stong pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu dang /chos 'phags kyi le'u sgrogs shig gsungs/ bsgrags pas byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma thob tshul gyi skabs na/ nged kyis ting nge 'dzin 'di rnams kyi ngo bo nyid dang rang bzhin la bltas na/ gang mnyam par bzhag par bya ba'am/ byang chub tu spyod pa'am/ gang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'tshang rgya ba'i chos de yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo / /rigs kyi bu 'di ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin te/ zhes pa'i skabs su de yin gsungs nas/ da dung nged kyi ting nge 'dzin 'di dag gi ngo bo nyid ces pa man chad thon gsung / de nyid bskyar nas zhus pas/ ting nge 'dzin la yun ring du 'byams so/ /da bsgragos 'tshal lam zhus pas/ da dung thon gsungs nas yangs su rdzags par btan ta/ /zla ba bzhi pa nas/ sku shed med par gyur pas/ lha rje bos nas sman zhig bsten na zhus pas/ khyed tsho mi nyan pa min na/ legs par gsang nas/sus kyang ma tshor bar shi ba zhig byed pa yin te gsungs/ de ltar bgyis na/zhabs drung na yod pa rnams kyis gsol sman bsten pa la sogs pa'i zhu ba gang yang ma byas zer/ khag yong lags zhus pas/ 'o na lha rje bos gsungs nas/phyag rtsa bstan te/ gdan 'dren pa'i gser yig pas phyag phebs pa la lta rgyu mi bdog mchi/ 'on kyang zla re tsam ma shi na'ang dge sbyor thun re tsam yong bar gda'i gsungs nas/ se 'bru'i sbyor ba tsam gsol bar— gnang / bla ma byang rtse ba dang / chos rje nyi gzhon pas mjal nas sku khams kyi zhu ba mdzad pas/byu 3—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ dge slong gzhon nu rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung skor/'bras re dang ja 'di 'thung nas mnyam par bzhag pas/ rig pa dwangs la dge sbyor 'phel ba/ nad pa gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig bdog gsungs/ thams cad kyis sku'i rim gro rgya che la yun ring ba dang / gdan bzhugs dang / yan log bdun pa phul nas/ gsal ba btab pas/ sku khams dwangs nas/ slab dpan nam seng la/ khar tsang nas khams ngan pa zhig byung ste/ dge sbyor shin tu 'phel bar byung gsungs/ yang / zla ba bdun pa nas cung zad snyung nas/ stan pa zla bzang la/ dge slong nam bzang bos la/ dkon brtsegs 'don pa dang / sman bla dang / sgrol mchod byed du chug cig gsungs/ snyung g.yog la slob dpon dpal ye/ slob dpon nam seng / bla ma rgya ma pa/ bla ma byang rtse ba/ ston pa zla bzang la sogs pa drung na yod pa rnams kyis/ drung gi snyung ba 'di/ gzhi ma ci lags/ dus nam byung lags zhus pas/ gzhi ma drang srong gi nad yin/ byung nas lo sum cu tsam song / dang po mkhan po gad phur bas bcos pas lo bcu'i bar tsam bde bar byung / de nas lo re zhing na zhing / khyad par dbus nas 'khor rjes dgun re bzhin shin tu na bar byung / na tshul yang du ma zhig byung gsungs/ sngar bcos thabs ci mdzad lags zhus pas/ bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba btab nas/ bdag na ba sems can la phan na na bar/ shi ba sems can la phan na shi bar/ sdug pa sems can la phan na sdug par bde ba sems can la phan na bde bar byin gyis rlobs zhes rtse gcig tu gsol ba btab cing /gang byung yang / dkon mchog gi byin rlabs su blo thag bcad nas/ de la dga' ba sgom zhing lam du 'khyer lo byas pa las/ thabs gzhan ma bgyis gsungs/dze4—

rgyal sras thogs med rin po che'i rnam par thar pa dad pa'i gsal 'debs/da res bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad kyi don du/ phan pa'i thabs shig bstan du gsol zhes zhus pas/ na so mthar phyin cing / nad kyang lcid ches pas/ sman pa 'tsho byed bsten zhing / sman bdud rtsi 'thung kyang gso ba dka' la/ gal te phan par kyang snang yang mi btsun par 'jug pa la/ rang btsun pa byed dgos zer ba bzhin/bdag gzhan sgyu lus kyi phung po 'di/ /na na na ste na bas dga'/ /sngar bsags kyi las ngan 'dzad pa yin/ /chos spyod kyi bya ba sna tshogs kyang / /sgrib gnyis sbyong ba'i ched du yin/ / na ba med na med de dga'/ /lus sems bde na dge sbyor 'phel/ /mi lus don can byed pa yang / /sgo gsum dge la sbyor ba yin/ /'byor pa med na med de dga'/ /bsrung bsral gyi bya brel de la med/ /'thab rtsod kyi khro 'byug ldi snyed pa/ /'dzin chags kyi nor las byung ba yin/ /—45—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ dge slong gzhon nu rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung skor/'byor pa yod na yod de dga'/ /bsod nams kyi dge tshogs spel bas chog /'phral phugs kyi phan bde ji snyed pa/ /bsod nams kyi 'bras bu yin par nges/ /myur du shi na shi bas dga'/ /rkyen ngan gyis bar du ma chod cing / /mtshams sbyor gyi bag chags bzang 'grogs pas/ /ma nor gyi lam du tshudo par nges/ /yun du gsan na gsan pas dga'/ /nyams myong gi lo thog skyes pa la/ /gdams ngag gi brlan drod ma yal bar/ /yun du bsten pas smin par 'gyur/ /gang byung yang dga' ba sgoms shig ang / /zhes pa'i/ gang byung dga' ba sgom gyi man ngag 'di/ gzhan la yang bstan na nyams su len lo byed/ rang res nyams su len 'tshal bas rang sor glod nas phan pa'i thabs mi 'tshol zhing / don dam shes bya'i gshis la/ nad ces bya ba grub pa med la/ kun rdzob tsam du na ba 'di rgyu 'brasabaslu med/ snang ba bden —46—

rgyal sras thogs med rin po che'i rnam par thar pa dad pa'i gsal 'debs/med/ sdug bsngal dang len gyi bzod pa/ chos shan rkyen gyis 'byed cing / sgrib pa sbyong ba'i thabs khyad par can yin pas/ spang du mi btub/ shi yang gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal mi 'byung zhing / khyad par byang chub kyi sems 'phel ba 'di 'dra ba 'dzoms pa'i 'chi ba/ phal gyis rnyed pa dka' yang / dkon mchog bka' drin la brten nas kho bos rnyed pas na/ sos par re ba'i 'dun pa mi byed 'di tsam du gnas pa yang khyed rnams kyi rim gro'i mthu yin gsungs/ da rung sku rim lo gsum gyi bar du sgrub lags zhus pas/ khyed la phan na sdug pa bzod kyang / sdug tshe 'di ring bas ci zhig bya gsungs/ nyi ma'i gung la gnyid la phan par gda' yis/ mgur ma la sogasagang spro gyis shig gsungs pas/ma byas na ni gsung bcag par 'gyur la/ byas na yun ring bshums byung nas/drung nas bshums pas 'jigs par gda' lags zhus pas/ 'pho ba yang ched kyis sgom dgos pa yin na/ mgur ma zab po dang / nges 'byung chen po skyes pa 'di 'dra ba'i 'phro la shi na rang legs pa yin gsungs/ nyin zhig drung pa zhal thon mdzad cing bskor ba mdzad pas/ sku shed med pas zhabs 'khor ba dang /gsung 'dar ba dpags pas bla ma rgya ma pa'i rtog pa la/ da ni mtshan bcas la sogs pa'i dge sbyor 'chag med yod na'ang / nged rnams la bcol nas ma mdzad na yong bar 'dug ste bsam ma thag /zhal phyir la 'khor mdzad phyag gnyis kyi phyag phreng bzung / thal mo ya gcig brkyangs nas/ da lta ma labs na brjed 'gro de ring nas nga'i tshab bla ma pas gyis la/ nyin re yum sgrub tshar re mdzod/ sgrol ma tshar nyer gcig de'i dam bca' yod pa slob dpon nam bzang —47—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ dge slong gzhon nu rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung skor/la bcol yod/ rang res mi nus par 'dug /ma ṇi la sogs gzhan pa rnams nga rang gis yong bar 'dug khyed gnyis la chos kyi 'bul ba byed pa yin no gsungs pas/ thugs shes kyis mkhyen 'dug bsam/ nges shes skyes shing / kha skyengs po tshad med cig byung / bla ma byang rtses mjal nas brtan bzhugs dang /gsol 'debs mdzad nas/ cung zad gsol gda' ba dang / seng tsam byung yang / drung pa rang bzhugs pa'i thugs 'dun mi mdzad par thugs sna stung ba la/jo nang ba'i sgrub pa po rlung ltas rtags po yod zer ba zhig na re/ dngul chur sems dpa' chen po snyung ba la/ dpon slob thams cad kyis rten 'brel phyogs gcig tu bsgrig dgos par 'dug cing / khyad par du drung pa rang gis zhing 'dir bzhugs pa'i rten 'brel mdzad na gsol ba thebs tsam 'dug ste/ skyes mchog chen po khong pa rang bzhugs pa'i thugs dgongs mi 'dug pas/ sku rim yang gal che ste/ de bas kyang drung pa rang gi rten 'brel gtso che zer ba thos nas/drung du zhus pas/ 'o na rlung ltas kyang re rtags yod par 'dug /nga rang la sdod pa'i rtsis ye med de/ phyogs ris kyi rim gro 'di rnams kyis da bar 'chir ma bcug zer ba la/ de lta bu'i gsung mi 'byon par/ sku tshe byin gyis brlab par zhus pa/ da dung de ka yin gsungs nas/ zhu ba bzhes su ma gnang / nyi ma gnyis sku bskyed du mngon tsam byung nas/ bla ma rgya ma pas/ dor zhag sku skyed dum byung gda'/ bdag cag sa skyar chabs gcig 'gro lags zhus pas/bskyed 'dis grul mi thub/ da lta nang na yod pa 'di rnams/ nga ma shi bar la bzhugs gcig yun ring 'grogs mi dgos par gda'/ dge slong nam —48—

rgyal sras thogs med rin po che'i rnam par thar pa dad pa'i gsal 'debs/bzang dang / slob dpon dpal ye la'ang de skad byas bdog gsungs/ nyin zhig rnal bsrung ba'i phyir/ khyoms tsho sna tshogs zhus pa'i 'phro la/ sgom 'ga' zhig gi sems kyi rtog pa mkhyen bzhin du dri ba mdzad pas/ bla ma rgya ma pa'i thugs dgongs la/ thugs shes thogs med mnga' bar 'dug bsam nges shes khyad par can skyes/ nyin zhig sman bla'i cho ga gyis gsungs nas/ skad ches na sku khams la gzan gyis dogs/ chung chung byas te/ yid cung zad gzhan du yengs pa'i skabs su/ skad med pa'i nam me nom me ci yin cha med de 'dra byed pa min/ da lta sgom chen pa rnams gsol 'debs re tsam byed tsa na/ mchi ma byung ma byung gi lan gtong / phyag mchod la sogs pa'i dus su gleng brjod mi gtong bar 'dug ste/ gsol 'debs rkya la mchi ma 'don dgos rgyu med/ spros med mnyam bzhag la rtse gcig tu 'gro na ni rab yin pas des chog /de ma yin par mtshan bcas kyi dge sbyor gang byed kyang / yid kyis sems can gyi sdug bsngal la rtse gcig tu dmigs nas/ de la mi bzod pa cher bskyed pa'am/ yang na/ bla ma dkon mchog gi yon tan la dmigs nas/ de la dad pa dang mos pa rtse gcig tu dungs pa byas nas/ de gnyis nam byed kyang lus kyi ba sbu g.yo ba/mig nas mchi ma 'byung ba/ spyod lam zungs mi thub pa tsam song song gi bar du/rig pa 'jur mig nas drangs nas/ blo de lta bu'i sgo nas phyag dang skor ba dang /mdo 'don/ bzlas brjod la sogs gang byed kyang / skad gsang mthon po lam lam pa byed pa de/ rten 'brel snying po'i man ngag dang 'dra bas/ lus kyis ngag gcun ngag gis yid gcun/ zer ba der 'gro bas na/ de bzhin mdzod la cho ga —49—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ dge slong gso nu rgyal maphywa dpal bzang po'igasung skor/gyis mdzod/ de ma yin par rig pa la ngar ma ston/ sems gzhan du yengs nas/ phyag 'tshal mchod brngod skyabs su mchi'o byas pa la dgos pa tsam med gsungs/ skad ches na snyan snyung gis dogs pa lags zhus pas/ snyan snyung rgyu ci yod/ gnyid bsrung ba'i don du khyoms tsho sna tshogs byed cing / ngag 'khyal don med sna tshogs lab pa dang khyad che/'o na sems yengs pa'i cho gas kyang snyan mi snyung ba la phan gsungs/ drung pa rang ni/ mtshan bcas kyi rim pa gang mdzad kyang / spyan chab phyung zhing / snying rje gcig gi shugs drag po dang bcas nas mdzad la/ snyung ba yun ring song sku shed med kyang / phyag mchod dang skor ba yid kyis mdzad cing / ma ṇi la sogs pa ma chag par/ 'khrul 'khar la dus rtag par bzhugs pa la/ snyung g.yag pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs la/ dbu sngas la phab nas gzims na bde bar 'dug ste bsams nas/ de gzhan mdzad par zhus pas/ sngar nas/ nyal ba dang bsnyes pa la ma goms/ tsog bu rang bde bar 'dug gsungs zhing / sku bsnyel po rang byung dus/ cung bsnyes pa tsam ma gtogs/ dang po snyung nas gshegs pa'i bar/ dbu sngas la ma bzhag par 'khrul 'khor kho na la bzhugs/ nyin zhig phyag skor mdzad pa'i 'phro la/ glo bur du phyag rtsa brtul nas/ mtshar che/ da rung yug gcig mi 'chi bar 'dug ste/ rtsa ni brtul 'dug ltos dang gsungs/phyag brkyang ba la bltas pas/ rtsa mi 'dug par/ snyung g.yog pa rnams skrag nas/ mchi ma byung / the tshom du gyur pa la/ rtsa 'dug ge gsungs/ brtul gda' zhus pas/ de ka 'byung mi 'dug gsungs/ de nas kyang zla phyed tsam bzhugs/—50—

rgyal sras thogs med rin po che'i rnam par thar pa dad pa'i gsal 'debs/de la 'phros nas/ bla ma rgya ma pas/ phyag rtsa brtul nas yun ring mi thogs zer zhing gda'/ gal te mi 'dod pa thog tu babs nas bde bar gshegs ngo shes na 'pho ba la sogs thugs dam gyi gsal 'debs 'di ltar gyis gsung ba'i zhal ta mi bdog gam zhus pas/ he khyed na re mi 'dod pa thog tu babs nabasha'achi na zer te/ shi yang mi 'dod pa thog tu babs pa min/ 'di kho yong ba'i grabs shig sngar du tshar/ mi rgan gyi las thabs zin/ lo bdun cu don lnga lon 'dug ste tshe thung thung min/ lo lhag lus pa med/ do gcig nas yon tan 'di 'gro don 'ga' re yong gi 'dug ste/ 'gro don chung du yang mi 'gro mchi/ 'di nas 'di ru 'gro'i gdong gcig yod/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis po 'di dang nam du yang 'bral ma myong / na ba'i rkyen gyis rmi lam sor chud 'dug byas pa dang 'dra bar ci yin cha med cig khar seng daphyid po na ba nas bzung ste/ ding sang gi bar la lus la shed med kyang / dge sbyor 'phel du song / da lta dran 'dzin mi dgos par dge sbyor du 'gro zhing 'dug de lta bu'i ngang nas 'chi ba de ka la phob zer ba yin/ gzhan gsal 'debs bya rgyu ci yang med/ byas kyang dga' ru e yong yang mi shes/ khyed rang rnam pas/ spyod 'jug las gsungasapa'i/de yi sangs rgyas rjes dran sogs/ /sus kyang g.yengs par 'gyur ba med/ /ces pa/ de dang mi 'gal ba gcig mdzod la nga rang cog ge bsdad pa de ka la/bcas bcos dang / lab lob gang yang ma byed par 'chir chug la/ tsab tsob ma —51—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ dge slong gzhon nu rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung skor/byed cig gsungs pas/ da ci zhu ba bya rgyur mi 'dug pas bsam ngo tsha zhum pa zhig byung / yang nyin cig nyi ma la bzhugs dus/ sman bla'i cho ga rgyas pa zhig mi lnga tsam gyis byas pa tshar ba'i yun rings shig nas/ sman bla byas ma byas gsungs/ bgyis tshar la zhus pas/ sman bla'i grabs byed cing 'dug pa yin te/rjes la dge sbyor mnyam bzhag cig la yengs nas/ cho ga byas pa ma tshor gsungs/ nub cig mchod pa tshar nas gzim mal du phebs thog la/ phud khyer shog gsungs/ gsol ba yin nam bsam khyer phyin pas/ yug zung cig gsungs nas/ phyag 'jug gis 'thor zhing phud mchod rgyas pa re mdzad yang /phyag thal mo sbyar zhing dbu thud pa re mdzad/ mchod pa rnam pa lnga phyag rgya dang bcas pa lan lnga tsam bskyar zhing mdzad/yang phyag thal mo sbyar dbu thud pa re mdzad/ spyan chab mang po byon/ snyung g.yog pa tsho la yang / nyid cag pa tsho mchod pa phul gsungs nas/ mar me lha bshos reng bu la sogs pa/ dkon mchog gi drung du bsgrigs pas/ 'dir khyer shog gsungs nas/ mchod pa thams cad la phyag reg pa re mdzad/ dbu thud pa re dang / phyag thal mo re sbyar/ de thams cad kyi dus na/ zhal gyi rnam 'gyur tsam ma gtogs pa/ gsung gi 'bru ni ma gonang par sku khrus mdzad dus/mdang 'di ltar mdzad pa ci lags zhus pas/ kha sang nas byung ba'i mthong snang za zi de pa byung / gzhan yang yi dam 'dra byon pas/ khyed rnams la yang mchod pa gyis byas pa yin/ gzhan ci yang shod rgyu mi gda' gsungs nas/ zhib par mi gsungs/ gzigs snang thams cad dag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig tu gda' —52—

rgyal sras thogs med rin po che'i rnam par thar pa dad pa'i gsal 'debs/lags sam zhus pas/ de tsho thams cad la g.yur do ci yod/ rmi lam sgyu ma dang 'dra/ gang la'ang mngon zhen bya rgyu med gsungs/ yang nang zhig bla ma byang rtse ba dang / bla ma rgya ma pa la/ 'o skol rang khrus byed do gsungs/ sku khrus gsol ba'i rjes/ na ning nyid cag dang / dge slong 'jam bzang ba la dmar khrid phog pa'i dus na lab byung ba bzhin/ rmi lam 'dzin pa 'di la byang cha chen po yod/ bde ba can la sogs pa'i zhing khams blta ba dang / sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa la chos nyan pa la sogs 'bad rtsol mi dgos par yong ba zhig dang po rig pa dngas dus shig tu nam 'dod 'dod bar ma chad du byung / bar skabs shig tu 'grib 'dug pa yin te/ ding sang na ba 'dis rmi lam 'dzin pa de sor chud 'dug /ma 'gags pa'i snang ba mtshar ba zhig gda'/ bar skabs su 'grib pa de yang bsod de ka 'dra des kyang lan nam snyam/ lar gyis blo chos su song ba re byung na/ 'jig rten gyi bsod nams chen po skad zer ba 'di kun ma byung na rang dga' ba lags/ 'bad rtsol gyis ma bsgrubs par byung na longs spyad du rung zhes sogs kyi dgag sgrub mang po bshad 'dug na'ang / 'byor na'ang 'byor pa lam du slong / rgud na'ang rgud pa lam du slong ba 'di la ji 'dra ba'i cu gal cig 'dug /de la spros nas/ rmi lam 'dzin pa 'di la gnas dben par bsdad/ mi rtag pa blo thog tu sgom/ 'khor ba la skyo shas drag po bskyed/ bla ma dang dkon mchog la blo khel po yod na/ dmigs pa kun med kyang rtsol med du zin par 'dug /de bzhin min na/ dmigs pa dang 'dun pa rkyang gisazin pa'i nges pa med/ 'on kyang gsang sngags kyi chos 'di thabs kyis khyad par du byas pa yin —53—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ dge slong gzhon nu rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung skor/pas/ rmi lam 'dun pa'i gnad ces gsungs gda' bas/ dmigs pa khyad du gsod mi nyan/ rang rang gi skal ba dang blo'i rig cig la nga 'gro ba yin tshod 'dug gsungs/ rgya ma pas/ bdag gis rmi lam gyi gdams ngag bgyis pas rdugs nas/ zin du ma 'dod zhu ba la nyin bar skyo shas dang 'dun pa btang bas/ rmi lam zin pa la tshegs med gsungs/ yang yi dam zhal gzigs pa'i phyi nub/ bla ma byang rtse ba la/ snyung g.yog gi res yod pa'i srod la/ ma dag pa'i las snang phal cher 'gags nas/ zhing khams rnam par dag pa mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba/ dngas shing thogs pa med pa/ nam mkha'i dbyings ltar rgya khyon dang /tshad 'di yin zhes rtsa ba nas gzhal ba mi nus pa zhig 'dug gsung zhing / phyag nam mkha' la yug yug mdzad de/ mnan na nems kyis byed cing / btegs na 'phar gyis byed pa la sogs pa mtshar du che ba zhig gi dbus na/ rang re 'dug pa/ de'i tsa na nad g.yog byed cing yod pa'i bag chags yin mchi bas/ bla ma rgya ma pa'ang 'dug /de'i khor yug kun na 'khor gyi tshogs grangs las 'das pa dpag tu med pa dang / gzhan yang 'od gsal gyi snang ba za zi lang long brjod kyis mi long ba zhig 'dug ste/ da ni mgyogs por 'gro bar 'dug gis ga༄/ngas sa/ /yang snga dro zhig mdang rmi lam bzung ba yin te/ lan cig zin la khad yod pas/ ma zin pa ka 'dra cig byung / phal cher zin cing 'dug nga ltar yang rgod bro ba zhig byung gsungs/ zhal 'dzum mul le/ phyag mdzub g.yas nam mkha' la ker mdzad nas/ rmi lam na dar ser po zhig 'dug pa tshur blangs —54—

rgyal sras thogs med rin po che'i rnam par thar pa dad pa'i gsal 'debs/pas/ de'i shul na tshur gser mang po byung / de nas gser theg tshad cig kha che paṇa chen la phul yod/ mdang ni kho bos kha che paṇa chen la zhabs tog chen po bgyis pas/ paṇa chen yang / bdag la rab tu mnyes nas shin tu dgyes pa'i tshul dang bcas nas gda'o gsung ngo / /paṇa chen gang na bzhugs pa lags zhus pas/ byams pa'i drung na bzhugs pa yin gsungs/yang / snga dro gcig sus kyang zhus pa med par/ sngon gyi dus na dpon chen kun dga' bzang po la/ kha chems 'jog par zhus pas/ kha chems 'di bzang du song tsa na byed zer ba'i gtam zhig 'dug ste/ de bzhin du rang re'i 'di la nad 'di phan nas khams bzang du 'gro rgyu zhig mi yong / thag ring nas yong zer ba 'ga' res/ gdams ngag tshig bzhi pa re yi ger khod blangs zer ba dang / slob dpon ras rkyang pa rgyal mtshan dar gyis kyang / don gyis na kha chems 'dri ba'i yi ge zhig bskur 'dug ste/ kha chems 'jog pa skabs su bab 'dug na'ang / nad kyis gdungs/ lus kyi shed zad/ rig pa'i ngar chag pa'i dus 'di 'drar song tsa na/ tshig bzhi pa re rtsom pa dang / lab pa la'ang cung gal chen po yong gin 'dug /lar gyis/ 'o skol khams bzang dus na'ang / chos dang 'jig rten gyi bya ba gang la yang / khrigs kha 'di yin gyi tig tig med par gtong gin yod pa de yin mod/ da 'chi kha dang / shi ba'i rjes la de bas kyang 'di ltar byed kyi khrigs kha ga na yong / gal te kha ta la nyan mkhan yod na/ sngar khams bzang dus/ rig pa dwangame dus su/ rang gis shes tshad chos mthun du byas nas bshad/ rtsom pa'ang che chung ci rigs su byas shing / khyad par du/—55—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ dge slong gzhon nu rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung skor/tshigs bcad che chung mang dag cig yi ger bkod yod pa/ de rnams kha chems yin te de ma gtogs/ dor zhag rig pa so na med pa'i 'brel med kyi tshig rdog gsum smras pa la sod med/ de ka la bsams nas/ sngar yang /phrad kyang 'di las gzhan pa smra rgyu med/shi yang kha chems gzhan 'ga' ma mchis so/ /zhes pa/ de ka yin no gsungs/ kun la gsung gi tha ma man ngag 'ga' zhig gnang bar zhu zhus pas/snying dang 'dra ba'i grogs la mdo rgyud kyi/ /snying po bsdus pa'i man ngag sngar nyid du/ /snying brtses kun nas bslangs nas bsnyad pa lags/ /snying gi dkyil du chug la nyams su longs/ / lus bde khams bzang rig pa dwangs dus su/ /gang shes dpe mkhyud med par bstan pa lags/ /da lta khams ngan rig pa mi gsal ba'i/ /'brel med tshig 'ga' smras kyang dgos pa chung / /mdor na bla ma chos nyid rgyal mtshan la/ /gdams pa phyi ma de nyid nyams su bzhes/ /zhes gsungs/ drung nas/ zhing khams gzhan du 'gro ba'i don rgya che lags kyang /—56—

rgyal sras thogs med rin po che'i rnam par thar pa dad pa'i gsal 'debs/bdag cag mgon med pa rnams kyi don la bzhugs bar zhu zhus pa yod na/'gro ba thams cad kyang spro na blo gtad pa khyed la lta ci smos/ gsung bzhin ma bsgrubs na lhan cig 'grogs kyang dgos pa med de/smano pa'i ngog ma mnyano na sman dag gis/ /bcas dgas nad pa sas par ga la 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i don soms la/ nga bla ma dang bral snyam pa'i mya ngan ma byed par/ rtse gcig tu gsol ba thob/ man ngag la nyams len gyis/ kho bo yod pa dang mtshungs pa'i byin rlabs 'byung zhing / rang gzhan gyi don 'grub/ de bas lhag pa'i gdam ngag med cing / khyad par du/ ston pa zla bzang rang yang / dge sbyor la 'bad pa thon kha chems dang / lam rgyu'i dngos po de ka yin/ nus pa byung tshad kyis snyoms chung la byams su byed pa dang / da lta rang res skyong dgos kyin yod pa'i ma nus pa 'di rnams la/ skyan ran legs po gyis sdug ge rnams khong sngon la shi /nged tsho ma shi bar shul du lus pa 'di 'dra zhig byung zer sdug bsngal po byed du yong bas na/ 'di rnams snying rje ba yin no/ /zhes lan gnyis su gsungs shing spyan chab bton/yang / sdug ge rnams snying rje snying rje zhes pa lan gsum gsungs/ yang bla ma rgya ma pa la/ bla ma pa'ang / cam cam mi byed par sgrub pa rtse gcig tu byed pa zhig re ba yin na'ang / sa gcig tu 'dug tshugs zer ba de yang mi 'dug ste/blo chos su song ba gcig 'dug pas rjes su yi rang / khyed rang gi da lta'i byed lugs 'di bzhin byas na/ sngar yang lab byung ba bzhin khyed rang la dgra gnyen —57—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ dge slong gzhon nu rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung skor/mang po yod par 'dug na'ang / dgra'i gnod pa mi yong ba'i khag ngas khur bas chog /da rung gnyen gyi phye mthor ma zug pa gyis la/ bya bral mthar thon pa mdzad par zhu gsungs nas phyag thal mo sbyar byung bas/ khong pa'i lus thams cad sbrid pa lta bur gyur cing / mchi ma rang dbang med par shor byung / de bzhin du bgyid par zhu lags shing drung nas bdag cag sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu zhus pas/ de ka lags kyi gsungs nas dbu phyogs pa zhig mdzad/ zhabs drung nas yod pa rnams kyis/ zhing khams gang du skye ba bzhes lags zhus pas/ 'gro la phan na dmyal ba'ang shin tu bzod cing /sems can la mi phan na/ dag pa'i zhing khams la'ang dgosapa mi gda'/ de rnams kho bo rang la dbang mi gda' bas/ dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs shing / bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i smon lam btab nas/ gzhan la phan pa'i lus shig thob tu re ba yin gsungs/ zla ba bcu pa'i tshes brgyad kyi tho rangs/slob dpon dpal ye'i snyung g.yog gi res la yod pas/ slob dpon nga mdun du tsog pu gyis shig gsungs/ de gong sku rgyab byang du bstan yod pas/ zhal byang du bsgyur nas/ spyod lam gcig pu de ka'i ngang nas/ nang par nyi shar bar du mnyam bzhag rtse gcig las mi g.yo bar bzhugs pa la/ zhabs drung pa rnams la/ bde bar gshegs zin pa yin nam snyam pa byung / bar skabs su gsung ci rigs pa 'byon yang 'bru ma go nas/ nang par tsha ba'i dus su/ mdang spyod lam 'di bzhin mdzad pa ci lags zhus pas/ nga'i za zi de rnams kyis slob dpon 'o rgyal la gtad/ nyid cag lkog tu bcug yin pa dag nga bsnyes pa mi nyal byas pa —58—

rgyal sras thogs med rin po che'i rnam par thar pa dad pa'i gsal 'debs/de'i mdun na/ rje btsun ma byon nas bzhugs 'dug pas/ rje btsun ma'i mdun du nga nyal nas bsdad pas mi yong / tsog langs la gsol ba gdab dgos snyam nas de ltar byas pa yin zhing / yang rje btsun ma/ byang nas lhor zhal gzigs 'dug pa la/ rang res kyang de phyogs la bltas nas/ gsol ba btab lags gsungs/ rje btsun ma rnal 'byor ma lags sam/ sgrol ma lags zhus pas/spyan nam ka la cher ba zhig mdzad nas/ sgrol ma sgrol ma zhes gsum gsungs/rje btsun ma gsung 'byon gyi gda' lags sam zhus pas/ zhal 'dzum pa zhig mdzad nas/ he de 'dra mi 'dug ste/ 'o skol ngos kyis sems can gyi sdug bsngal ma bzod nas/ rje btsun ma la yus mang po btsongs gsungs/ yang dge sbyor lags sam mdang zhag ni sna tshogs shig la yengs gda'o gsungs/slob dpon dpal yes/ glang thang pa'i zhal nas/ nga dmyal bar skye bar 'dod nas/ smon lam mang du btab pa yin te/ mi 'grub pa 'dra/ da lta dag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig las/ tha mal gyi snang ba tsam mi 'dug ces pa/ de bzhin byung ba ma lags sam zhus pas/ phal cher rang min nam/ yin pa dag kyang srid/ 'on kyang 'khrul ba rnams la gtad ka ci bdog gsungs/ de nas thugs rje'i shugs kyis bshums pa yun ring zhing / thugs rje drags la song nas/ glo bur du gser ma'am sku khams log na 'jigs par gda' bas/ ding sang mtshan bcas kyi thugs dam rnams glod pa dang / khyad par snying rje'i dmigs pa mi mdzad par zhu zhus pas/ thabs shes rab zung du 'brel ba'i phyir/ mtshan med kyi dge sbyor la mtshan bcas kyis mi gnod gda' zhing / blo'i —59—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ dge slong gzhon nu rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung skor/rtsol ba cung zad yod kyang byed par spro la/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal dran tsam na/snying rje'i dmigs pa ched kyi ma bzung yang / ngang gis skye zhing / byung rgyal du btang na khyed rnams ya nga bas dran 'dzin chen po byas pa lags/ spyod 'jug las/ de tshe bsod nams gshig skyabs na/ /zhes gsungs pas/ na 'chi byung dus/ lhag par dge ba la sbyor ba yin gsung ngo / /bcu dgu'i tho rangs kyi dus su/ cung zhig slongs shig gsungs nas/ de ltar byas pas/ bde mo zhig byung lags pas/ 'di ka la bcas bcos ci yang ma byed cig gsungs/ de nas bzung ste/ sang nyi shu'i dgongs ja'i bar/ spros med kyi ngang la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pas/ dag pa gnyis ldan chos kyi sku 'pho 'gyur mi mnga' ba de mngon du mdzad kyang / gzugs kyi sprul pa'i sku de nyid/ gnyis 'dzin zhabrul bas bslad pa rnams kyi blo ngor sa mo bya lo zla ba bcu pa'i tshes nyi shu nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nub pa dang mnyam du/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te/ bde bar gshegs pa'i tshul bstan to/ /de nas zhag bdun gyi bar du gsang yod pa la/ lha'i me tog gi char rgyun ma chad par babs pas/'ga' res mthong nas/ da bde bar gshegs pa'i snga ltas sam/ yang na sku khams dngas pa'i rtags yin nam zer zhing / mtshams dam po la yod pa'i sgom chen rnams la/ de bar sngar ma myong ba'i nyams rtogs khyad par can skyes shing /mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la tshe gang 'bad pa bas kyang / tshes nyi shu dang / nyer gcig gi dus su sgom bogs che ba byung zhing / gdung gzhu ba'i nyin/ nam mkha' thams cad 'ja' 'od dkar po bris pa lta bus 'khor ba'i bar thams cad —60—

rgyal sras thogs med rin po che'i rnam par thar pa dad pa'i gsal 'debs/'ja' tshon kha dog sna lngas spel ba ltar bkra zhing / nam mkha'i dkyil thams cad shin tu dngas shing 'od gsal ba dang / sa gzhi thams cad tshub ma med cing yul 'jam pa dang / bar snang thams cad lha'i me tog dkar po char ltar babs pas/ shin tu rmongs pa'i gang zag thar pa'i rigs chad pa rnams kyang / dad pa glo bur du skyes shing mchi ma'i rgyun babs/ ba spu zing zhing cho nge'i sgra 'byin na/gzhan rnams lta ci smos te/ 'dus pa thams cad ngo mtshar ba'i ltas de dag gis bskul nas/ mos pa dang gus pa'i gdung shugs lhag par 'phel bar gyur to/ /de nas bzung ste/ zhag bzhi bcu zhe dgu'i bar du nam mkha' la sprin med dwangs par gyur pa ni/ 'od gsal spros med phyag rgya chen po mngon du gyur pa'i mtshon byed yin no zhes gleng la/ yid du 'ong ba'i ser bu cung zad ma gtogs rlung chen po rnams kyang 'jam dal gyis zhi ste/ zhing pa rnams kyi g.yul byed pa bul bar byung zhes kyang grag go /sa yang cher g.yos shing / me tog gi char spur khang gi dud khung nas zhugs nas/ bsreg rdzas 'bul ba'i khung bu nas phyung zhing / sngar yang spur gyi thugs khar thim pa dang / zhugs me spar ma thag sku'i nang na yang me 'bar zhing / dbu'i spyi gtsug skya thal song ba'i dkyil na yar/mar me ltar ta le 'bar ba la der yod pa rnams mthong snang bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ tha dad du mi 'dra ba du ma byung ba ni/ shar nas 'od dkar po snam bu brkyang ba lta bu dngul chu'i ri la zug ste/ slar shar phyogs su thim pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis byang phyogs nas 'od dar yug brkyang ba lta bu gzims khang la zug ste/slar byang phyogs su thim pa dang / la las/ 'od nyi ma shar ba lta bus/ chos rdzong —61—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ dge slong gzhon nu rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung skor/la bskor te nub phyogs su thim pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis/ nam mkha'i mthongs nas skras pa brkyang ba lta bu'i 'od gzims khang la zug ste/ mthar nam mkha'i dbyings su yal ba dang / de dag dang mtshungs par/ dbus phyogs dang / chu zhal la stod lho byang la sogs par yang / nyin par 'ja'i tshogs 'khrug pa dang /me tog gi char 'bab cing / mtshan mo 'od dang sgra chen po dang / sa g.yo ba la sogs pa'i ltas ngo mtshar ba byung zhing / khyad par spur 'ju ba'i nyin me tog gi char chen po mjad lung par babs shing / dag pa'i snang ba can 'ba' zhig gis/chos rje pa spyan ras gzigs kha sar pā ṇis spyan drangs nas bde ba can du gshegs pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis/ rje btsun ma sgrol mas spyan drangs te/ g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing khams su gshegs pa dang / la la dag gis/ kha che paṇa chen gyis gdan drangs te dga' ldan du gshegs pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis lha dang lha mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas/ sil snyan la sogs mchod pa'i khyad par du mas yongs su bskor te po ta lar gshegs pa dang / la las ni seng ge la chibs nas/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mas bskor te/ shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su 'deng gsung ba'i gsung lhang lhang ba dang bcas te mngon dgar gshegs pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis mchod rten dkar po bar snang khengs pa zhig gi bang rim la rim gyis 'dzegs nas byon te/ mthar bum pa'i steng du bzhugs nas de la bskor ba mdzad cing / rdo rje dril bu'i sgra sil sil sgrog bzhin du/ 'o skol rang 'og min du 'gro'o gsungs zhing / mchod rten dang bcas pa nam mkha'i mthongs su gshegs pa'i rjes su/ de nyid kyis kyang tshangs —62—

rgyal sras thogs med rin po che'i rnam par thar pa dad pa'i gsal 'debs/pa'i 'jig rten yin zer ba'i bar du phyag phyi la byon cing / de nas kyang chos rje'i gsung gis/ yar shog yar shog gsungs pa'i sgra lhang lhang thos kyang / ji zhig ltar na/ gzhal yas khang mig gis ma bzod nas/ long ba ltar gyur te slar lhung ma thabs su log la yong dgos pa byung ngo zhes pa dang / yang 'ga' zhig gis ni/ khyed rnams kyi bla ma gshegs pa yin yong / nga'i rgyal sras chos rje ni/ da dung chos rdzong na sku khams bzang zhing sku mtshams dam po la bzhugs yod/ ces sogs dang / 'ga' zhig bla ma rin po che snyung nas bde bar gshegs pa dang / chos rje'i thugs la ji ltar dgongs tshul la sogs/ khyed rtsar bsdad pa bas nga rgyus che zer ba la sogs pa mthong snang mi 'dra ba/ 'ga' zhig la mngon sum dang / 'ga' zhig sgom nyams dang / la la rmi lam bzung ba'i nyams myong sgyu ma lta bu'i nyams snang la byung ngo zhes grag go /spur khang gshig dus/ dbu thod la mkhal ril po ma nyams par byon la/ ring bsrel shin tu phra ba chu shel lam/ mu tig gi kha dog lta bu dngas shing 'od 'tsher ba'i rang bzhin can mang po byon zhing / 'phan yul nyan po'i dge bshes dpal rin zhes bya ba la/ zhal bzhugs dus tshems bud pa zhig gnang zhing / dus phyis mya ngan las 'das nas/ zla ba drug song rting / tshems de la dung g.yas 'khyil rtse mo nyi zlas brgyan pa byon pa dang / mtshur phu ba'i mi nyag dge bshes shig gi gdung skal la bde mchog byon pa dang / snar thang pa'i dge bshes shig gis gdung skal spyan drangs pa la/ sman bla'i sku byon/ e pa'i dge bshes shig gis sbyan drangs pa la/ thugs rje chen po byon/ skyor mo lung pa'i dge bshes shig —63—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ dge slong gzhon nu rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung skor/gis spyan drangs pa la a dang dung g.yas 'khyil byon/ bla ma rog pa tshang ba la/ring bsrel las grub pa'i sgrol ma'i sku byon/ 'jad pa'i yon bdag cig gis spyan drangs pa'i gdung skal la/ don zhags kyi sku byon 'dug /ces pa la sogs pa brjodo kyis mi lang bas/ 'dir yi ge mang kyis dogs shing / gtso che ba rnams smas sa/ /de dag gis ni chos kyi rje rgyal sras rin po che pa de nyid gdul bya'i don la/ zhing 'di nyid du bsam bzhin du/ sku skye ba bzhes te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sgor rab tu byon nas/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa gsal bar mdzad pa dang / gdul bya mang po'i mgon skyabs dang / 'dren pa dam pa mdzad pa la sogs pa'i tshul cung zad tsam zhig /rang gzhan gyi mos gus kyi dran pa gso ba'i phyir/ yi ger bris pa'o/ /nyes par gyur pa rnams/ blo sbyangs mkhas pa mos gus kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la bzod par gsol lo/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam thar dpag yas rnams/ /bdag blo doman pas rtogs par mi nus kyong / /gus ldan slab mas mang du gsal btab ngar/ /phan pa'i bsam pas mdzad tshul 'di byas so/ /sgro btags skur pas dben pa'i rnam thar 'di/ /tshig gi sdeb sbyor mkhas pa ma mchis kyang / /—64—

rgyal sras thogs med rin po che'i rnam par thar pa dad pa'i gsal 'debs/bla ma'i yon tan don la gnas pa'i phyir/ /blo ldan 'ga' zhig 'di la slob 'dod pa/ /de la bla ma'i byin brlabs 'jug par 'gyur/ /dad med log lta shas ches 'di mthong nas/ /mi gus skur 'debs sdig spyod de dag kyang / /thugs rje che mnga' dpal ldan bla ma de'i/ /lhag par brtse ba'i yul du rab dgongs 'gyur/ /de phyir mthong thos dran reg 'tshengs gyur pa'i/ /'brel tshad don ldan byang chub thugs gnyis kyis/ /rnam par slan pa dad pa'i gsal 'debs 'di/ /sa steng kun tu dar zhing rgyas gyur cig /rgyal sras spyod pa rlabs chen mdzad tshul la/ /mos gus tshad 'dzin 'gal 'khrul ci mchis pa/ /skye+or+sā mchog sems dpa' chen po de nyid dang / /mas gus spyan ldan rnams la bzad par gsal/ /dge des 'gro ba'i sdig dang sdug bsngal kun/ /—65—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ dge slong gzhen nu rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung skor/bdag la smin cing bdag gi dge bde rnams//gzhan la sbyin mdzad chos rje bla ma de'i/ /sgrub rgyud bstan pa phyogs bcur 'phel gyur cig /bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab spyan ldan pas/ /thugs rje chen pos 'gro kun bdag mdzad phyir/ /gzhan don dka' spyad khur gyis mi skyo ba'i/ /rgyal sras chos rje bla ma'i bkra shis shog /dpal ldan bla ma chos kyi rje/ 'jig rten gsum na bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba rgyal sras thogs med rin po che'i rnam par thar pa/ dad pa'i gsal 'debs zhes bya ba 'di nyid/ gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i/ shar gling chen mo'i gdan sa pa mkhan po chos kyi 'od zer ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen rdo rje rgyal mtshan la sogs pa du mas snga gong nas bskul zhing / 'phral nyid du chos 'khor gling pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang dag gis bskul nas/ shākya'i dge slong gzhon nu rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ chos grwa chen po tshal gung thang gi gtsug log khang chen por/ stag lo zla ba brgyad pa'i yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la sbyar ba'// //dge legs dang bkra shis chen po rgyas par gyur cig /rgyal sras chos rje bla ma'i rnam thar 'di/ /mtshan thos dad pa'i sa gzhi rab g.yo bas/ / rnam par 'dod te btsal yang yun ring du/ /ma rnyed mod kyi chos rje'i byin rlabs —66—

rgyal sras thogs med rin po che'i rnam par thar pa dad pa'i gsal 'debs/kyis/ /phyis na rnyed te bris pa'i dge ba ni/ /rgyal sras bla ma'i thugs dgongs ji 'dra bar/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i tshogs rnams ma lus pa/ /gnas skabs mthar thug phan bde'i 'bras 'byin pa'i/ /byang chub spyod pa'i lam la 'jug par shog /bdag kyang chos las nam yang ma g.yos par/ /chos rje bla mas rjes su 'dzin gyur cig /ces smras nas bsod nams rin chen bdag gis/mgyogs par bris pa lags so// // shur+ghaṃ/

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / 'gro ba kun gyi gnyenā gcig pu/ /thugs rje'i mnga' bdag spyan ras gzigs la 'dud/ /rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos shing / /thugs rje'i dbang gi sna tshogs skur sprul nas/ /lhag bcas 'gro rnams 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /legs par sgrol mdzad rje btsun ma la 'dud/ /shes bya'i gnas rnams gsal bar legs ston ston pa sangs rgyas dang / /srid gsum 'gro ba sdug bsngal las skyob skyob pa dam pa'i chos/ /tshogs gnyis sog pa'i zhing mchog mchog gyur 'phags pa'i dge 'dun te//skyabs gsum dag la legs par rab dang dngas pa'i sems kyi 'dud/ /bla ma'i rnam thar yon tan rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i gsung dbyangs rgya mtsho yis/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor brjod kyang mi zad na/ /blo dman bdag 'dra'i sdu+oḍi yul ma yin kyang / /

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/dad mos 'dab shag ldan pa'i bung ba'i tshogs/ /bskul tshig snyan sgra dar dir sgrog pa dang / /rang gi dad pa'i dran pa gso phyir dang / /gzhan la phan pa'i bsam pas kun blangs nas/ /bla ma'i rnam thar ngo mtshar pad mo'i tshal/ /legs bshad 'od zer 'phros pas kha phye ste/ /dad yod ldan pa'i bung ba'i tshogs rnams la/ /ngo mtshar sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston 'gyed phyir rtsom/ /de la bdag cag rnams kyi ston pa bdag nyid chen po 'di'i rnam par thar pa'i yon tan gyi tshogs mtha' dag ni bsam gyis mi khyab cing / rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyis kyang bskal pa'am bskal pa las lhag par yang brjod par mi nus te/ mdo sde rgyan las/de ni cig car la lar sgo mang brgya nas chos kyi 'khor lo dang / /la lar skye ba mi snang la lar skye ba'i spyod pa sna tshogs dang / /la lar byang chub la lar de ni mya ngan 'das ston kyang / /de ni gnas de las kyang rnam par g.yo mi mnga' la thams cad mdzad//ces gsungs pa ltar bdag nyid chen po 'di ni bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol tu sa bcu gnyis kyis dbang phyug tu gyur te/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur sangs rgyas tshar nas/ chos kyi sku las ma g.yos bzhin du/ da gzod sprul —69—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/pa'i sku tshogs pa bstan te/ skad cig 'ga' la zhing khams la lar ni lhums su 'jug la lar ni sku bltams/ la lar gzhon nu rol rtsed mdzad/ la lar ni btsun mo'i 'khor gyis bskor/ la lar ni rab tu byung nas dka' ba spyad/ la lar nibadud btul nas sangs rgyas/ la lar chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ston/de bzhin du dag pa'i zhing khams la lar ni/ dus kyi 'khor lo dang /'khor lo bde mchog dang / gsang ba 'dus pa dang / kyi rdo rje dang / kun tu bzang po dang / 'jam dpal dbyangs dang / spyan ras gzigs la sogs pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang ma dag pa'i zhing khams la lar ni/ byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / la lar 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po dang / la lar tshangs pa dang / brgya byin dang / la lar grub thob dang / paṇ+ḍita dang / dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / khyim bdag dang/ lha dang / klu dang / lha ma yin dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa dang / sman dang bya dang jinya dang / ri dwags dang / de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyis 'dul ba la sangs rgyas/byang chub sems dpas 'dul ba la byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par rol pa/mdor na gdul bya gang dang gang thabs gang gis 'dul ba la de dang de'i tshul bzung nas/ mtha' yas pa'i gdul bya la mtha' yas pa'i skad kyis mtha' yas pa'i chos ston par nus pa'i mtha' yas pa'i skye ba bzung ste/ bsdu ba rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas gdul bya rnams lam gyi rten dang lam dang lam gyi 'bras bu la 'god par mdzad pa las/ zhing 'dir skal ba dman par gyur pa'i sems can —70—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/gdul ba'i phyir/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse dang 'phrin las cig tu bsdus te/ bdag cag la sogs pa kha cig gi snang tshul du tha mal pa ltar rigs mthun par sprul te lam sbyong ba'i tshul ston par mdzad pa'i rnam par thar pa'i yon tan gyi rgya mtsho chen po'i nang nas kyang chu thigs tsam zhig blangs te/ bla ma'i yon tan don la gnas pa la sgro btags skur pa ma btab snyan ngag gi ma bsgribs par go bde ba'i tshul du brjod na/ de yang 'di ltar sems dpa' chen po de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rgyal sras lag len 'di spyir gyis mdo rgyud thams cad snying po btus pa lta bu'am/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi phyag len mdor bsdus pa yin zhing / khyad par du sems chen po nyid kyis phyag len dang mdzad spyod kyi rnam par thar pa rags rim 'di nying/ la tshang bas/ 'di nyid la rnam thar gyis spyad du byas nas/ bshad tshod phyag len gyi rnam thar cig tu sbyar te/ rgyal sras lag len gyi don gyi 'grel pa legs par bshad pa pad mo'i tshal zhes kyang bya/rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer zhes kyang bya ba mtshan gnyis dang ldan pa 'di nyid kyis ston pa la thog mar bsdus don cung zhig bsnyad na/ rgyal sras lag len la don gsum ste/ mchod par brjod cing brtsam par dam bca' ba dang / brtsam bya bstan bcos kyi rang bzhin/ mjug gi don bsdu ba'o/ /gnyis pa la sngon 'gro chos la 'jug tshul dang / dngos gzhi skyes bu gsum gyi lam bstan pa/ sngon 'gro chos la 'jug tshul la bdun las/—71—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/dus gsum gyi 'byung gnas pha yul spangs pa'i phyag len/ rnyed dka' ba'i dal 'byor thob pa don yod par bya ba'i phyag len/ 'gal rkyen sgrib pa spangs pa'i phyag len/ mthun rkyen bshes gnyen bsten pa'i phyag len/ yon tan gyi 'byung gnas dben pa bsten pa'i phyag len/ mi rtag pa 'khrungs pas tshe blos botang ba'i phyag len/ slu med kyi dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro ba'i phyag len na/ /dang po dus gsum gyi 'byung gnas pha yul spangs pa'i phyag len la yang lnga ste/ dal 'byor gyi ljon shing yul gang du rigs rus gang las 'khrungs pa'i zhabrungs tshul/ de nyid tshogs gnyis kyis brlan dang ldan pa'i yab yum gang gis bskyed pa'i skyed tshul/ de nyid byams pa'i nyi 'od dang ldan pa'i ma mas skyed bsrings pa'i bsring tshul/ dang po nyid nas theg pa chen po'i rigs sad pa'i sad tshul/ dug gsum gyi 'byung gnas pha yul spangs nas rab tu byung ba'i byung tshul/gnyis pa rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor thob pa don yod par bya ba'i phyag len la yang lnga las/ rab tu brtson pa'i ded dpon gyis thos bsam gnyis kyi grur zhugs te gsung rab rgya mtsho'i nang nas mkhyen gnyis kyi nor bu blangs pa'i blang tshul/ lung rigs kyi mche sder dang ldan pa'i ri dwags dbang pos phas rgol gyi glang po bcom tshul/ /don gnyis kyi nor bu blangs pa'i phyir so sor thar pa'i tshul khrims kyi grur zhugs te thar pa'i ba dan btsugs pa'i tshugs tshul/ gzhung lugs kyi pad tshal legs bshad kyi tsha zer kyis phye ste —72—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/tshig don phun tshogs kyis sbrang rtsis blo gsal gyi bung ba tshims par mdzad pa'i mdzad tshul/ legs par bshad pa'i lde mig gis gsung rab rin po che'i gter mdzod kha phye ba'i phye tshul lo/ /dngos gzhi skyes bu gsum gyi lam la/ skyes bu chung ngu'i lam sdug bsngal sdig pa'i 'bras bur rtogs pas rgyu mi dge ba la 'dzem pa'i phyag len/ skyes bu 'bring gis lam srid pa gsum gyis bde ba mi rtag par rtogs pas thar pa don du gnyer ba'i phyag len/ skyes bu chen po'i lam la bsam pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa/ sbyor ba byang chub kyi sems gnyis sgom pa/ de dag gi bslab bya la bslabs pa gsum las/ byang chub kyi sems ni byams snying rje yod med kyi rjes su 'gro ldog byed pas/ mnyam nyid kyi byams pa chen po mnga' ba'i mnga' tshul bzod med kyi snying rje chen po mnga' ba'i mnga' tshul/ bsam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i phyag len/gnyis pa sbyor ba byang chub kyi sems gnyis sgom pa la gnyis las/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems sgom pa la'ang / mnyam bzhag tu bdag gzhan brje ba sgom pa'i phyag len/ rjes thob tu rkyen ngan lam du 'khyer ba la/ mi 'dod pa'i chos bzhi/ bzod dka' gnyis/ 'byor rgud gnyis/ chags sdang gnyis lam du 'khyer ba'i phyag len/gnyis pa don dam byang chub kyi sems la yang mnyam bzhag tu spros bral la 'dzin med sgom pa dang rjes thob tu chags sdang gi yul gnyis la bden zhen spang ba'i phyag len/—73—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/gsum pa de dag gi bslab bya la bslab pa la lnga las/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug la bslab pa'i phyag len/ mdo nas gsungs pa'i chos bzhi la bslab pa'i phyag len/ nyon mongs pa spong tshu'i bslab pa'i phyag len/ dran shes bzhin dang ldan pa'i sgo nas gzhan don bsgrub pa la bslab pa'i phyag len la gsum las mdo rgyud nas ji ltar bshad pa bzhin skyes bu dam pa'i mtshan nyid tshang bas/gzhan don bsgrub tshul/ dad mos kyi chu gtsang gis gang ba'i gdul bya'i snod du sku gnyis kyi gzugs brnyan gsal bar mdzad pas gzhan don sgrub tshul/'bad med lhun grub gyi 'phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pas gzhan don sgrub tshul/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba la bslab pa'i phyag len no/ /gsum pa mjug gi don bsdu ba la/ brtsam bya bstan bcos kyi don bsdu/rtsom byed kyi rnam par thar pa'i don bsdu ba gnyis/ rnam par thar pa'i don bsdu ba la gnyis te/ gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams gdul ba dang / las tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa'i phyir zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pa'i bstan tshul/ de nyid kyi sku gdung ring bsrel gyi snying po can rnams sku gsung thugs kyi rten du gyur tshul rnams kyi ston par byed pa las/—74—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/na mo lo ki sha ra ya/gang gi chos kun 'gro 'ong med gzigs kyang / /'gro ba'i don la cig tu brtson mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma mchog dang spyan ras gzigs mgon la/ /rtag tu sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo /zhes mchod par brjod cing /phan bde'i 'byung gnas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /dam chos bsgrubs las byung ste de yang ni/ /de yi lag len shes la rag las pas/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi lag len bshad pa bya/ /zhes brtsam par dam bca' nas/ dang po yul gang du rigs rgyud gang las zhabrungs tshul ni/ de yang 'di ltar thos te/ ma ga ta rdo rje'i gdan las byang phyogs su dpag tshad brgya bgrod pa'i sa cha/ rnam thos bu'i pho brang bzhin du 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor rgyas pa/ sham bha la'i pho brang bzhin du 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul rgyud mar byon pa/ na len tra'i gtsug lag bzhin du mkhas grub du mas nye bar bsten pa/ dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang las/—75—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin gyi gsung skor/lho nub dpag tshad phye dang gsum tsam bgrod pa na/ brag ri dkar po'i phreng bas kun nas bskor ba/ rtswa dang lo ma dang / 'bras bus brgyan pa'i shing ljon pas mdzes pa/ 'bab chu shel gong ltar dngas shing gtsang ma 'bab pa/ lo tog phun sum tshogs pa skye ba me tog dang / be+e ḍūr+ya lta bu'i ne'u gsing sngon pos brgyan pa'i yid du 'ong ba phul byung brag skya zhes bya bar sku zhabrungs so/ /gdung rus ni tod yin thog pa'i rgyud pa bzang po yin ces grags so/ /chu dang me tog ljon zhing 'bras bu mdzes/ /ne gsing sngon po be+e ḍūr+ya 'dras brgyan/ /yid 'ong yul der rigs rgyud phun tshogs pa'i/ /mi yi mchog gyur rgyal ba'i sras de 'brungs/ /yab yum gyis bskyed pa'i tshul ston pa ni 'di ltar/ 'das ma 'ongs thams cad mngon sum du gzigs pa'i mngon par shes pa thogs pa med par mnga' ba des/ dal 'byor gyi chos bco brgyad tshang ba/ dal 'byor gyi chos/ ha cang rigs che zhing mtho ba yang ma yin/ ha cang chung zhing dma' ba yang ma yin pa zhig tu sku 'khrungs na bstan pa dang sems can mang po la phan par gzigs te/yab ni/ dad pa dang snying rje che ba/ 'khor dang ma nus pa la byams pa/ khengs pa dang nga rgyal chung zhing shes rab che bar gyur pa dkon mchog dpal zhes bya ba dang / yum ni/ skar ma'i nang na zla ba bzhin du bud med kyi nang na rnam par mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba/ dad pa dang snying rje che ba/ za ma bud med kyi yon tan du ma dang ldan pa 'bum sgron zhes bya ba gnyis kyis sras su sprul te/ grub pa —76—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug stong mo mon mo gos kyi dbon rgyud du sku 'iXgrangs so zhes grags so/ /lhums su zhugs pa'i dus na yum la spyan ras gzigs rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor lus la thim pa'i rmi nyams dang ldan cing / sad pa'i tshe na nyams gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma thugs la shar/ lus bde zhing yang ba dang / byams snying rje 'bad rtsol med par skye ba byung ngo zhes grags so/ /zla grangs thim thim gyi bar du lhums su bzhugs nas mi dang mi ma yin pa'i sems can du ma'i don mdzad cing bltams pa'i dus na/ spyan ras gzigs kyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor phyir byung nas zhing sbyangs/ sems can smin par byas nas slar dkyil 'khor la bkod pa'i snang ba dang / sngar med pa'i dri zhim po bsnam pa dang / rol mo'i sgra snyan pa grags pa dang / sa g.yo ba dang / me tog gi char 'bab pa dang / phyi rol du yang sngar mi skye ba'i rtswa dang / me tog la sogs pa skyes/ lo legs pa dang /yams nad 'khrug pa zhi ba la sogs pa bkra shis pa'i mtshan ma dang bcas nas sku 'khrungs te/ mtshan dkon mchog bzang po zhes gsol lo/ /rgyal ba 'bum phrag tu ma skyed pa'i yum/ /ma rig mun sel bstan pa'i sgron me dang / /dkon mchog thugs rje'i dpal las legs 'khrungs pa'i/ /dkon mchog 'phrin las bzang po de la 'dud/ /—77—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/ gzhon nu yid 'ong zhabrungs pa la/ /dga' ldan gnas nas lha'i bus/ /me tog sogs kyis legs mchod pas/ /sa phyogs de yang mchod rten 'gyur/ /yid 'ong gzugs mdzes mdangs ldan pa/ /sprin dkar steng nas glog 'gyu'am/ / yang na dmigs med thugos rje yis/ /pad dkar bsdus nas gyan pa 'dra/ /gzhon nu de'i gsung snyan gyis/ /dri za'i glu dbyangs zil gyis mnan/ /thub pa'i bstan pa ma 'grib pa/ /yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel ba mtshar/ /byams pa'i 'od dang ldan pa'i ma mas bskyed bsring tshul stan pa ni/ de yang 'di ltar thos te/ sras rgyal bu don grub btsas nas zhag bdun na yum 'das pa bzhin du/ dgung lo gsum lon pa na yum 'das/ lnga lon pa na yab kyang 'das/ de dus nye ba kun gyis zangs mo che 'di bu 'di la zhogagazhan dngos po rnams yab kyi dge rtsa la gtong byas pas/ nga la cang mi dgos thams cad pa'i dge rtsa la thong gsungs nas/ dngos po gang 'dug yab kyi dge rtsa la —78—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/btang / sems dpa' chen po yum gyi a phyi chos nyid 'dren gyi sar khrid de dgung lo lnga pa nas dgu'i bar du gsos/ de bar bya na yang ma chag par byin/gces spras dang brtse gdung chen pos bskyangs pas shin tu drin che ba cig bdog gsungs/rgyal sras de'i sku lus dang / /kun la snyoms pa'i thugs rje dang / /zhabs tog byas pa'i dge ba gsum/ /phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du 'phel/ /dang po nyid nas theg pa chen po'i rigs sad tshul ston pa ni/sbyor ba'i sngon du snying rje dang / /mos pa dang ni bzod pa dang / /dge la yang dag spyod pa ni/ /rigs kyi rtags su nges par bshad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ sems dpa' chen po 'di ni 'khrungs ma thag nas/ zhi ba dang / dul ba dang / nges pa dang / yid gzhungs pa dang / snying rje chen po'i ngang tshul dang ldan zhing bu chung gi spyod pa las 'das pa zhig byung ste de yang skye ba dpag tu med pa'i gong rol nas tshogs gnyis chu bo'i rgyun bzhin goms pa'i stobs kyis/ bu chung smra shes tsam gyi dus na nyin gcig yum gyi pang na bzhugs dus/ rlung po 'khor byed pa cig gis shing lo gcig nam mkha' la khyer song ba gzigs nas drag tu bshums pa la/ yum gyi ci byung dris pas/ de la phyag —79—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/mdzub btsugs nas/ sems can cig nam mkha' la khyer song gsungs pa dang /sems can ma yin shing lo yin byas pas bshums pa'i 'phro bcad ces pa dang /ba mo 'byung dus snga dro cig sgor bzhud nas gos med par sgren mor byung bas/yab kyi gos gar song byas/ṇa snying rje ba'i 'khyags pa de 'dra la g.yogs nas yod zer khrid nas ltar phyin pas/ sngom pas gang ba'i sho phung ba mo skya khad pa zhig la gos g.yog pa mtha' la rdos mnan byas 'dug zer/ gzhon nu'i dus na bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems de lta bu dang / yang na bsgom byed pa yin zer nas sku rnam snang gi chos drug ldan du bcas nas nyin mtshan bde stong ting nge 'dzin gyis dus 'da' ba byung zhes grag go /bshum pa'i dus na dpe cha shog 'khyar phyag tu gtad pa dang / shin tu mnyes shing bzhum 'phro chado pa dang / byis pa gzhan mis brdungs tsa na bshum pa zhig yod ces spru/gab/ bsdo/ /'jam dpal dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan pas sa skyar gdan drangs dus 'phros pa'i gsung gleng byung dus su/ gong gi de lta bu rnams thos te bden lags sam zhus pas/ de ltar grags gda' te bdag rang gi ni mi dran lags zhus/ dran tsam na chos la gzhan gyi thu yugs la sogs mi gus pa byas tsa na mi bzod pa skye zhing / dang po byis pa'i dus rang nas khong khro shas chung shing snying rje che ba gzhan gyi dge ba la rjes su yi rang kha tshig min par skye ba zhig yod/ de stobs kyis su la'ang dzig ngan smra mi nus/ nga chung chung gi dus su sa skyar kar phubs kyi sgor tsar mi cig gi don med par mgo la brgyab pas skrang 'bur chen —80—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/po byung yang khong khro ma skyes gsungs pa dang / byis pa gzhan dang rtse ba na/gzhan pham nas ngus na bdag mi bzod cing / rang pham yang mya ngan tsam med pa yod gsungs pa dang / rtswa shing 'thu ru chas dus grogs kyis rnyed na rang gi ma rnyed kyang mi sdug rang gi rnyed kyang grogs kyis ma rnyed na khong tsho la pha ma sogs kyis 'thab tu yong bsam nas res 'ga' rang gi rnyed pa nas byin res 'ga' 'thu rogs byas gsung ba dang / byis pa'i dus rtse mos pher tsam na mchod rten bzhengs pa dang / chos 'chad pa dang sgom byed pa la sogs dge ba'i phyogs kyis dus 'da' ba zhig yod gsung zhes thos so/ /skye ba dpag tu med pa'i gong rol nas/ /tshogs gnyis chu bo'i rgyun bzhin goms pa'i mthus/ /gzhon nu'i dus nas stong nyid snying rje 'byongs/ /zas gtsang sras po de dang 'gran pa 'dra/ /pha yul spangs nas rab tu byung ba'i tshul ston pa ni/ /gnyen gyi phyogs la 'dod chags chu ltar g.yo/ /dgra'i phyogs la zhe sdang me ltar 'bar/ /blang dor brjed pa'i gti mug mun nag can/ /pha yul spong ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ /—81—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin gyi gsung skor/ces gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab ste/ de yang 'di ltar thos te/ a phyi'i sa na bzhugs dus phyugs lug 'tsho ba la byon cing / a phyi la khral 'bab pa la/ra lug bsad kyin hor 'dra la sha sprod pa dgos pa byung bas/ ra lug gsod sar khrid pa'i dus bzhums shing 'chang nas snying rje ba yin mod gsungs te/yun ring por 'khrid du mi 'jug par brgyal brgyal du bshums kyang / dbang med du khrid kyin bsad pa lan mang rab byas pas/ a phyis byams po byas kyang /de lta bu la yid 'byung zhing skyo ba skyes te/ dgung lo dgu bzhes pa'i dus su/phyugs lug 'tsho sa nas bros te/ yab kyi pha spun bu ston pa rin chen bkra shis kyi sar bsam gling du byon te/ yi ge 'bri 'don la sogs pa bslab pas/ rig pa'i gnas rnams mthong pa tsam gyis shes pa byung bas/ kun gyi 'di ni phal pa zhig ma yin nges zhes gleng ba byung zhes grag go /de nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rab tu byung bas 'dzin par dgongs nas dgung lo bcu bzhi pa spre'u'i lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes brgyad kyi snga dro'i cha la bsam gling pa'i gdung rgyud bla ma dpal 'bar bas mkhan po mdzad/ de'i gcung po mkhan po rin chen dpal bzang pas slob dpon mdzad/ grib tshod pa dge slong rin chen rdo rjes mdzad/ bstan pa rin po che'i sgor zhugs nas/bzang po dpal zhes mtshan gsol lo/ /de'i nyin par sngar med pa'i dri zhim pos khyab pa dang / rol mo'i snyan pa grags pa dang / me tog gi char 'bab pa la sogs pa kun gyis thun mong du grub par byung zhes grag go /—82—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/rgyal bas rgyal srid spangs pa bzhin/ /rgyal sras pha yul rab spangs te/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas mdzad phyir/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la zhugs pa'i tshe/ /sngar med spos kyi dri zhim rnam par ldang / /rol mo'i sgra snyan nam mkha' dgod pa 'dra/ /lha'i me tog char pa bzhin du 'bab/ /sprin chen rnams kyang bla re bres pa mtshar /de lta bas na byang chub kyi sems gnyis goms pa'i phan yon bsngags pa dang / pha yul spangs pa dang rab tu byung ba'i yon tan bsngags pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer las dug gsum gyi 'byung gnas pha yul spangs pa'i phyag len gyi le'u ste dang po'o// //—83—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/rnyed dka' ba'i dal 'byor thob pa don yod par bya ba'i phyag len ston pa ni/dal 'byor gru chen rnyed dka' thob dus 'dir/ /bdag gzhan 'khor ba'i mtsho las bsgral bya'i phyir/ /nyin dang mtshan du g.yel ba med par ni/ /nyan sems sgom pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len btab ste/ dang po rab tu brtson pa'i ded dpon gyis thos bsam gyi grur zhugs te/ gsung rab rgya mtsho'i gling nas mkhyen gnyis kyi nor bu blangs tshul ston pa ni/de yang 'di ltar thos so/ /ston pa rin chen bkra shis kyis yi ge 'bri 'don btsun pa byed pa bshad gsar la sogs pa'i grogs byas pas drin che bar dgongs nas/ zhing khang rnams kyang a khu la gnang ste/ 'jig rten gyis bya ba la snying po med/ nga'i zhing dang nyid rang la gang yod kyis mi phongs tsam yod mchi/ gal te ma 'dang na ngas bsod snyoms byas nas kyang skyong ba yin/ sems las mi 'tshal ces zhal ta mdzad nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshad sgrub gnyis kyis 'dzin pa la/ bshad nyan gyis lung gi chos 'dzin sgom sgrub kyis rtogs pa'i chos 'dzin par dgongs nas dgung lo bco lnga pa'i dus bya lo la/—84—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/bo dong e bsam gling pa'i dgon lag yin pa'i stobs kyis/ e'i chos grwa chen por byon te/ bla ma kun dga' rgyal ba'i drung du dang por mngon pa kun las btus la nan tan mdzad/ de yang dang po nas dul ba dang zhi ba dang bzod pa dang byams pa'i ngang tshul dang ldan pas/ grogs kyi slob gnyer la 'gran zla dang phrag dog gi dmigs rkyen du mi 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir/ gzhan las blo gros kyis nus pa chung zhing dman pa'i tshul bzung yang / skye ba dpag tu med pa'i gong rol nas goms pa'i phyir/ gzhan gyi lo mang po'i bar du 'bad pa bas mkhas par gyur te/ de dus 'jam dbyangs rong pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan bya ba na re/ mang ja'i tshogs gral du/ nyid btsun chung bzang po dpal dang bcas pa'i blo gsar ba rnams la nga 'dri ba bya rgyu yod do/ /mngon pa nas zang zing med pa'i tshor ba sdug bsngal bya ba cig bshad 'dug ste/ zang zing med pa'i tshor ba yin na sdug bsngal yin pa'i dam bca' bud zer/ 'di la lan thob zer ba la/ 'di la gzhan gyis ni lan gang yang ma byung / de lta bu 'byung bar gzhung rang nas nyan thos dgra bcom pa 'ga' zhig la zang zing ni med kyang las kyi nus pa mthong ba yin zhes sdug bsngal 'byung bar bshad yod dgongs nas/ de lugs kyi sgrub byed 'gal spong gsungs pas/ mkhas pa thams cad ngo mtshar bar gyur te/ bla ma nam bkra ba bya ba na re/ nyid thogs med dngos su 'dug thogasamed gnyis pa yin gsung la mchod par mdzod zer bas/ mchod par mdzad nas nga thogs med gnyis pa yin gsungs pas/ dus de nas bo dong thogs med ces mtshan yongs su grags so/ /g.yin yang byams pa'i chos lnga/ sa sde lnga sdom rnam —85—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/gnyis/ pra kar ra ṇa sde brgyad rnams kyi tshig don la mkhas pa 'phags pa thogs med lta bur gyur/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod 'jug bslab btus rnams dang / dbu ma rigs pa'i tshogs drug la sogs pa dbu ma'i bstan bcos rnams dang / mdor na lung gi chos thams cad kyi tshog don la mkhas pa/'phags pa klu sgrub lta bur gyur nas/ dpal ldan sa skyar byon te/ mkhas pa chen po bla ma gzhon rgyal bya ba'i drung du sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa la mkhas pa sbyangs shing / gtso bor tshad ma rnam nges la thugs sbyong mdzad cing / chos mchog rgyan/ lha dbang blo/ shākya blo dzña na shrī la sogs pa'i 'grel pa chen po rnams kyi tshig don la mkhas pa dpal chos kyi grags pa lta bur gyur te/ de dus sems dpa' chen po'i zhal nas/le lo'i dbang gis shas cher ma 'bad kyang / /'on kyang kho bo'i blo dang phrad pa na/ /shes bya'i tshig don lhan cig dmigs nges yin/ /zhes gan+da/ngas so zhes grag go /rab tu brtson pa'i ded dpon gyis/ /thos bsam gnyis kyi grur zhugs te/ /gzhus lugs rgya mtsho chen po nas/ /mkhyen gnyis nor bu blangs pa mtshar/ /lung rigs kyi mche sder dang ldan pa'i ri dwags dbang pos phas rgol gyi glang po bcom tshul ston pa ni 'di ltar/ rigs pa dang grol bar smra ba'i spobs —86—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/pa thogs pa med pas the tshom gyi tshogs bsgral bar nus pa grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu phyin pa sgrub pa dang / sun 'byin gyi cha la snyengs pa mi mnga' ba ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i don la dbang 'byor pas chos dang chos ma yin pa na rnam par 'byed pa la mkhas pa'i mkhas pa chen po des/dgung lo nyer gsum bzhes pa'i dus su gtsang phyogs kyi chos grwa kun du grwa bskor mdzad nas/ lta ba log par 'dzin pa'i rgol ba ngan pa rnams lung rigs kyis sun phyungs te spobs pa med par byas/ lta ba phyin ci ma log par 'dzin pa rnams mthun phyogs su bsdus pas/ kun kha mthun par grwa skor ba byung ba la kun las shes rab che ba dang / ston pa bzang ba ma byung zhes gleng ba byung ngo zhes grag go /des na sde snod 'dzin pa gnam kyi skar ma tsam phyi nang du/ sems dpa' chen po nyid nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar ba lta bur gyur te/ mkhas pa'i grags pas sa'i steng thams cad khyab par mdzad/ lung rigs kyi bgro gleng mdzad pa'i tshe na/ byams pa rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gdan sa nga yin/ klu sgrub rje 'brang dang bcas pa'i gdan sa nga yin/ chos grags rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gdan sa nga yin gsungs nas/ thugs ngar mdzad pa cig yod ces grags so rnams gsung ngo / /dus phyis 'gol ba'i dus su mtshan nyid pa'i gsung gleng byung ba'i tshe/ 'o skol yang dgong mo thal 'gyur 'phen len byed rtsa na rig pa ngar pa cig bdog gsungs/—87—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/ri dwags dbus na seng ge ji bzhin du/ /mkhas mang rgya phrag du ma 'dus pa'i tshe/ /lung rigs nga ros phas rgol skrag mdzad pa'i/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba de la 'du/ /don gnyis kyis nor bu blang pa'i phyir so so thar pa'i tshul khrims kyi gru chen por zhugs te/ thar pa'i ba dan btsugs pa'i tshul ston pa ni/ bstan pa la zhugs nas yongs su rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos por ma sgrub na/ so so thar pa'i las sgrub pa dang / las kyi cho ga la mi dbang ba dang / gsang sngags las kyang dge slong la bsngags pa che bar gzigs nas/ dgung lo sum cu pa byi ba'i lo zla ba bcu pa'i tshes drug gi snga dro'i cha la/ mkhan po byang chub sems dpa' chen po rin chen mgon dang / las kyi slob dpon bla ma nam mkha' sangs rgyas/gsang ste ston pa bla ma kun dga' rgyan/ grib tshod pa slob dpon shākya byang chub dad pa'i dge 'dun dge slong rgyal mtshan 'bum gyis thog drangs pa rnams kyi dbus su e'i chos grwa chen por bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad nas/ dgra bcom pa chen po'i rnam par gyur te/ ngur smrig 'dzin pa thams cad kyi nang nas gtsug gi nor bu lta bur 'gyur te/lam mchog so so thar pa'i sgor zhugs nas/ /nyes lhung dri ma'i tshogs kyis rab dben zhing / /nyis brgya lnga bcu'i khrims kyi 'khor gyis bskor/ /sems dpa' khyed ni gnas brtan dgra bcom 'dra/ /—88—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/gzhung lugs kyi pad tshal legs bshad kyi tsha zer gyis phyes te tshig don phun tshogs kyi sbrang rtsis blo gsal gyi bung ba tshim par mdzad tshul ston pa ni/de yang 'di ltar/ nang du bde gsal mi rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis sgo du ma nyams su myong bar byed pa don dam par byang chub kyi sems dang / sems can thams cad la ma bu gcig pa ltar brtse ba bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang nam yang 'bral ba med pa'i ngang nas/ phyi ru bstan pa bzung ba'i phyir bshad nyan g.yel ba mi mnga' bar mdzad do/ /dus chos la phar tshad gnyis mngon pa kun las btus/ mdo sde rgyan rgyud bla ma spyod 'jug dang po ti drug drug gsungs/ zhar chos la bka' mdo rgyud dang de'i 'grel pa 'grel bshad/ man ngag gi skor mtha' yas pa rnams/'jam dpal dbyangs chen po don yod rgyal mtshan sku mched kyis thog drangs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rgya mtsho lta bu la gsungs shing / bshad nyan la gnod dogs nas gshin chog la sogs pa rnams la yang ma byon par/ bshad nyan la brtson pa'i stobs dang / byang chub kyi sems kyi nus pa dang / gzhung lugs 'chad pa na tshig don gsal zhid 'brel chags pa/ chad lhag med cing rna bar snyan pa'i tshig gis brda 'phrod pas nges shes skyed pa la gzhan las phul du phyin pa'i legs par bshad pa'i gsung gi 'od zer gyis/ nyan pa po'i mi shes pa'i dri ma bsal te/ blo gros kyi pad mo'i ze 'bru gsal bar mdzad pa la brten nas/ g.yu chu ba slob dpon kun rin bya ba dka' pod bcu gsum blo la 'chad pas thog drangs pa'i po ti mang po mkhyen pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma dang /—89—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/grwa skor 'khor ba'i ston pa du ma zhig bton cing / bstan pa rin po che'i khur chen po 'khur ba'i dus su dgung lo so gnyis pa yos lo la 'jam dpal dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan pa sku mched yum dang bcas pa dang / bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan kun spangs nam mkha' grags/ byang sems rin chen mgon rnams kyis rta ra'i gdan sa mdzad par zhu ba gsol ba la/ zhal bzhes ma mdzad pas/ bla ma mnur pa chos 'phags rgyan dang / rin po che shes rab 'bum pas kyang gdan sa mdzod gsungs pa'i zhal ta nan chen po mdzad pa/ bla ma'i bka' bcag par gyur dogs nas zhal gyis bzhes te/ byang sems rin mgon gyis dbu mdzad pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang shab tshang pa la gtogs pa'i dge bshes gra bu slob rnams kyis zhu 'bul byas pas chos grwa chen po e'i zur chen mdzad de/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen nam mkha'i skar ma tsam gyi dbus na/ sems dpa' chen po nyid zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba ltar du ni mdzes/ mkhas pa dang btsun pa dang bzang ba'i grags pas phyogs thams cad du ni khyab/ 'jam dpal dbyangs chen po don yod rgyal mtshan sku mched kyis thog drangs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis gtsug gi nor bu lta bur ni bskur/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis ni zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du 'phel zhing rgyas/'chad pa dang rtsod pa dang / rtsom pa'i bya bas ni dus 'da'/ dbul phongs thams cad la chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pa char bzhin du ni 'bebs/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi don la skad cig kyang g.yel ba med pa'i ngang nas rta ra'i gdan sa lo bdun mdzad ces grag go /—90—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/mkhyen brtse'i tsha zer phyogs bcur 'phros pa yis/ /ma rig mun sel blo gros pad tshal 'byed/ /shes bya'i gnas rnams ji bzhin gsal bar ston/ /sems dpa' khyed ni nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dra/ /legs par bshad pa lde mig gis gsung rab rin po che'i gter mdzod kha phye ba'i tshul ston pa ni/ 'di ltar thos te/ mngon pa kun btus la dpang lo'i ṭīk+ka gzhi byas nas brjod bya'i tshogs mang nyung 'dra ba la 'phral zhal gsal ba 'chad bde zhing go sla ba/ khyad par du las dang po la phan pa zhig bya dgos dgongs pa la/ dpang lo'i ṭīk+ka la gnod dogs nas ma mdzad/ snga gzhud la mchan zhib po zhig btab gsungs/ de dus phar tshad gnyis la'ang ṭīk+ka byas na legs rab yong bar gda' ste/ sgros gsar rnying dang de 'dra'i chags sdang gi rkyen du gyur dogs nas ma byas par phar phyin gyi gzhung la mchan cig btab gsungs/dgung la sa brgyad pa la 'jam dbyangs dan yad pas bskul nas/mdo sde rgyan la ṭīk+ka mdzad/ khong gis bskul nas sbyar byas na/ stong sob tu song dogs nas ma byas/ 'di la dka' las kyang che rab byas nas brtsams te/legs rab cig byung nas 'dug gsungs/ de'i rjes la rgyud bla ma'i ṭi kā mdzad/ de'i rjes la slob dpon grub rgyal ba'i don du spyod 'jug gi ṭīk+ka mdzad/dpang lo'i drung du spyod 'jug su mkhas kyi gleng mo byung bas/ la la na re/ kyi ston pa mkhas zer/ dpang lo'i gsung ni mi mkhas/ spyod 'jug la bod gangs —91—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/can gyi khrod na rgod tshangs pa dang / gu ru thogs med gnyis las mkhas pa med/spyod 'jug gi don thams cad khong gnyis kyi rgyud la ldan pa yin gsung zhes grag go /bshad nyan mdzad dus slob dpon dang mched grogs 'ga' res/phyag rdzas srab pa la grwa ba mang po skyong dgos pas lag len skor rnams skyong bar zhu zhes zhus pas/ lag len skyong na nga'i lag len de 'di lta bu zhig yin te dgongs nas rgyal sras rnams kyi lag len bshad par bya zhes lag len bshad/ bshad par bya zhes lag len gyi sgra la brten nas rang gzhan thams cad rgyal sras lag len la 'jug pa'i phyir rgyal sras lag len mdzad/brtsams zin nas zhu dag la khang thog byon te mdun na bzhag yod pa'i dus/rlung chen po cig byung nas khyer song bas shog bu gcig kyang ma rnyed/ de nas yang blo la gsal le 'dug pas ldab nas bris/ de phyogs thams cad du dar ba 'di'i rten 'brel yin pa 'dra gsungs/ de'i dus su snyung po cig byung ba la grwa pa rnams kyis zhal ta 'jog pa zhu zhus pas nga'i kha chems rgyal sras lag len yin gsung zer/ de nas thams cad kyis sku rim rgya chen po bsgrubs shing gsol ba btab pas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don la yun ring du bzhugs so/ /brtsam chos thor bu ba mdzad pa la 'jug pa sems bskye dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed/ smyung gnas rnams kyi cho ga blo sbyong / rten 'brel snying po skyid sdug lam khyer rnams kyi khrid yig /bla ma dang bla ma brgyud pa'i bstod pa/ rgyal ba dang rgyal ba'i sras la bstod pa/ rang la bskul ba dang gzhan la gdabs pa snga rting yi ger thebs pa la brgya dang bcu gsum mdzad de/—92—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/sna tshogs rin chen gter kha phye ba ltar/ /don mang gzhung nyung 'dus pa gsal bar ston/ /sdeb legs bstan bcos rtsom pa'i mchog tu gyur/ /mkhas pa dpa' bo de dang 'gran pa 'dra/ /de bas na thos bsam sgom gsum 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi phan yon bsngags pa la sbyar bar bya zhing /rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer las rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor thob pa don yod par byas pa'i phyag len gyi le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/chos kyi 'gal rkyen grogs ngan spong ba'i phyag len ston pa ni/gang dang 'grogs na dug gsum 'phel 'gyur zhing / /thos bsam sgom pa'i bya ba nyams 'gyur la/ /byams dang snying rje med par bsgyur byed pa'i/ /grogs ngan spong bar rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab te/ de yang 'di ltar thos so/ /dgung lo nyi shu lon pa'i dus su ston pa nam rdor bya ba'i bshad slong kyis grogs la byon pas/ rnyed che bar yong / 'o skol gnyis ka bshad gsar ba yin byas nas rdzun byed dgos zer ba la/ sngon nas bden pa'i tshig smra ba la goms pas/ grogs ngan gyi dbang du ma btang bar rdzun mi zer gsungs pas/khong yang dad nas nga la nyid lta bu'i grogs po yod pa zer nas bkur ba'i yul du 'dzin to zhes grag go /gzhan yang 'di ltar/ dper na smyon pa la lam mkhan bcol na lam log tu 'khrid pa las 'os med/ de bzhin du gang zag thos pa chung la lta ba mtho ba/ rgyud tshod dma' la spyod pa rtsing ba'i smyon pa lta bu bla mar tshul 'chos pa dang / ne tsho smra mkhan bzhin du kha nas zab mo'i tshig bzang kham po che bshad kyin don gyi lag len med pas las rgyu 'bras la mi 'dzems pa de lta bu bla mar tshul 'chos pa dang / rje dpon ngan pa bzhin du slob mas bsnyen —94—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/bkur dang zhabs tog bag tsam chung shing 'gyangs pa dang / ko long sdom du yong la nor snying sdug re phul ba dang 'dzum yal yal yong la slob ma de chos bzhin byed mi byed mi blta bar 'phral gyi zas nor la dung nge byas pa de lta bu bla mar tshul 'chos pa dang dper na bud med mo gsham bzhin du/ bla ma ngan pa re dang phrad pa na/ gzhan skyes bu dam pa kun gyis drung du 'gro mi ster khong rang gi drung du ji tsam bsdad kyang yon tan ci yang mi skye ba de lta bu bla mar tshul 'chos pa rnams kyang grogs ngan yin te/ rdo rje 'chang gi dbang ler/ nga rgyal dang ldan khro bas zil mnan dam tshig rnam bral rdzas la rkam zhing thos pa dag kyang med / /slob ma rnams ni slu ba don du gnyer zhing mchog gi bde ba'i lam las sems nyams dbang ma bskur/ /longs spyod dag la kun chags bag med rtsub mo'i tshig dang bcas shing dbang po'i don du 'dod ldan pa/ /de nyid dmyal ba bzhin du slob ma mkhas pa rnams kyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub rgyur ni spang bar bya/ /ces gsungs pa ltar nga rgyal gyis khengs shing snying rje chung ba/ khong khro shas che ba gsang ba'i dam tshig rnams 'chol par spyod pa/ dge 'dun dang dkon mchog gi dkor la rngam zhing rdzas la zhen pa/ mdo rgyud phyin ci ma log pa'i thos pa med pas rmongs shing / yang dag pa'i man ngag med kyang yod par tshul 'chos pas slob ma slu ba/ bag med pas chang dang bud med la chags pa/ rgyud kyi rdo rje'i tshig phyin ci log tu 'chad pa'i bla ma'i ming btags rnams kyang / bdud kyi sprul pa'am grogs po yin pa'i phyir/ rgyang ring du spangs te/ rang byung gi grogs byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang / nam yang 'bral ba med par mdzod/ —95—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/zla ba'i dkyil khor mun pa dang bral bzhin/ /bdud kyi grogs ngan ring du rab spangs te/ /grogs kyi mchog gyur byang chub sems gnyis dang / /nam yang 'bral ba med pa de la 'dud/ /mthun rkyen bshes gnyen dam pa bsten pa phyag len ston pa ni/gang zhig bsten na nyes pa zad 'gyur zhing / /yon tan yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel 'gyur ba'i/ /bshes gnyen dam pa rang gi lus las kyang / /gces par 'dzin pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab te/ byang chub sems dpa' gzhon nu nor bzang gis theg pa chen pa'i bshes gnyen brgya rtsa gcig bsten pa'i tshul ltar/ sems dpa' chen po 'dis kyang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen bcu phrag bzhi dang 'gran gyi do zla bral ba'i yongs 'dzin rin chen gnyis rnams bsten te/ de yang thog mar shes bya rgya chen gsan pa'i yongs 'dzin bcu phrag cig ni 'di ltar dgung lo bcu bzhes pa'i dus su/ 'jam dbyangs 'khon ston la/ sems bskyed/ phar tshad gnyis/ mngon pa/ gshin rje dgra nag gi mngon rtogs yum sgrub mi 'khrugs pa'i sgom bzlas rnams gsan/ bla ma kun rgyal ba la mngon pa —96—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/kun las btus la sogs pa byams pa dang 'brel ba'i chos skor rnams gsan/'jad rong pa 'jam dbyangs nyi ma rgyal mtshan la tshad ma rnams nges gsan/ sa skya'i mkhas pa chen po bla ma gzhen rgyal ba la/ sde bdun 'grel pa 'grel bshad dang bcas pa gsan/ bla ma bkra shis mgon la mngon pa kun las btus gsan/ slob dpon shākya byang chub la phar phyin gsan/ khro phur tshad ma'i skyes bu bsod nams mgon la/ yum rgyas pa brgyad stong pa brgyad stong 'grel chen sogs gsan/ 'jam dbyangs nyag gcig la/ nyi khri khri brgyad stong pa/ shesarab sna tshogs/ shes rab khri ba/ nyi khri le mang / nyi khri snang ba/ le brgyad ma sa sde lnga rnams gsan no/ /pang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa la/ sa sde lnga theg bsdus skor gsum/ mngon pa kun las btus/ thub pa dgongs rgyan rnam bshad rigs pa/ las sgrub pa'i rab tu byed pa/ rten 'brel mdo 'grel/ dbu ma sgo rim sogs dbu ma'i skor/dus 'khor rgyud 'grel gsang 'dus kyi sgrub thabs/ brgyad stong don bsdu/ de'i 'grel pa/ byang chub gzhung lam/ phung po lnga'i rab byed/ bcu gcig zhal gyi gzungs/ sdud pa'i 'grel pa sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi mdzad pa rnams gsan/ gu shri rin chen seng ge la mngon pa kun las btus gsan no/ /shin tu bka' drin che ba'i bshes gnyen bcu phrag cig bsten tshul ni/dgung lo lnga ba'i dus su bsam gling pa'i gdung rgyud sangs rgyas dbon pa bde mchog dril bu pa'i dbang zhus pas dbang bzhi'i don ngo 'phrod pa byung zhes grag go /bsam gling pa'i rin po che dpal 'bar ba dang / mkhan po rin chen dpal —97—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/bzang po gnyis la so sor thar pa'i sdom pa de'i bslab bya dang bcas pa gsan/bla ma mdo sde dpal ba la rnam rgyal sgrub thabs dang / gzungs sgrol ma maṇ+ḍal bzhi/ sgrol ma nyer gcig gis las tshogs sgrub thabs dang bcas pa/ gshin rje gshed drag po'i rjes gnang / byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i gtor ma brgya rtsa gzer lnga'i gdams pa/ rnam dag gtsug nor sogs gsan/ bla ma mnur pa chos 'phags rgyal mtshan la/ yo ga'i skor gyi dbang bka' bshad bka' man ngag gi bka' thams cad rdzogs pa dang / zab chos gsan/ byang sems rin chen mgon la bde mchog sgrol ma 'khor chen dgyes rdor dgra nag tshe dpag med/ kun rig rnams kyi dbang / byang chub dgongs brgyan/ theg bsdus skor gsum/ byams chos lnga rtsa 'grel/ nyi shu ba sum cu ba/ sems bskyed lan drug rnam rgyal gyi rjes gnang / mgon po lcam dral gyi rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa/ a phyi ma'i gtor dbang gtor chog la sogs pa gsan/ bla ma ra sa ba rin chen gling pa la 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs zhus nas nyams len mdzad pas don spyod kyi shes rab chen por song gsungs/ mkhan chen chos rgyal dpal bzang po la snying po don gsum/ sems nyid ngal so khro phu ba'i man ngag brgya rtsa'i skor rnams gsan/ bla ma ri pa dpal she la/ zha ma nas brgyud pa'i phyag rgya chen po stod skor/ nā ro chos drug lhan cig skyes sbyor sogs gsan/ kun spangs nam mkha' grags la/ bde mchog gi dbang lan gnyis dpa' bos mdzad pa'i skyes rabs/ bslab btus mdo btus phyag rgya chen po gang gā ma gsan/ bla ma 'di —98—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/la ni ma 'ongs pa'i mngon par mkhyen pa mnga' ste/ gzim khang chos rdzong rtsig rtsig pa'i bkod pa'i zhal ta ar po rnams la mdzad pa'i rtsa na sems dpa' chen po yang bzhugs pa la/ nyid kyi thugs dgongs la/ btsun rgan blo ma khugs dgongs yod mchi ste/ khang pa 'di'i bed sus spyod mi shes so a gsung zhing / mkhar las grub nas dgun cig bzhugs pa dang sku bsnyung ste/ sems dpa' chen po gdan drangs nas nga'i tshig bzhi po 'di nyid kyis bsgral cig gsungs te/ nga ma shi bar rtsar bzhugs gsungs pa dang / shi nas zhe dgu'i bar cho ga re gyis gsungs pa dang / gzim khang 'di dang gzhis nas khal brgya thon pa gcig 'bul bas bzhes ga༄/nga ba la/ gzhis lo cig bsnams nas khong rang gi dus mchod la phul/ gzhan rnams gsung bzhin du bsgrubs te/ sems dpa' chen po'i gsung na re/ khang pa 'di grub nas khong pas dgun cig las ma bzhugs 'o skol gyis lo gsum cu rtsa grangs shig tu bed spyad 'dug de dus ma 'ongs pa'i mngon shes gsungs par gda' gsungs/zab chos sna tshogs zhus pa'i bshes gnyen bcu phrag cig ni 'di ltar/ bla chen kun blo la sems bskyed rgyal sras lam bzang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod 'jug sogs gsan/ 'dzim pa'i bla ma yon tan rgya mtsho la/ 'khor chen dang sgrol ma'i rgya gzhung / don zhags skor rnams gsan/ de'i sku mched bla ma rdo rje dpal bzang la gzer lnga'i byin brlabs/ bshes springs la sogs gsan/bla ma rin ye ba la 'jug pa sems bskyed/ byams chos lnga rtsa 'grel/ dpe chos dang man ngag rin spungs sogs gsan/ 'jam dpal dbyangs don yod pa la/—99—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/sgrol ma dang / bde chen ral gcig gi dbang / sems bskyed/ sa skya ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong min pa/ dbu ma chen po'i khrid rnams gsan/ mkhan bu ston pa la bde mchog gsang 'dus dpal chog rdor sems rnams kyi dbang /nag po pa'i sgrub thabs kyi ṭīk+ka/ las chog gi ṭīk+ka rnams gsan/ bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan la sems bskyed sgrol ma'i dbang / dril bu bskor gsum gyi lung / bde mchog mchod 'phreng / bde mchog sdom 'byung gi 'grel pa sum pa lo tsā'i snyan brgyud/ rnam rgyal gyi bstod pa/ tsaṣ+ṭa go mis mdzad pa rnams gsan/ra sa pa bla ma bsod nams lhun grub la gshin rje gshed dgra nag gi dbang rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa gsan/ bla ma blo bzang ba la glang ri thang pa'i blo sbyong tshig rkang brgyad ma gsan/ spyi bo lhas pa'i mkhan po shes rab rgyal grub bozang la/ thugs rje chen po skyer sgang pa'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa sags gsan na/ /dag snang rgya chen sbyangs pa'i bshes gnyen bcu phrag cig ni/ ti sgri'i kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ bla ma mkhas btsun chen po bla chen bsod blo/ bla ma shes rab rgyal mtshan/ bla ma shar pa kun bsod/ drang po lung pa'i mkhan po thugs rje shes rab/ slob dpon dpal gyi mkhan chen bsod nams seng ge /bla ma rgyal po dpal ba bla ma nam mkha' sangs rgyas rnams la yang chos 'brel re yong gsungs/ 'gran gyi do zla bral ba'i yongs 'dzin rin chen gnyis ni 'di ltar/bstan 'dzin thams cad kyi gtsug rgyan phan bde thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/gnas brtan chen po'i sprul pa/ dag pa'i sa la gnas pa'i sems dpa' chen po —100—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/mkhan rin po che bsod nams grags la/ mdo rgyud thams cad snying po/ man ngag thams cad kyi nying khu/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi spyi lam theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong zhus pa'i dus su skye ba dpag tu med pa'i gong rol nas dpon slob kyi 'brel ba yod pa'i rten 'brel gyi byang chub kyi sems gnyis kyi dbyar gyi chu klung chen po'i rgyun bzhin du 'phel zhing rgyas/ stong pa nyid snying rje'i rba klong chen po 'khrugs nas don gnyis lhun grub kyi rgya mtsho chen por phyin te/ bla ma yid bzhin gyi nor bu las sangs rgyas dngos kyi mos gus lon te/ mkhan chen rin po che dang mjal ba na gnas brtan chen po zhig dang mjal ba'i snang ba yong gin 'dug gsungs/jo bo rje'i bla ma gser gling pa'i mtshan brjod pa'i tshe phyag thal mo sbyor/spyan chab 'don pa bzhin du/ mkhan chen rin po che'i mtshan brjod pa dang /phyag thal mo sbyar spyan chab nyil nyil mdzad nas nga'i bla ma de'i thugs rje de lta bu gzhan la rang med gsungs nas/ gtsug gi nor bu ltar 'dzin te/ skyid sdug lam khyer/ don zhags kyi skor/ sman bla'i rjes gnang dang mdo mchog /'dul ba mdo rtsa ri khrod ma lo gyon ma dang 'od zer can gyi gzungs jo bo rjes mdzad pa'i sems skyed cho ga /dze ta ris mdzad pa la sogs pa'i chos chung brgya rtsa rigs gtad sogs skyer sgang ba'i chos skor rnams zhor nyan mdzad/ de'i rjes la 'a cog pa sems bskyed sogs kyang zhus so/ /dang por rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas par sbyangs shing / bar du rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid dang dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje —101—
