mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/chen po gnyis la goms par byas pas/ mchog gi dngos grub brnyes nas 'gro ba'i don rgyun chad med par mdzad pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i ngo bor gyur pa/ rin po che sher 'bum pa la/ rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs/ sdud byed rnams kyis bsdus/rigs gsum mgon pos bkral/ lo paṇa rnams kyis bsgyur/ mkhas pa rnams kyis gtan la phab/ bshad pa'i srol ma chag /bka' rgyud grub thob rnams kyis zam ma chad/ byin brlabs kyis na bun ma yal ba/ rgyud sde thams cad kyi snying po/ rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi spyi lam sbyor ba yan lag drug zhu ba'i thog mar dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs par zhus te/ mtshams dam por bcad nas yan lag drug gi khrid zhus te sgom pa'i dus na/ 'od gsal chos kyi sku la mnga' brnyes te/ dang po'i sangs rgyas ye shes lhun grub kyi rten dang / brten pa lha dang lha mo dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams nges pa gsum ldan du zag med bde ba chen po'i ngang du rol ba gzigs/ snga phyi med steng 'og med 'dus ma byas rgyar ma chad/ phyogs su ma lhung / gsal la ngos bzung med/ bde la zag pa med/ snang la rang bzhin med/ mdangs 'od gsal gshis skye med mtshan nyid gnyis su med pa/ gzhon nu ma la pra phab pa bzhin du/ me tog bkram pa dang / rin chen phyag rgya dang / mun pa nges par 'joms pa dang / rnam pa thams cad gzigs pa dang / nam mkha' lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma shar/ rdo rje lus kyi rtsa 'dir rlung 'di rgyud/ byang sems 'di 'bab pa mngon sum du gzigs/ zhing khams brjod kyis mi lang rnams su de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha'i skar ma tsam gyi zhal gzigs sking lung bstan pa sogs nyams —102—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/dang grub rtags brjod kyis mi lang ba yod de/ kun dang thun mong ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir ma bris so/ /bla ma 'di la rdo rje 'chang dngos kyi mos gus mnga' ste/ bla ma rgyud pa'i lo rgyus gsungs pa'i dus su dpang lo'i gsung na re/gal te rnal 'byor pa yis ni/ /stong pa nyid ni rtag sgom na/ /blo ni gzhon pa la dga' ba/ /'byung ba dag ni the tshom med/ /bya ba der ni so che shes rab 'bum khong la yod par gda' gsung pa yin/thugs rje chen po'i zhal gzigs ma gzigs ni cha med/ thugs rje chen po thugs rgyu la 'khrungs ngo shes de yin gsung nas phyag thugs kar sbyar te/ spyan chab nyil nyil mdzad/ bde/ bar gshegs pa'i dus su yang / bsnyung ba med par rdo rje'i skyil mo dkrung bcas pa la grongs gsungs/ dus lan cig ched kyi shog gsungs te/ snyan nas snyan du thugs nas thugs su rgyud/ sdig po che bcan thabs su sangs rgya bar nus shing / rab tshe 'di 'bring bar do/ tha ma yang skye ba bdun nam/ bcu drug na sangs rgya ba'i gdams ngag grub thob kyi zam ma chad/byin brlabs kyis na bun ma yal ba/ mkha' 'gro ma kha rlangs pa thul le ba'i man ngag thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid dang / phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skye sbyor dang / rten 'brel snying po rnams kyi khrid dbang mdor bstan/ smyung gnas kyi skor rnams gsan te/ 'gro don phyag rgya chen po yong ba'i rten 'brel mdzad do/ /—103—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/rgyal ba lta bu'i bshes gnyen du ma la/ /rgyal ba'i mdo rgyud dbang dang man ngag sogs/ /rgyal bas gsung bzhin thugs su chud gyur pas / /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab bstan pa'i bdag por gyur/ /yon tan gyi 'byung gnas dben pa bsten pa'i phyag len ston pa ni/yul ngan spangs pas nyon mongs rim gyi 'grib/ /rnam g.yeng med pas dge sbyor ngang gis 'phel/ /rig pa dwangs pas chos la nges shes skye/ /dben pa bsten pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab te/ de yang 'di ltar thos so/ /bo dong e'i rta ra'i gdan sa sems dpa' chen po rang gi bu chen/ slob dpon rgyal mtshan seng ge la gtad nas kyang bshad nyan mdzad pa'i dus su/ 'jam dpal dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan sku mched/ yum dang bcas pa rnams kyigo e'i chos dpon mdzad par zhu ba gsol bas/ ngas mkhan po btsal yong gi gsungs nas sa skyar byon te/ lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa la e'i bla chos la 'byor par zhu phul bas/ gu ru thogs med thos pa'i gtam la snyan/ nga'i bla ma stag sde ba seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis ma thob pa'i gdan sa yin sang rang 'gro gsungs nas —104—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/mnyes 'dug gsungs/ de nas legs pa gdan drangs nas sa sde la sogs pa'i phyag dpe rnams lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa la phul nas/ dben pa bsten pa la thugs phyogs te/'du 'dzi mi gotsang ba ltar rgyang bosrings nas/ /rang gzhan dan du bsam tan sgam pa la/ /rab tu brtson par 'dod pa'i skye bo yis/ /phyi dang nang gi dben pa thob par shog /ces sogs dang /rang bzhin nyams dga' gzhan gyi 'tshe ba med/ /chu dang lo ma 'bras bu'i 'byor pa med/ /chags dang sdang ba'i gtam yang mi thos pa'i/ /dben pa'i nags tshal dag tu gnas par bya/ /zhes sogs gsungs nas/ rang bzhin gyis 'dug na nyams dga' zhing / ting nge 'dzin ngang gis 'phel ba me tog rnam pa sna tshogs skye ba/ bya rnam pa sna tshogs sgra snyan pa 'byin pa/ rtswa dang lo ma dang / 'bras bus brgyan pa'i shing ljon pas mdzes pa/ mdun na chu bo chen po bzhi'i ya gyal yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i gtsang chu'i chab sgra snyan po lhung lhung du 'bab pa/ de'i nye zhabor na be+e ḍūr lta bu'i ne'u gsing sngon po la me tog kha dog sna tshogs pa dag gis tshom bu bkod pa bzhin du brgyan pa/ 'tsho ba rnyed sla zhing chom rkun dang gcan gzan gyi 'jigs pa med pa/ gangs ri dpal dang ldan pas bskor ba'i dbus g.yas ru —105—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/byang gi sa cha/ grub chen rgyud mar byon pa'i gnas mchog ri bo po ta la dang tshul mtshungs par gyur pa dngul chu'i chos rdzong du dgung lo zhe gsum pa la byon nas sku mtshams bcad/ mthun rkyen gyi zhabs tog slob dpon bsod nams brtan gyi pha ma gnyis dang phyug mo sna tshogs kyis bsgrubs te/ nye gnas ma gtogs su la'ang mjal kha med cing / nyin mtshan thams cad stong nyid snying rje zung du 'brel ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis dus 'da' bar mdzad do/ /de dus e nas dge bshes rnams kyis gdan 'dren pa la phyin te/ da dung chos gsung bar zhu 'phrin phul bas/ mjal kha yang ma gnang bar/brtse yang gzhan phan nus med ma ṇi ba/ /mchi ma'i rgyun dang snying rjes gdong dang yid/ /rnam par brlan par gyur nas rang nyid kyis/ /slob ma rnams la snying gtam 'di skad smra/ /zhes pa nas/ phrad kyang 'di las gzhan pa smra rgyu med/ /ces sogs gdams pa gnang te gtong / de nas lo 'ga'i bar du/ gsol 'dren pa'i bug sgo ma gtogs pa sbring 'gags mdzad/ phyi nas 'bul ba'i dad rdzas thams cad kyang blangs/ thengs gcig sha gsar gzugs shig dang / zho zhig dang / phud dam gang 'bul ba byung ba nye gnas kyis blangs pas/ nyid rang gsol gsungs nas gsol du ma gnang / nye gnas kyis kyang za ma nus par chang dang zho bo/ sha de chu bya la byin ces grag go / ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su rnyed bkur la/ /—106—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/re sa med cing kha zas zhim po yi/ /ro la chags pa spangs te 'khor ba yi/ /ra ba las ni thar pa bya phyir 'bad/ /lo nyi shu rtsa grangs kyi bar du sku mtshams khor yug la bzhugs te/ de dus chos rje kun mkhyen pas dngul chur byon nas/ rang re zhal cig mjal bar zhu chos kyi gsung gleng mdzad pa'i na gsungs pa la/ da lta mtshams dam po'i dam bca' zhig bdog pas mi mjal bar zhu/ da gzod nged mjal du yong zhes zhal gyi bzhes/ khong gi grub mtha'i dri ba'i lan zhu yig phul te sku mtshams ma phye zhes thos so/ /de dus chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa bo dong du byon nas mjal du 'byon gsung ba la yang / re nga mi byon par zhu zhes zhu ba bskur te/de'i dus su mi chen kha drag pa sus zhus kyang mtshams ma phye bar/sku ni 'du 'dzi'i g.yengs bas dben/ /gsung ni bre mo'i gtam gyis dben/ /thugs ni gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pas/ /dben par gyur te zhes grag go /po ta la dang gnyis su ma mchis pa'i/ /dben zhing nyams dga'i gnas kyi mchog gyur der/ /'du 'dzi mi gtsang ba ltar rgyang bsrings nas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dben pa bsten la 'dud/ /—107—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/mi rtag pa thugs la 'khrungs pas tshe 'di blos btang ba'i phyag len ston pa ni/yun ring 'grogs pa'i mdza' bshes so sor 'bral/ /'bad pas bsgrubs pa'i nor rdzas shul du lus/ /lus kyi mgron khang rnam shes mgron pos 'bor /tshe 'di blos btang rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab ste/ de yang 'di ltar sems dpa' chen po 'di ni/stong pa nyid snying rje'i rba klong chen po 'khrugs kyang / 'o skol la nyams myong tsam med snying rje shas chung gsungs nas khengs skyung 'ba' zhig mdzad pa la/ mi rtog pa thugs la 'khrungs par zhal gyis bzhes te/ gnas dben par rig pa dngas pa'i dus su/ mi 'di dang 'di zhes bya ba shi zer ba thos tsa na 'o skol gyi lus 'di la yang chu'i lha ba'am/ rlung nang gi mar me bzhin du bzod blags ye med pa zhig yong gin 'dug gsungs/ nye gnas kyi gzim khang la mkhar lan cig byed pa yin zhus pas/ 'o skol yun ring sdod pa'i nges med/ de'i rkyen gyi sems can mang po 'chi gsungs nas ma gnang / bla ma rin ye ba'i sar bzhud pa'i shul du babs nas byas pas/ sems can mang po shi yod nga gzungs —108—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/sngags 'dren dgos sdug ge kun de la ci rer 'dug snying rjer gsung zhes grag go /de'i dus su gsungs pa/shin tu nyams chung chu bur lta bu'i lus/ /sna tshogs rkyen ngan rlung gis rab bskyod nas/ /skad cig gnas pa'i gdeng yang mi 'dug na/ /chos min yid la sems pa'i long 'dug gam/ /di ring tsam yang mi 'chi gdeng med cing / /shi nas gar skye rang dbang med bzhin du/ /don med tshe 'di'i bya ba lhur blangs nas/ /rang gis rang nyid bslus par mi 'gyur ram/ /zhes sogs dang /rgan gzhon dar ma go rim ma nges pas/ /'chi snyam med par glo bur 'chi 'gyur zhing / /sman spyad rim gro sogs kyis bzlog mi nus/ /'di 'dra bsams la tshe 'di'i zhen pa spongs/ /nor ldan lag stong sgren mor 'gro 'gyur zhing / /kha drag can la yud tsam bsdad dbang med/ /'khor mang nang nas grogs med gcig pur 'gro/ /—109—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/'di 'dra bsam la tshe 'di'i zhen pa spongs/ / zhes sogs gsungs shing / mi rtag sgom pa 'di zab zer nas gnas lugs kyi don lta bu'i zab pa de lta min te/ 'di rgyu la skyes na dang po chos la 'jug pa'i rgyu byed/ bar du sgrub pa nyams su len pa'i lcag byed/ mthar 'od gsal chos sku thob pa'i rgyu byed pas 'di sgom pa gal che gsungs/ sems dpa' chen po 'di nyid ni mi rtag pa thugs la zhabrungs pas/ 'dod yon gyi 'khri ba chod/ phyi tshis kyi grabs gshom bor/ tshe 'di'i mdun ma mi chos kyi bya byed skad skad krig krig thams cad the la bor blos btang ba de yin no/ /'dus byas thams cad ri gzar 'bab chu bzhin/ /mi rtag mi brtan snying po med rtogs nas/ /phyi tshis grabs gshom tshe 'di'i bya byed kyis/ /snang ba nub par gyur pa de la 'dud/ /da slu med kyi dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro ba'i phyag len ston pa ni/rang yang 'khor ba'i gtsor rar bcings pa yi /'jig rten lha yi su zhig skyob par nus/ /de phyir gang la skyabs na mi bslu ba'i/ /dkon mchog skyabs 'gro rgyal sras lag len yin/ /—110—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phyag len la btab te/ de yang 'di ltar thos so/ /dbus su byon pa'i dus gung thang nas lha sar 'byon pa'i chu khar 'bebs dus/rta bdun brgyad cig la mi re re bzhon nas chu la rkyal btang nas byung bas chu dkyil du thams cad nub nas song bas gzigs pa dang a ka kha skyon che gsungs nas phyag thal mo sbyar te/ sgrol ma sgrol ma 'phags ma 'phags ma gsungs nas spyan chab nyil nyil 'dug pa dang / mi rta zung cig ma rtogs pa rta dang ma bral bar yug cig na chu 'gram thon byung mi rta zung gcig chus khyer song ba dang / sems dpa' chen po'i sku rgyab nas da ci med pa'i mi dkar po gzugs ring phrug gos dkar po snying song ba zhig ske rags dres ma chig rkyang bcings pa zhig byung nas nga 'gro nga 'gro zer zhing chu la tshom tshom med par rgal song nas mi de'i lag pa nas drud byung ste/ ci yang ma nyes par sos rting / mi dkar po de gar song cha med la song bas/ kun ya mtshan par gyur te/ sems dpa' chen po'i zhal nas kyang ci tho dod gsungs/ drung nas 'phags ma la gsol ba btab pas 'phags ma'i sprul pa yin las che zhus pas/ yin pa dag kyang srid re mtshar cig byung / lar rang gis blo gtod nus na dkon mchog 'dis rang mi slu ba zhig yin gsungs zhes grag go /dbyar cig bo dong na bzhugs pa'i dus su char pa ye ma bab pas/ chen po dpal rgyal bas char 'bebs shes tshad bsags nas phab kyang ma phebs par re thag chad pa'i dus su/ chen po pas/ bya rgod gshongs kyi jo bo ba la drung nas sku khrus cig gsol la char 'bab pa'i gsol ba cig 'debs par zhu zhus pas/ de bzhin bgyi —111—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/gsungs nas byon te gsol btab pas/ jo bo'i drung na bzhugs pa'i bar de rang la yang char pa thor thor babs/ de nas skad cig nyid la sprin chen po 'dus/ 'brug sgra zab mo ni skye bo rnams la gtam snyan skyel ba bzhin du grags/mi rnams ni dga' seng seng por gyur te 'di ltar/sprin mgo nag po mun nag spel ba bzhin/ /me long nang bzhin thal ba'i dkyil na mdzes/ /me bya rab dga' ze ba sprel ba rnams/ /glu gar mdzes pas rab tu bstod pa bzhin/ /sprin tshogs de dag dpa' bo dgod pa bzhin/ /rgyun chags zab mo'i sgra 'byin rnam par mdzes/ /de yis char phab mu tig gtor ba bzhin/ / 'brug gi rnga sgra rab tu dgang gyur na/ / glog phran 'gyu ba bro gar byed pa bzhin/ /de'i nub mo nas char chen po gnya' shing gi rgyun tsam pa zhag bdun gyi bar du bab pas/ chen po yang dga' ste/ ngas zhu ba 'bul rin chog zhus pas/jo bo 'di la byin brlabs shig rang gda' gsung zer/ de la sogs pa'i rnam grangs mang po yod de yi ge mang dogs pas 'jigs nas ma bris so/ /jo bo 'di dang / skyi rong gi 'phags pa wa ti'i mched zla grags pa'i 'jad sna gsar gyi jo bo dang / ngur smig gi sgrol ma rang byon rnams kyis sems dpa' chen po la —112—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/gsung byon par grags so/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen mes tshig pa'i dus dang / bla ma rin ye ba gtsang po'i zhabor la tshud pa'i dus su rje btsun ma la gsol ba btab pas me dang chu'i 'jigs pa las skyabs pa'i gtam rgyud gsungs nas/ dkon mchog 'di la snying thag pa nas gsol btab na byin brlabs kyis tshul 'phral la yong ste gsungs/spyan ras gzigs dbang sems dpa' khyed nyid kyis/ /rang dang rang gi spyan chab las 'khrungs pa'i/ /rje btsun ma la gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal 'phral du sel ba mtshar/ /de bas na 'gal rkyen grogs ngan spangs pa dang / /mthun rkyen bshes gnyen bsten pa dang / dben pa bsten pa/ mi rtag pa sgom pa dang / dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro ba'i phan yon dang bsngags pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer las/'gal rkyen grogs ngan spang ba dang / bshes gnyen dam pa bsten pa dang / yon tan gyi 'byung gnas dben pa bsten nas tshe 'di blos btang ste/ bslu med kyi dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro ba'i phyag len gyi le'u ste gsum pa'o// //—113—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/sdug bsngal sdig pa'i 'bras bur rtogs pas rgyu mi dge ba la 'dzem pa'i phyag len ston pa ni/shin tu bzod dka'i ngan song sdug bsngal rnams/ /sdig pa'i las kyi 'bras bur thub pas gsungs/ /de phyir srog la bab kyang sdig pa'i las/ /nam yang mi byed rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab ste/ de yang 'di ltar/ sems dpa' chen po 'di ni/ lta ba mtha' bral nam mkha' lta bu'i don rtogs kyang / nyes lhung shin du phra ba la yang 'dzem par mdzad de/dam pa'i don du las 'bras ma grub kyang / /kun rdzob las 'bras bslu ba med pa'i phyir/ /sdig pa spong zhing dge ba sgrub pa 'di/ /mtho dman kun la dgos pa'i spyod pa yin/ /zhes gsungs shing / dang po lpags thul gon pa tsam yang nyes par song dogs nas/ ya nga ba chen po byung ste/ phyis 'dul ba thos tsa na de tsam gyi spyod lam dog po yang mi dgos par 'dug gsungs/ nye gnas kyi lo gcig la zhing du ma btab pa gzigs pas/ sems can mang po 'chi ru yong / 'o skol lo yi ci byed —114—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/gsungs nas byed du ma gnang / dbyar yog mo'i me shing ma 'don de la sems can mang po yod/ ma shi na 'khos shig shar nas 'ong gsungs/ dbyar 'od khang med dus nub mo dkar me phul na phye ma leb 'chi ru yong gsungs nas dkar me nyin par 'bul/ dbyar kha mchod pa lnga se gyis phyis na sems can rkang 'og tu song ba mi mthong gsungs nas mdor na las rgyu 'bras la mngags pa chen po mdzad do/ /mtha' bral nam mkha' lto bu'i don rtogs pas/ /spangs blang dgag sgrub spras pa kun bral kyang / /rgyu 'bras slu ba med pa'i don gzigs pas/ /nyes lhung shin tu phra la'ang 'dzem pa mtshar/ /srid pa gsum gyi bde ba mi rtag par rtogs pas thar pa don du gnyer ba'i phyag len ston pa ni/srid gsum bde ba rtswa rtse'i zil pa bzhin/ /yud tsam zhig gis 'jig pa'i chos can yin/ /nam yang mi 'gyur thar pa'i go 'phangs mchog /don du gnyer bar rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab te/ lha'i nang nas tshangs pa dang /—115—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/brgya byin mi'i nang nas 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po thob kyang mi rtag cing 'jig pas snying po med/ thar pa bla na med pa'i byang chub 'di don du gnyer dgos gsung zhing 'di ltar gsung ngo / /thar pa'i lam du mi 'gyur dge ba yis/ /re zhig bde 'gro'i bde ba thob 'gyur kyang / /mkha' la mda' 'phangs sa la lhung ba ltar/ /'phen shugs zad nas ngan 'gror lhung ba 'gyur/ /me yi rang bzhin tsha ba yin pa ltar/ /'khor ba'i rang bzhin sdug bsngal yin par gsungs/ /bde phyir sdug bsngal 'dor 'dod skyes bu yis/ /thar pa don du dge bar 'bad par bya/zhes spranasungs so/ /srid gsum bde ba snying po med gzigs nas/ /rang gzhan don du tshogs gnyis grur zhugs te/ /sku gsum nor bu rin chen len par byed/ /sems dpa' khyed ni rgya mtsho'i ded dpon 'dra/ /skyes bu chen po ni lam mnyam nyid kyi byams pa chen po mnga' ba'i tshul ston pa ni/byang chub sems pas sems can la/ /bu gcig pa la bya ba bachin/ /—116—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/rkang gi khongs nas byams pa che/ /de lta'i rtag phan byed par 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ sems dpa' chen po 'di ni nang na byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin mnga' bas/ sems can thams cad la mnyam pa nyid du byams te/ de yang 'di ltar/ yon bdag gi rigs 'ga' zhig gis/ dmag la 'gro ba'i dus rim gro la gtor ma'i chas mang po skyal tsa na/ gtor ma phul nas 'phrin las bcol ba'i skabs su/ 'o skol rang dkon mchog chos skyong la zhu ba byed tsa na/phyogs gnyis ka ru rgyu 'khrug pa zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad zhi bar mdzod cig zer ba la rtogs shig rgyal cig 'phags par mdzod mi zer nyi cag rnam pa'ang de bzhin mdzod/ kho pa ta rgyal ba zhig 'dod de/rgyal ba ma byung yang 'khrug pa zhi na phar tshur gnyis kar la des chog /de bzhin byas pas yon bdag bslus par yang mi 'gyur gsungs/ sems can 'di dang 'di zer bya ba bde zhing 'dug zer ba gsan tsa na/ de legs so gsungs nas shin tu mnyes shing 'di ltar yang gsung ngo / /bdag gi sdug bsngal rlung shugs kyis bskyod nas/ /gang gi bzhin ras nag po'i sprin bsdus te/ /mchi ma'i char phab ngud mo'i 'brug sgra bsgrags/ /de 'dra yal bar 'dor bar rigs sam ci/ /—117—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin gyi gsung skor/bdag nyid bde ba'i nyi zer phog pa yi/ /gang gi bzhin ras pad mo'i tshal rgyas te/ /so'i ze 'bru dkar po ston gyur pa/ /de 'dra yal bar 'dor bar ga la rigs/zhesagasdo/nga ngo / /gang gi rang bzhin byams pa'i bdag nyid kyis/ /rnam par brlan pa bzhin du sems mthun zhing / /phun sum gnod pa med pa'i sems gyur nas/ /dka' thub can bzhin gcan gzan khro bo spyod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ drung na 'khod pa'i ri dwags dang gcan gzan kun gcig la gcig phan tshun gnod pa med cing byams te/ gzhan gyis phul ba'i sha khyi chen po zhig yod pa kun kyang rna mo'i rtsed mo'i phyir brdung ba ltar byas tsa na mi rmug par bros cing sprang po la rmug pa'i tshe na ni bgrangs pa dang rmug 'phro gcod pa cig yod do/ /zhus bu kun kyang bye'u mthong khar babs pa'i dus/gnod pa'i sems spangs nas de byung ba la dga' zhing 'drogs dogs pa'i phyir des mi mthong ba'i sar phyin nas nyal cing / bye chung la yang gnod pa med do/ /spyang ki zhig yod pa kun kyang 'tshe ba'i sems spangs te/ gting la sha byin kyang mi za ba cig byung zhing / ngang pa zhig yod pa kun kyang sems dpa' chen po bskor ba mdzad pa'i dus su kho yang skor ba byed/ bzhugs pa'i dus su kho yang sdod/ sems dpa' chen po'i spyod lam gyi lad mo byed pa zhig byung 'dug de la —118—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/mnyes shing / dmag byung nas bo dong du 'byon dgos pa byung dus/ nye gnas la gzhan dngos po mi thub ngang pa de ma lus pa gyis gsung zer/ mkhan thams cad mkhyen pa byang chub rtse mo'i gsung na re/ dud 'gro de kun gyi byed lugs de rang ngo mtshar che/ byang chub kyi sems 'di 'byongs tsa na gang yang dbang du 'du ba cig yino paro 'dug gsung zhing khong rang gi mdzad pa'i rnam thar na yang 'di ltar bkad yad da/ /dbus pa'i dmag 'jad du byung dus dngul chu rnams la/ dngos po la ma chags par thams cad bros/ 'gro ba mi yong ba'i rgas pa rnams kyi g.yog ngas byed pa yin gsungs te/ shul na yod pa rnams bred nas drung du 'tshogs te/bsdad yod pa'i dus/ dmag mi rnams khro zhing rngam pa'i tshul gyis drung du byung ste/zhal mthong ba dang 'phral du btul pa dang / khro zhing brngam pa rnams kyang zhi nas drung na 'khod pa rnams la gnod pa mi byed par byin brlabs zhus kyin 'gro/'ga' zhig ni dad pa skyes te/ mchi ma 'byin cing mi bsad pa'i sdig bshags byed do zhes grag go /drung na 'khod pa'i slob ma rnams kyang / nga kho na la mnyes shing byams snyam du thams cad de ltar ru sems shing / de rnams kyang gcig la gcig mthong che zhing byams pas phan tshun che mi rtsod par gral 'og tu sdod pa la has thob byed cing cig gi cig snyan par smra'o/ /byams pa'i rang bzhin byams pa'i thugs mnga' bas /drung na 'bod pa'i mi dang gcan gzan kyang / /gcig la gcig byams byams pa'i sems dang ldan/ /—119—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/char sprin mug po lta bu'i mdog 'dra ba'i/ /khro zhing gtum pa'i dmag dpung lhags pa'i tshe /gang gi sku ni mthong pa tsam gyis kyang / /khro ba zhi nas gnod pa'i sems dang bral/ /'gro rnams byams pas 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bzod med kyi snying rje chen po mnga' tshul ston pa ni/'gro ba 'di kun thugs rje'i bdag can des/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa de la the tshom med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ sems dpa' chen po 'di ni/ dper na ma bu gcig po yid du 'ong ba la brtse ba ltar 'khor ba'i sems can rnams la snying rje chen po mnga' zhing / khyad par du dngos su sdug bsngal ba dang / sdug bsngal gyi rgyu la spyod pa la brtse ste/ de yang 'di ltar thos so/ /dgung lo bcu drug tsam lon pa'i dus su/ zang zing gi phan 'dogs bag tsam byas pa'i dge bshes shig gis sang nyin la sleb dgos pa'i don gal can zhig gi bang chen bcol te bo dong nas sa skyar byon pa'i phyed lam sleb pa'i thang dkyil cig na khyi gu bzhi lnga zhig skyes pa yas bor nas song 'dug pa gzigs nas/ snying rje nas bshums shing / de ring 'di pha skyel du phyin na ni khong gi don mi 'grub/ di ring bzhag na ni/ dgun yin pas 'khyags nas kyang 'chi/ pho rog dang gcan gzan dag gis kyang bsod snyam du bsam pas di ring 'di pha bskyal la/ do red mtshan rkyang nas 'gro dgos pa yin dgongs te/ khyi khu skyel —120—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/ba'ang log byon pas/ dge bshes de dang da res ma 'phrad pa bya dgos dgongs pa la/ srang bar zhig tu 'phrad pas nyid kyis don gal can gyi btab bcog pa 'dug zer nas 'thab tu byung bas/ skye lo byung gsungs/ de nas de ma khad log nas byon pas tho rangs kha sa skyar phebs/ lan bsgyur tsha ba gzhig gsol nas byon pas dgong mo bo dong phebs te/ dge bshes des kyang ngo mtshar che ngas 'thab pa de yang bzod par gsol zer bas byung gsungs/ thabs mkhas la thugs rje che ba'i phyag len du gda'o/ /yang dgung lo nyi shu tsam lon pa'i dus su e'i dge 'dun rnams chos gzhi la btegs par/ rgya sgo'i 'gag na sprang mo zha ba gcig yod pa ngu bzhin 'dug pa thugs kyis ma bzod ste ci nyes dris pas/btsun pa thams cad 'byon par 'dug des na nga la lto gter mi mi yong zer/ngas khyod len du yong gi sdug bsngal ma byed gsungs nas thag pa khyer nas log byon te nga la khur gsungs pa la/ mos 'khur mi nus pa 'dug pas/ gdong la mo'i gos stan rnams bskyal/ de nas mo rang khur nas chos bar sar skyal gasdo/ngas/snying rje'i dbang gi sems can don mthong na/ /rang gi sdug bsngal dag la'ang mi gzigs par/ /sems can so so'i 'dod don sgrub mdzad pa'i/ /thabs mkhas thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /des na sems can dngos su sdug bsngal mthong na lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/gzhan gyi sems can sdug bsngal ba 'di 'dra 'dug zer ba gsan na/ nga'i ma —121—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/rgan de snying re rje gsungs te bshums nas gsung gleng kyang 'phro chad nas 'gro nyid / glang ri thang pa la gzhan gyis ngo nag po byas pa gsan nas/ nga'i ma rgan sems can sdug bsngal ba 'di la bsams tsa na ngo gdong dkar po yong sa mi 'dug gsungs zer/ de khong pa mad par gda' gsung nas spyan chab nyil nyil mdzad cing 'di ltar gsung ngo / /sdug bsngal mang gzir 'gro 'di yal bor nas/ /rang nyid zhi bde 'ba' zhig don gnyer bas/ /pha ma me yis tshig pa yal bor nas/ /rang nyid bsil ba'i rdzing bur khrus byed 'dra/ /'gro 'dis rang gi bde ba yal bor nas/ /bdag gi don du sdug bsngal khur blangs pa/ /sa dang rgya mtsho'i rdul bas ches mang na/ /de dag bdag gis ji ltar yal bar 'dor/ /thog med dus nas lan mang phan btags pa'i/ /'gro+o mngo bzod dka'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba/ /mthang thas dran kyang gas par ma gyur pa/ /bdag gi snying 'di lcags la byaba'isam ci —122—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/sngon chad yang yang sdug bsngal sel byed ma/ /mnar med me yi nang du tshig gyur na/ /de la snying rje'i bsam pa mi skye ba/ /bdag 'dra mi'i lus can dud 'gror zad/ /gsung zhing snying rje'i nyams byung rgyal du btang na nyin mtshan khor yug tu de nyid la rtse gcig tu 'byams nas phyi rol pas ltas na brgyal ba ltar mngon pa yong gin 'dug gsung / dbus pa'i dmag rting ma 'jad du byung dus dngul chu'i mdun gyi thang chen po dmag gis gang ba gzigs pas/ sdug ge tsho sdug ge tsho/nga'i ma rgan 'di tsam zhig 'khrul nas sdug bsngal gyi rgyu la spyod pa de snying rje snying rje gsung ste bzhugs gdan gyi steng du 'drel ldog mdzad cing / bshums pa'i mthar brgyal brgyal gyi bar du bshums 'dug ces grag go /gzhan yang 'di ltar thos so/ /ngan song gsum a cang che/ mi'i nang nas kyang sdug bsngal la dngos su spyod pa 'di rnams snying shin tu rje mod/ bsam mno legs par btang na sdug bsngal spyod pa 'di rnams snying rje gsungs zhing /da lta 'jig rten na mi che ru re drung du re/ 'khor mang kha drag nor che/ las su sdig pa 'ba' zhig byed pa de 'dra rnams gzigs pa'am/ dran pa'i de dag gi gleng mo byung tsa na yang spyan chab 'byin cing / sems dpa' chen po yi gsung na re pha rol po rnam rtog skyer yong bsam pa byung nas nyams dkyil gin tshod bzung ba min na de 'dra rnams dang phrad pa na mchi ma rang dbang med par yong gin 'dug gsung / 'o skol chos pa 'di rnams sdug bsngal gyi rgyu la spyod pa 'di —123—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/rnams la snying rje skye thang pa zhig 'dug pa la skye ba nyung ba de/ rang re rnams kyang tshe 'di'i dpal 'byor kha drag de rnams la skyon gnas su mi lta ba'i blo ngan de phugs su zhugs pas lan 'dug da lta sdug bsngal ba rnams la snying rje ba de sdug bsngal de la rang re yang skyon du lta bas yin par 'dug ste/ de gnyis rang skyon gang che mi shes gsung / tshogs chos gsung pa'i dus sems can gyi sdug bsngal la sems dpa' chen po nyid kyis bshums tsa na tshogs pa byin po ngu cong theg theg yod pa de la mtshan nyid pa zhig na re/ mkhan bu ston pa dang paṇa chen pa kun chos gsungs tsa na bzhad gad theg theg nyams dga' zhad che bar 'duga'adi pa'i chos gsung ba 'di sdug zhad che mi gces shi ba bzhin du ngu cong theg theg zer/ de kho'i de 'dra mo yang yod do/ /des na sems can gyi sdug bsngal snying rje chen po zhabrungs tshul gong 'og rnams su'ang bstan cing ston par 'gyur la phal cher ni brjod kyis mi lang ngo / /bu gces shi ba'i ma ma ji bzhin du/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal mthong thos dran gyur na/ /spyan chab si ta'i rgyun ltar 'bebs mdzad pa'i/ /'gro ba'i gnyen gcig po la phyag 'tshal lo/—124—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnamapar thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/byams pa dang snying rje chen po sngon du song ba'i sgo nas bsam pa byang chub kyi mchogo tu sems bskyed pa'i phyag len stan par byed pa ni/thog med dus nas bdag la brtse ba can/ /ma rnams sdug bsngal rang bde ci zhig bya/ /de phyir mtha' yas sems can bsgral bya'i phyir/ /byang chub sems bskyed rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab ste/ de yang 'di ltar thos so/ /sku mtshams dam po la bzhugs pa'i dus/ mkhan chen rin po che bsod nams grags pa zhing gzhan du myur por gshegs pa mngon par shes pas mkhyen te/ mtshams hur thon mdzad nas byon pa'i lam khar mi gnyis kyis ra cig mi 'gro bzhin khrid 'gro ba dang phrad pa la ci byed dris pas/ hor 'dra la sprod pa yin zer/ snying rje bas bshums te/ gser zho phyed byin nas 'di hor 'dra la byin la ra 'di ma bsad la blang byas gsungs/ de nas shangs kyi mda'i gad skyibs shig tu phebs pa dang / 'dir ja skol ngal gso ba yin gsung 'di na chu mi gda' zhus pas/ chu'i khag ngas khur/ me shing 'thus la shog gsungs/shing btus nas slebs pa'ang chu 'di na gda' yi gsungs nas phyag gis bye ma —125—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/la rud rud mdzad pa sngar med pa'i chu byung bas zhabs tog pa rnams kyis bsam pa la mig 'phrul yin nam bsam pa byung zer/ ja gsol zin pa'i rjes lo yang chu 'dug yar lam phyed kyis ltas pas chu'i rjes yang mi 'dug zer ra/ /de nas mkhan chen rin po che dang mjal bas/ nyid byon pa de dga' gsungs nas mnyes tshor chen po mdzad/ 'jug pa sems bskyed 'di sngar bla ma rin ye ba la thob lags te/ drung du zhig thob na bsams pas sku khams kyis lcogs tsam du gda' na thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhus pas de dus snyung rab 'dug te/ shin tu yang spro mo da lta rang mchod pa bshoms cig gsung zer/sems bskyed kyi cho ga dngos gzhi grub nas/ mkhyen par gsol ba gdab pa'i skabs su/ sa chen po ni rab tu g.yo/ lha'i me tog ni char bzhin du 'bab/spos kyi dri zhim po'i ngad pa ni rnam par ldang / rol mo'i sgra snyan pa ni dbyar gyi 'brug bzhin du grags/ sprin rnams 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i bla re bres par gyur ces grag go /cho ga tshar ba'i rjes la mkhan rin po che yi gsung na re/ chos bdag po'i lag tu 'phrod/ da ste btsun rgan di ring shi yang 'gyod pa med do gsungs nas/ rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur te/ de nas ring po ma thog par gshegs shing /gshegs khar sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad po de nar ba zhig gsungs nas/ gshegs zhes grag go /mkhan rin po che'i slob ma rnams na re/ bla ma rgyal sras pa de la mngon par mkhyen pa yod med las 'das nas 'dug mkhan chen pa gshegs pa'i le kha der khong gis phebs nas byon zer gin 'dug zer/ des na sems —126—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/dpa' chen po nyid kyang / nyin zhag re la dus gsum du smon 'jug gi sems bskyed bsdus pa re len cing /gang gis rang gi bde ba yal bor nas/ /yu bu'i don du bam khur blangs pa yi/ /sems can tshogs 'di blo yis yal bor na/ /theg chen dam chos thos pa'i dgos pa ci/ /des na mtha' yas sems can bsgral bya'i phyir/ /bla med byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de/ /rang don spangs te dngos sam brgyud nas kyang / /gzhan don sgrub byed skyes bu mchog yin no/ /gsung zhing dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang skye bo'i tshogs khri phrag du ma la byang chub sems kyi sdom pa gnang nas byang chub sems dpar gyur par mdzad cing dus phyis mkhan byang chub sems dpa' chen po byang chub rtse mos dbu mdzad pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'ba' zhig tshogs pa la 'jug pa sems bskyed gsungs pa'i skabs su/ 'o skol gyis mkhan chen rin po che ba la 'di zhus pa'i dus su/ chos bdag po'i lag tu 'phrod pa yin gsungs nas mnyes tshor chen po mdzad cing gda'/ 'o skol la bdag rgyu tsam med de da khong pa de skad gsung gin gda'/ 'on kyang byas pas/ jo bo rje yab sras sku mched gsum la sogs pa'i dus su'ang chos 'di la bka' dog pa yin —127—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/pa 'dug dus phyis kyang 'di 'bogs pa nyung bar gda'/ gang ltar lags kyang / 'o skol las dbus gtsang gnyis na/ chos 'di phog pa mang ba med/ sngar yang rgyud la skyes pa yang mang po byung zhing / da 'o skol nas chos 'di'i bka' yongs su gtong ba yin pas/ nyid cag dge ba'i bshes gnyena'abogs par nus pa thams cad kyis phog cig gsung ngo / /gnas brtan chen pos rgyal tshab dbang bskur nas/ /theg chen chos kyi bdag por lung bstan tshe/ /sa chen g.yo zhing me tog char bzhin 'bab/ /rol mo'i sgra dang spos kyi dri zhim ldang / /mkha' la 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i bla re bres/ /byams dang snying rje'i sprin chen las byung ba'i/ /byang chub sems kyis char pas 'gro ba yi/ /phan bde'i lwo thog smin par mdzad pa mtshar/ /de lta bas na sdig pa mi dge ba la 'dzem pa dang thar par don du gnyer ba dang byams snying rje dang byang chub kyi sems rin po che'i phan yon bsngags pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer las sdig pa mi dge ba la 'dzem pa dang / thar pa don du gnyer ba dang / byams snying rje chen po sngon du song ba'i sgo nas/ bsam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i phyag len gyi le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //—128—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/bdag gzhan brje ba sgom pa'i phyag len ston pa ni/sdug bsngal ma lus bdag bde 'dod las byung / /rdzogs pa'i byang chub gzhan phan sems las 'khrungs/ /de phyir bdag bde gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dag /yang dag brje ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ /ces gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab ste/ de yang 'di ltar thos so/ /slob dpon dpal ye bas blo sbyang la/ nyams su sgom dus/ khong la shig nad byung bas/ sems dpa' chen po'i gsung gis/ nyid rang gis snying rus skyed la gsos gal te mi gsos pa 'dra na 'dir byon/ nged kyis kyang gso rogs bya yin gsung zer/ khong gis yun ring po'i bar du gsos kyang nyung du ma song bas/drung du phyin nas bslab ye ru mal bcas nas zhag shas song ba dang / shig rnams nyung du song 'dug pas/ rnam rtog skyes te drung du ltar phyin pas/ drung pa la shig gi 'jig pa 'dug pa mthong bas/ drung nas 'o rgyal nga rang gi snying rus skyed la gang gsos gsos byed nga la thugs la 'dogs par zhu byas pas/ nyid kyi shig blangs pa ma yin nga rang la yod pa yin gsungs nas ma gnang / de nas zhag 'ga' na thams cad yal nas song zhes thos so/ /yang grwa yang dben pa'i mkhan po 'dis/ lo gnyis gsum dngul chur —129—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/bzhugs pas/ lan cig khong na nas mgo bo dang snying kha la gzer chen po skyes te/ zug bzod thabs med pa yod pa'i skabs su nye gnas nyul ba la byon pa la/na bza' chos gos cig yod pa yang 'bul bar skur zug gzer yod tshul yang bshad de/ nye gnas drung du bzhud nas dum pa lon pa'i dus su zug zer thams cad gar song cha med la song bas/ rje rin po ches nga'i na tsha rnams blangs pa yin nges par 'dug zer zhing nges shes skyes nas dad gus thun mong ma yin pa tshud 'dug cing / sems dpa' chen po'i gsung na re/ gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dngos su len pa 'di kun snying rje'i bsam pa drag pos blang na ngo shes pa nyams su myong bas grub pa la gsung zhing gzhan gyi na tsha la sogs la gtong len gyi dmigs pa byas tsa na khams nyog por 'gro yin 'dug gsungs/bla ma gdan 'dren gyi gser yig pa dad pa dben shri byung ba'i res/sems dpa' chen po rang la yang gong du gdan 'dren pa'i mjal sa yod ma zer ba yang 'dug sang gser yig pas sleb yong ba yod zer ba'i bya nam byed na byung bas rang re la gdan 'dren med mchi ste/ so mi bsod pa zhig yong pa yod pa bden mchi gsungs/ gal te gdan 'dren yod kyang rang res 'khyus pas nye 'khor rnams la/ mi bde ba yongs gsungs nas 'byon du ma gnang / sang hor gyis sleb byung nas sa skyar gdan drangs pa'i phyag phyi la bdag gis kyang phyin pas/ sa skya'i rgyab der dro 'debs pa'i sar khyi rgad po cig byung ba la hor gyi 'bar bor ches rdo cig brgyab pa la skad ngan cher po shor bas/ sems dpa' chen po rang la brgyab pa bzhin du a gsungs nas dkar yol 'chor la khad —130—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/byung zhing spyan chab mang po bton/ de nas sa skyar byon nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang skye bo'i tshogs chen po la/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos gsung nas/'gro ba dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad do/ /gser yig pas tshong 'dus na mar gdan drangs pa'i dus/ hor kyi g.yog po gsum la nag chen po thug nas bsod du byung ba la gsung byon pas srog las thar bar mdzad/ sku zhang gis rtsis kyi rten 'brel la dben shri'i gdan gyi 'og rang gi gzugs/ rang gri dang rang thag 'ong bcug pas dben shris mthong nas rtsa ra chen po byed pa la byung ba la yang gsung byon pa tsam gyis grol bar byas te/rin spungs bar byon nas dbus su 'byon ma dgongs par yar byon te/ zha lur gdan drangs dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang skye bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa la chos kyi sbyin pa mdzad/de dus mkhan chen bu ston pa bsnyungs nas grongs la khad pa 'dug pa la mjal te/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs nas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don la zhugs pa'i rten 'brel dang bdag gzhan brje ba'i dmigs pa mdzad pas de'i nub mo nas sku bskyed byung nas bsnyung ba dngas te/de dus bla ma rgyal sras pas mkhan po'i snyung nad blangs zer ba'i grags pa chen po yang byung zhing mkhan po'i zhabs btegs pa zhig gi rmi lam du mdang drung pa la/ bla ma rgyal sras pa sku lus shel dkar ltar dngas par gyur pa gser gyi dbu rgyan gsol nas dbang bskur mdzad pa rmis lags zhus pas/ rmi lam bzang po yin nga yang mdang khams bde zhing rig pa dngas pa zhig byung gsungs —131—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/nas mnyes 'dug zer/ de la sogs pa'i rnam grangs mang po yod do/ /yi ge mang pas 'jigs nas ma bris so/ /'gro kun pha mar shes nas sems rgyud snying rjes brlan/ /bdag la gces 'dzin spangs nas gzhan skyon bdag la len/ /'gro la phan sems skyed nas bde dge gzhan la gtong / /kun rdzob byang sems sgoms la dgos pa'i chos gsum yin/ /zhes kyang gsung ngo / /bdag gzhan 'khor 'das nam mkha'i dbyings bzhin du/ /bdag gzhan gnyis su med pa'i don rtogs kyang / /bdag la gzhan gyi sdug bsngal len byed cing / /bdag gi bde dge gzhan la gtong bar mtshar/ /mi 'dod pa'i chos bzhi lam du 'khyer ba la dang por ma rnyed pa lam du 'khyer ba'i phyag len ston pa ni/su dag 'dod che+on dbang gi+os bdag gi nor/ /thams cad 'phrag gam 'phrag tu 'jug na yang / /lus dang longs spyod dus gsum dge ba rnams/ /de la bsngo ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ /—132—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len ston te/ de yang 'di ltar thos te/ bshad nyan mdzad pa'i dus su/ 'jam dpal dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan pas chos zhu ba la sa skyar gdan drangs nas chosakyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor te/ tshur byon dus la tshas nag por jag pa byung ste/ sems dpa' chen po rang gi sku la ma reg zhabs tog pa rnams 'ol le ba re bkyigs te jag pa za ma za dus zhabs tog pa zhig bkyig pa grol byung ba'i tsa na/ jag pa'i ral gri zhig bzhag 'dug pa khyer nas bros na bsam yin yod tsa na/ sems dpa' chen pos mkhyen nas ston pa blo rtsab rtsob ma byed ang gsungs nas/ 'brosam nus zer/ dngos po rnams rin chen sgang pa'i sa char ma 'khyer/ ngas blos btang yod pas 'phrogs pa yin snyam pa'i blo yang ma byed/ nga'i go lag khyer na yang khyer gsungs pas jag pas phyag 'tshal nas nged tsho la/ phongs nas thabs rdugs pas nyid lta bu zhig dang thug zer yin 'dug zer/ jag pa rnams rjes zlos byed du bcug pas bsngo ba yang mdzad ces thos cing /nor la chags pa'am bdag la sdang ba yis/ /bdag gi bdog kun 'phrogs nas nyin cig tsam/ /'tsho ba'i zas tsam med pa'i skabs byung na/ /de tshe dam bca' 'di ni dran par bgyi/ /zhes gnod lan du phan 'dogs par dam bcas pa ltar mdzad do/ /dus phyis sems dpa' chen po'i gsung na re/ dbusga pa'i dmag mang po mthong ba des/dpon chen byang pa 'dis 'o skol la choso 'brel ma byas pa'i gong du brtson sdug —133—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/ge zhig mi gsod pa'i zhu ba byas kyang ma 'grub pa de gnyis lo mang po'i bar du dge sbyor gyi bskul ma byas/ de bar la dge sbyor gang byed kyang de rnams dang /dbus pa'i dmag sngon ma rang re dngul chu ba 'joms mi de rnams kyi don du bsngos/ smon lam rnam dag btab yod de e phan ni mi shes gsungs/sems dpa' 'di yi longs spyod gzhan bdag gis/ /'dod chen dbang gis 'phrogs par 'gyur pa'i tshe/ /byams pa'i gzhu brdungs dge ba'i mda' 'phen zhing / /snying rje'i dpung gis de yi sdig sdug rnams/ /thams cod phrogs nas sems dpa' khyed nyid ni/ /rab tu khras nas gnad lan 'jal ba 'dra/ /sdug bsngal lam du 'khyer ba'i phyag len ston par byed pa ni/bdag la nyes pa cung zad med bzhin du/ /gang dag bdag gi mgo bo gcod byed na'ang / /snying rje'i dbang gis de'i sdig pa rnams/ /bdag la len pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab ste/ de yang 'di ltar thos so/ /bshad nyan mdzad pa'i tshe/ 'jam dpal dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan pa sku —134—

rgyal srasarin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/mched kyis bo dong du chos gsung ba'i dus/ rgya sgo lam 'gag na shig nad tshabs can byung ba'i sprang rgan lus kyi zungs shor ba gos dang stan la sogs pa shig gi phung por gyur pa cig 'dug pas de la drung sku mched pa'i skya bo tshos drung nas skyug bro 'gag der ma bsdad zer zhing 'bud pa gzigs pas/ snying rje drag tu skyes nas sbyan chab shor te/ de'i nub mo kho'i gos dang stan shig gi phung por gyur pa ltar nang du khyer/ sprang po la nam bza' gcig gnyis/ bza' rgyu gnang nas shig rnams la sku lus sbyin par btang ste/ shig gi phung po'i gseb tu gzims nas zhag gcig gnyis song ba dang / slob dpon dang mched grogs gcig gnyis kyis tshor nas ltar byon pas/ sprang po'i gos dang / stan shig gi phung po rnams gsol/ sku lus thams cad 'brum pa thug po byung ba bzhin song 'dug par mthong bas/ khong rnam pa ha las te/ nyid da rung lus gtong ba'i dus tsam la ma sleb las che/ de 'dra rang ha cang thal drags mi mdzad pa zhus pas/bdag gis lus can thams cad la/ /lus 'di ci+o bder byino zin gyis/ /rtag tu gsad dam dmad pa'am/ /brdeg sogs ci dga' byed la rag /ces dang / 'gro mang rdog pas bdag gi spyir 'tshog gam/ /'gums kyi mi gsod 'jig rten mgon dgyes mdzod/ /gsungs nas ma gsan pa dang / khong rnams pas 'jam dpal dbyangs don yod pa'i drung du phyin te 'di bzhin mdzad —135—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/yin gda'/ nged tshos zhu ba byas kyong 'di skad gsungs nas mi gsan par 'dug /drung nas gsung 'byan dgasapar gda' zhus pas/ 'jam dpal dbyangs don yod pas kyang de ma thag byon te/ de lta bu rang mi mdzad par zhu ha cang 'o rgyal drags tsam 'gyur kyang mi shes zhus pa la yang /lus tsam gyis kyang gzhan la phan thogs par/ /nam zhig 'gyur ces bdag gi gang bsam pa/ /smon lam de ni 'bras bu yod par bya zhes dang / /gzhan la mi phan sred zad bde ba yang / /dmyal ba'i me ltar mthong nas rab spongs zhing / /gzhan la phan na mnar med me nang du/ /rab dga' 'jug pa rnams kyis rjes su slob/ /gsungs te ma gsan par gsos pas ring por ma thogs par shig rnams yal nas song zhes grag go /de dus ha cang so tsha drags nas ma zug pa'i dus su/stod kyi cha la dar res dum re dkris kyin bzhag gsungs/gang zhig khro dang nga rgyal dbang gyur na/ /bdag gi lus la rma srol cher gtod de/ /'chi bar nges pa'i gnas skabs byung gyur na'ang / /de tshe dam bca' 'di ni dran par gyis/ / zhes dam bca' ba bzhin ni mdzad do/ /yang bo dong du sprang phrug zhig nad byung ba —136—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/zhig gi shig thams cad blangs pas/ sems dpa' chen po'i sku lus la 'phungs nas zhag gcig la shi 'dug zer/ sems dpa' chen po la brten nas de sa gnas gong ma zhig tu 'phos nges bsam pa 'byung ngo / /gzhan yang bo dong dang dngul chu gnyis su sprang po shig nad byung ba mang po'i shig blangs te/ nyung por yal gin song zhes grag go /dus phyis 'phan yul glang thang ba yin pa'i ston sgom byang chub sems dpa' chos mchog bya ba la khong rang la shig nad byung ba'i steng du gzhan gyi shig nad kyang blangs te sems can la lus dngos su sbyin pa btang nas gshegs pa'i de ma thag la bdag gis thugs dam la 'dogs par zhu ba'i 'phan chas khyer nas nye gnas la 'di ltar zhus byas pas nye gnas drung du song nas log byung ba la/ ci gsung byas pas/ go rjes su yi rang shākya thub pa rus sbal sku zhabrungs pa'i dus srin bu ke ta ka brgyad khri la sku lur+sā sbyin par btang ba dang / don gyis cha mthun pa de yin khong gi sems la 'gyod pa yod pa'i rigs su mi 'dug ngo mtshar che/ 'o skol blo sbyong pa yin pas/ da shig de tsam zhig 'chir 'jug pa snying rje/ yar long la shog gsungs yin 'dug /drung nas sku nas bgres pa dang shig tshan ches drags pas ci 'gyur mi shes zhus kyang mi gsan par long shog gsungs/ da sngar nyid cag shig nad byung ba gso ba byas pa drag zer la/ slob dpon yon tan 'od dang / dge slong lha bzang /dkon mchog rin chen/ nam mkha' bzang po/ bdag cag rnams kyis gso lo bgyis pas drung du yang zhu ba 'grub bo/ /de la sogs pa'i rnam grangs mang po yod de mang dogs pas ma bris so/ /—137—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/lhun po'i ngogs la bya tshogs babs pa bzhin/ /srab 'jam gser mdog 'dra ba'i sku lus la/ /ru mtshon rnon po'i mchu rnams ltar zug nas/ /'bum phrag du ma'i shig gi khrag 'thung tshe/ /mtshon gyi phug pa'i zug tsam 'byung na yang / /bdag nyid sdug kyang 'gro la phan gyur na/ /pad mos brgyan pa'i mtsho ru ngang pa ltar/ /dmyal me'i nang du'ang dges pas gshegs la 'dud/ /ma grags pa lam du 'khyer ba'i phyag len ston pa ni/'ga' zhig bdag la mi snyan sna tshogs pa/ /stong gsum khyab par sgrog par byed na yang / /byams pa'i sems kyis slar yang de nyid kyi/ /yon tan brjod pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab ste/ sems dpa' chen po 'dis ni thams cad thams cad kyi/ yon tan 'ba' zhig nas brjod kyi/ gzhan gyi skyon nas brjod pa lan cig kyang ma mthong zhing ma thos la/—138—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/gang zhig thos na bdag la 'gro kun gyis/ /khre+ol bar gyur pa'i grags ngano mi zad par/ /phyags bcur bsgrags pa mthang thas dran gyur na/ /de tshe dam bca' 'di ni dran par bgyid/ /ces gsungs shing / 'ga' zhig gis la la la 'phyas mos btang tsa na/ nā ro pas te lo pa nya bsha' ba la sogs pa mthong ba dang sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis 'jam dpal gshin rje khyim btsun nyo chang byed par mthong ba la sogs pa'i gtam rgyud gsungs nas/ 'o skol rang blo ma dag pa yin kho kun ci 'dra yin mi shes/ lar yang 'o skol gyis mi la skyon brjod mang po byas na 'o skol la yang thams cad kyi tshur 'thab pa zhig rten 'brel la cis kyang yong gsung / de shin tu mad par sems dpa' chen po'i yon tan 'ba' zhig brjod cing / skyes bu dam pa kun gyis kyang bstod bskur bsngags gsum 'ba' zhig mdzad pa'i tshul 'di ltar thos so ste/ dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa'i gsung na re/thog mar shes bya kun la mkhas par bya/ /bar du mkhas pa'i tshogs su legs par bshad/ /tha mar 'dris pa'i don la brtson pas bsgom/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi bzhed gzhung yin/ /zhes sa skya paṇa ṭi tas gsungs pa de/ gu ru thogs med khong gis byas pa yin/'o skol chos pa rnams kyi nang na chos byed pa ta mang rab 'dug te brtan pa thob pa du tsam bdog pa/ gzhan gyi ni nga la rgyus med brtan pa thob ngos shes pa gu ru —139—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin gyi gsung skor/thogs med khong yin/ pho skyes pa spam zer na de kun la zer ba lags/ mi gzhan gyis nga'i rgyud tshod sleb pa la da rung dka' las chen po yod/ ngas gu ru thogs med kyi rgyud tshod sleb pa la bskal ba mang por tshogs gsog dgos/ nga khong gi bla ma yin khong nga'i slob ma yin te/ nga'i bla ma zhig las kyang de la mos/mi rgan nam 'chi ba'i sngas kha der gu ru thogs med yod pa zhig byung na dga' ste/nga phyogs thams cad du rgyug khong pa gcig tu bzhugs pa 'dis yid smon thog tu e 'bab mi shes zhes gsung zer zhing / gsung yig snyan ngag dang bcas pa bskur ba'i nang na yang /khyod la nga 'dra'i slob dpon brgya yod kyang / /nga la khyod 'dra'i slob ma khyod las med/ /ces sogs kyis bstod pa mang po yang 'dug go /kun mkhyen rong pa'i gsung na re/ nga la pha bas lhag pa'i bu gcig yod pa yin/ nga'i slob ma 'di 'dra gzhan na yod na smon ne 'chor/ skyes bu dam pa 'di 'dra 'jig rten na dkon gsung zer/ bla ma rin ye ba bla ma yin kyang / sems dpa' chen po'i mtshan nas brjod tsam na phyag thal mo sbyor spyan chab 'don zer ro/ /slob dpon yon tan 'od kyis chos rje kun mkhyen pa la mjal du phyin dus/ khyed dngul chu ba bla ma'i skal ba rgyal/ rgyal sras pa de ming don mthun pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po yin/ khor mdzad spyod rnam par dag pa 'phrin las rgya chen po can des grub mtha' de 'o skol 'dod pa de bzhin mdzad na lta spyod phun sum tshogs pa yong ba gda' ste/ khong yang lta ba rang snga rabs pa —140—

rgyal srasarin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/la zhen che ba 'dra/ khong dang lta ba 'di'i chos kyi 'brel gtam zhig las ci bya bsam pa yin te/ ngas lan cig dngul chur phyin pas kyang khong mtshams dam po la bzhugs 'dug pas ma mjal/ dri ba 'ga' zhig bskur bas kyang ngas ci yang mi shes zer ba'i lan gcig las ma byung / da rung khong dang cig 'phrad dgos/ gang ltar lags kyang rgyal sras de mtshungs pa med pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yin/ 'di nas 'phos ma thag byams mgon gyi drung du zang thal le 'gro rgyu de yin/ de'i rgyu thams cad kho la tshang ba yin gsungs zer / yang rta nag tu byon pa cig la/ dngul chu'i thad kyi sprin la phyag btsugs nas der 'dus pa rnams la pha gi'i 'og nas sangs rgyas mi'i gzugs su bzhugs pa cig yod pa yin e shes gsung zer/ dpal ldan sa skya'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'jam sgeg gi gsung na re/ dbus gtsang gnyis po 'di na mthong thos dran pa la dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po 'dug ste/ gzhan su bas kyang bo dong thogs med de smon/ nga yang tshe gzhug la sgom cig zhu rgyu byung na bo dong thogs med de la sgom cig zhu/ khongs mtshams dam po cig yod par 'dug pas/ rten 'brel ma 'grig na nga rang gi slob ma rdor gzhon la sgom cig zhu/ de gnyis min pa'i bla ma dang sgom su la'ang yid mi smon gsungs/ bla ma mnyam med pa khong rang gi slob ma sgom la 'gro ba rnams la/ khyod tshe 'di dang 'dra 'dres kyi chos shig byed na bla ma 'di dang 'di'i rtsar rgyug sa med rdul med kyi chos shig byed na bo dong thogs med de'i rtsar rgyug dang da lta de las lhag pa med do gsung pa 'dug zer zhing mkhan chen bu ston pas kyang /—141—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/sde snod gsum gyi don la mkhas gyur cing / /rgyud sde zab mo'i rtogs pa kun chub pas/ /byang chub sems gnyis 'byong pa rgyal ba'i sras/ /zhes sogs kyi bstod pa yang mdzad cing / sems dpa' chen pos zhal lur byon pa'i res/ kho rang gi grwa pa rnams la/ da lta bod gangs can gyi khrod na chos shes nas nyams su blang ngo shes pa rgyal sras thogs med pa tsam yin/ ngas kyang chos shes pa shes te kun mkhyen 'phags 'od kyi gsung zhig la brten nas bshad nyan byed dgos pa byung bas/ khong gi 'dra ba'i nyams len byung ba med/ 'di lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po la chos 'brel thos pa tsam res kyang 'khor ba mtha' can du 'gyur ro shes pa yin pas/ mtshams la yod pa rnams kyang /kho la chos zhus/ de bar gyi zhabs tog thams cad bla brang nas byed pa yin gsungs zer/ de'i res sems dpa' chen pos kyang / zla ba gcig zha lur bzhugs nas gang la gang 'dod kyi chos gsungs nas 'gro ba dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad ces grag go /de la sogs pa'i skyes bu dam pa kun gyis bsngags pa brjod pa'i rnam grangs mang po thos so/ /yi ge mang bas 'jigs nas ma bris so/ /chags sdang dbang gis gzhan dag gi /skyon brjod tshig gi 'phreng ba dang / /phan tshun 'phros pa gyur pa bzhin/ /nam yang lhan cig mi gnas pa / /—142—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/skyeso bu dam pa thams cad kyi/ /bstad dang bkur dang bsngags pa gsum/ /snyan pa'i tshig gis bos pa bzhin/ /khyod la rab tu 'dus pa mtshar/ /dmod pa lam du 'khyer ba'i phyag len ston pa ni/'gro mang 'dus pa'i dbus su 'ga' zhig gis/ /mtshang nas 'bru zhing tshig ngan smra na yang / /de la dge ba'i bshes kyis 'du shes kyi/ /gus par 'dud pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab ste/ 'di ltar sems dpa' chen po'i gsung na re gzhan dag gis rang re'i chos rgyud dang bla ma dang rang la smod sa byung ba'i dus su mad lags byas pas/ de kas dzig ske yang chad nas phan tshun rgyud sreg res yang mi yong / rang re bzod ldan du yang 'gro ba yin gsungs nas dam bca' yang 'di ltar mdzad de/'gro mang dbus su sdang yid ldan pa'i mis/ /tshig ngan bzod par dka' ba dma' phab nas/ /—143—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/gdong pa 'degs pa'i skabs kyang med byas na/ /de tshe dam bca' 'di ni dran par bgyi/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dngul chu ba'i bya bral ba 'u re ba gcig gis jo mo nang du grub mtha'i gleng mo byed pa 'ga' zhig gi gseb tu byin pas/ la la na re/ bla ma rgyal sras pa de kun grub mtha' dang gang gis yang phyogs zhen mi mdzad par thams cad la dag snang sbyor ba gcig yod pa 'dug zer ba dang / gcig na re/mkhan chen bu ston pa de yang mkhas pa yin pa la nges don 'di ma go /rgyal sras pa'i de yang shes nas btang snyoms su 'jog pa de rang min las che zer ba la khos rtsod pa byas pa'i gleng mo drung du byung bas sems dpa' chen po'i gsung na re/ khos ma shes par 'dug mad lags zer rgyu yin te/ kun mkhyen pa'i grub mtha' 'di ni mdo rgyud mang po na bshad/ rgya gar nas kyis grub mtha' rnying pa yin pas rang res nor bar ma shes/ mkhan bu ston pa'i grub mtha' 'di yang ni/ khong cig pu'i ma yin/ mdo rgyud phal mo che thams cad dang / rgya bod kyi mkhas grub phal che ba thams cad kyi dgongs pa yin pas de bas kyang 'o skol gyis nor bar ma shes khong bden gsungs/chos dang chos min blang dor dgag sgrub rnams/ /legs par 'byed pa'i mkhyen gnyis dang ldan kyang / /dag snang chen pos chos dang gang zag la/ /phyogs med ris med mnyam nyid mdzad pa mtshar/ /—1slo—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/bzod dka' gonyis lam du 'khye+or ba'i phyag len stan pa las dang pa ni/bdag gi bu bzhin gces par bskyangs pa'i mi/ /bdag la dgra bzhin lta bar byed na yang / /nad kyi btab pa'i bu la ma bzhin du/ /lhag par brtse ba rgyal sras lag len yin/zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab ste/ de la 'di ltar bstan pa dang sems can spyi mthun la gnod pa chen po byed pa de 'dra rnams la 'ga' zhig gis 'di lta bu kun ha cang mi rig drags 'dug zer nas zhe sdang sgom pa gzigs tsa na/ ha cang mi rig pa byas tsa na de ka snying rje ba yin gsungs nas de lta bu'i rnams la lhag par yang brtse bar mdzad cing 'di ltar gsung ngo / /bdag gam bdag gi phyogs la gnod byed dam/ /bstan dang 'gro ba yongs la gnod byed pa'i/ /ma rung skye bo'i mthong thos dran gyur na/ /lhag par snying rje'i gnas su shes byas nas/ /rnyed bkur snyan smras sogs kyi dngos su phan/ /gdags par nus na gdags shing mi nus na'ang / /—145—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/byams dang snying rje drag pos bdag nyid kyi/ /bde dge ci yod de don bsngo ba gces/ /zhes gsung ngo / /bzod dka' gnyis pa ni/rang dang mnyam pa'am dman pa'i skye bo yis/ /nga rgyal dbang gis brnyas thabs byed na yang / /bla ma bzhin du gus pas bdag nyid kyi/ /spyi bor len pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab ste/ de yang 'di ltar gsung ngo / /rang re la gzhan gyis dngos su brnyas pa dang tshig ngan smras pa'i/ de'i lan ma byas na pha rol po yang zhe sdang mi skye zhing / rang re yang skyon med kyi skyes bu bzod ldan du 'gro ba yin/ gzhan gyis mi rig pa byas rang res kyang de'i lan byas tsa na gnyis ka skyon can du 'gro ba yin gsungs shing / dam bca' yang mdzad de/bdag la nyes pa yod dam med kyang rung / /mtho dman mnyam pa su yang rung ba yi/ /gnod pa'i rnam pa che chung ci byas kyang / /de tshe dam bca' 'di ni dran par bgyi/ /zhes gsung ngo / / zhe sdang drag pos gang zag gzhan dag gis/ /—146—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/gnod pa byed na'ang lan du phan 'dogs na/ / snying rje can gyi sems dpa' khyed nyid ni/ /sems can gzhan la brtse ba smos ci 'tshal /'byor rgud gnyis lam du 'khyer ba'i phyag len ston pa las dang po rgud pa lam du khyer ba'i phyag len ni/'tsho bas 'phongs shing rtag tu mi yis brnyas/ /tshabs chen nad dang gdon gyi btab kyang slar/ /'gro kun sdig sdug bdag la len byed cing / /zhum pa med pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab ste/ sems dpa' chen po'i gsung na re/ dus phyis bsnyung ba'i dus su/ na ba'i rkyen gyis rmi lam sor chud cing dge sbyor 'phel du song gsung zer cing 'di ltar gsung ngo / /nad gdon chom kun dgra sogs dam chos kyi/ /bar chad yin zhes grags kyang rang gi blo/ /las su rung na de kun grogs su 'gyur/ /blo ngan 'di ni dam chos gegs gsung nges/ /zhes pa dang /—147—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/'byor pa med na med de dga'/ /bsrung bsral gyi bya brel de la len/ /'thab rtsod kyi khro 'khrug ji rnyed pa/ /'dzin chags kyi nor las byung bar nges/ /ceXs sogs gan+da/ngas so/ /gnyis pa 'byor pa lam du 'byer ba'i phyag len ni/snyan par grags shing 'gro mang spyi bos 'dud/ /rnam thos bu yi nor 'dra thob gyur kyang / /srid pa'i dpal 'byor snying po med shes na/ /khengs pa med pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab ste/ de yang 'di ltar sa'i steng na 'gran gyi do zla thams cad bral ba'i sems dpa' chen po 'di'i snyan pa'i dri bsung grags pa'i dri gzhon gyis sa'i steng thams cad khyab par byas pas/ rgya nag po'i yul nas kyang stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po chen po dang /rgyal bu chen po tang thal rtse dang / rgya gar dang ba yul dang ya rtse dang / mnga' ris la sogs pa'i rgyal phran thams cad kyis kyang mos gus chen pos shākya thub pa'i rgyal tshab bstan pa'i bdag po bo dong thogs med ces sogs kyis bstod —148—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/pa gdams pa bskur bar zhu zhes pa'i 'phrin yig 'bul ba dang bcas pa rim par bskur zhing dad pa chen pos spyi bos gtsug tu bsgom par byed pa dang /dngos su mi chen gyi rigs 'dug pa la yang / 'jam dpal dbyangs chen po don yod rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ ti shrī chen po bsod nams blo gros sku mched ta dben kun dga' rin chen dpal rgyal mtshan bzang po/ ta dben kun dga' legs pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la sogs pa'i dpal ldan sa skya ba'i gdung rgyud rnams dang /mkhan thams cad mkhyen pa byang chub rtse mo dang / mkhas btsun dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub chen po khyung ba/ dbus phyogs kyi yang phag gru rin chen/ stag lung rin po che / rgya ma rin po che/ mtshal pa'i sgom sde rin po che la sogs mdor na dbus gtsang gnyis kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms pa phal che ba slob mar 'dus shing / gzhan yang dbusagatsang gi ta dben grub shri si tu dpon chen du dben sha la sogs kyi las kha 'dzin pa'i mi chen thams cad kyis kyang spyi bo'i gtsug tu bkur zhing / yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che ltar dgos 'dod kyi longs spyod thams cad rtsol med du 'byung / 'das ma 'ongs thams cad mkhyen pa'i mngon par shes pa thogs med mnga'/ yi dam gyi lha ston nam dngas pa'i skar tshogs tsam gzigs/ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i don la dbang 'byor kyang / thugs la rlom pa dang khengs pa rdul tsam yang mi mnga' ste/rang gi nye du'i bkur bsti rab spangs nas/ /—149—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/gzhan gyi bkur bsti 'dod na blos btang nyams/ /de phyi gang du su dang 'grogs kyang rung / /mtho dman 'bring gsum spyi bor 'khur ba gces/ /gsung zhing 'di ltar gsung ste/ 'o skol chos pa rnams la yang mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan gang yod kyang / des rang mchog tu 'dzin cing nga rgyal gyis rang las dma' ba la brnyas bcos mnyam pa la 'gran sems/ mtho ba la phrag dog byed na chos gnad du ma song ba yin/ dper na sman gyis nad skyed pa'am/ 'dre shar nas gnod pa la glud nub sgor skyel ba dang 'dra/ des na yon tan du sangs rgyas thob kyang spros bral du shes dgos/ 'gran sangs rgyas tshugs zer bas 'dug ste de dang 'di gnyis dpe mi gcig gsungs/ sgom chen pa thos pa chung nge ba'i rigs nyams cung zad kyis nga rgyal chen po byed pa de 'dra gzigs tsa na/ dmigs su bkar nas mi gsungs kyang chos gsung ba'i bgros la/ sgom chen pa ci rigs shig nyams len tsam re skyes tsa na des ci 'tshengs cha med par nga rgyal rtsa ba'i nyon mongs drug gi nang nas che shos de rgyas par byas nas/ blar btsog tu song ba de 'dra yong gin 'dug gsungs/rang nyid dben par gnas pa'i rlom sems kyis/ /gzhan dag khyad gsod bdud kyi las yin pas/ /'du 'dzi spangs dang yon tan skye sogs kyi/ /rlom sems spong ba bstan pa la gces so/ /gsung nga / /—150—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/shin tu dbul kyang zhum pa'i sems dang bral/ /snyan pa'i grags pas 'dzam gling khyab gyur cing / /chen po rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu bzhin/ /gus pas mchod kyang khengs pa bral ba mtshar/ /chags sdang gnyis lam du 'khyer ba'i phyag len ston pa las dang po dgra rang rgyud 'dul ba'i phyag len ston pa ni/rang gi zhe sdang dgra bo ma thul na/ /phyi rol dgra bo btul zhing 'phel bar 'gyur/ /de phyir byams dang snying rje'i dmag dpung gis/ /rang rgyud 'dul ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab ste/ de yang 'di ltar sems dpa' chen po 'dis ni rang gi sems thul ba'i stobs kyis/ sems can ma rung shing dmu rgod pa khro zhing gtum pa rnams kyang sku mthong ba dang gsung thos pa'i tshe rang bzhin gyis dul bar 'gyur te/ gong du bstan pa'i dngul chur dmag byung dus bzhin no/ /sems dpa' chen po'i gsung na re/ chos gcig gi de bzhin nyid mngon gsum du mthong ba bzhin du/ sngon la rang re'i sems 'di legs po cig thul na gzhan gyi sems kyab ngang gi dul ba cig yong gsungs/ de'i shes byed la/—151—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/sems 'di gcig pu btags pa yis/ /de dag thams cad btags par 'gyur/ /sems 'di gcig pu btul bas na/ /de dag thams cad btul bar 'gyur/ /zhes sogs dang /sems can mi badzo/na nam mkha' bzhin/ /de dag gzhom gyis yong mi lang / /khro ba'i sems 'di gcig choms na/ /dgra de thams cad choms dang 'dra/ /sa steng 'di dag kos g.yog tu/ /de rnyed ko bas ga la lang / /lham mthil tsam gyis ko bas ni/ /sa steng thams cad g.yogs dang 'dra/ /zhes sogs dang /rang rgyud gyong po thul na dpa' bo'i mthar thug yin/ /khong khro'i dgra bo thul na rgyal ba'i mthar thug yin//zhes gsung ngo / /—152—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/gnyis pa 'dod yon la sred pa spong ba'i phyag len ston pa ni/'dod pa'i yon tan lan tshwa'i chu dang 'dra/ /ji tsam spyad cing srid pa 'phel bar 'gyur/ /gang la zhen chags skye ba'i dngos po rnams/ /'phral la spong ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len btabs ste/ de yang 'di ltar 'dod yon la sred pa chung bas/ gsol kun gang drangs kyang zhim pa dang mi zhim pa'i zhal nyod mi mdzad par gang drangs pa la gsol bas/ gzhan gyis bkur ba dang zhabs tog sla zhing 'di ltar yang gsung ngo / /chu rgya mtsho che la 'phyo ba'i nya/ /rkan lcags kyu rnon pos phug pa de/ /rang zas la sred pa ches bas lan/ /sred zhen gyi zas la ma rgyugs na/ /lcags kyus yas rkan 'bugs don med/ /yul mthun rkyen gyis 'khor bar 'dzin pa 'di/ /rang 'dod yon la sred pa che bas lan/ /—153—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/'dod yon gyi sred pa spangs tsa na/ /yul mthun rkyen lam gyi grogs su 'char/ /'dod yon spyod kyang zhen med shin tu gces/ /gsungs pa dang / 'o skol dang po grwa pa'i dus na dngos po gsog pa'i blo ma skyes pas 'phral lto skyid pa cig byung gsungs/ sems dpa' chen po rang gi mched grogs bla ma nam rdor ba bya ba na re/ nged grwa tshang yang gcig 'grogs yun ring rgyus che ste/ dang po rang nas snying rje che/ ma nus pa dang bkres pa mthong tsa na gsol 'phro bcad nas gnang gin yod/ 'dzin chags chung nas khal re tsam las med kyang 'di zad tsa na 'khos pa gcig 'char gsungs nas 'tshol phro dang 'dod mthun mi mdzad cing / da nang las gsol rgyu med kyang blo la las mi mdzad thugs bde mor gnas pa cig yod gsungs/rang sems thul bas gzhan sems rang gi thul/ /gzhan gyi don du 'dod yon spyad gyur kyang / /zhen chags mi mnga' chags sdang rang sar grol/ /sems dpa' khyod ni 'dam skyes pad mo 'dra/ /—154—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/don dam byang chub kyi sems ston pa las dang po mnyam bzhag tu spros bral la 'dzin med sgom pa'i phyag len ston pa ni/sna tshogs snang ba 'di dag rang gi sems/ /sems nyid gdod nas spros pa'i mtha' dang bral/ /de nyid shes nas gzung 'dzin mtshan ma rnams/ /yid la mi byed rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab te/ de yang 'di ltar skye ba dpag tu med pa'i gong rol nas/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid sgom pa la goms pa'i phyir dang / sku tshe 'dir yang ting nge 'dzin gyi bogs dbyung pa'i phyir dben pa 'ba' zhig bsten pa'i stobs kyis/ phra rags rtog pa'i 'gyu ba chad nas gzung 'dzin mtshan ma dbyings su dag te/ sems chos sku lus 'ja' lus su gyur te/ ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag bya dang 'jog byed ting nge 'dzin rang gi ngo bo yang mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i ye shes chen po la dbang 'byor bas/ mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob la khyad med/ nyin mo dang mtshan mo la khyad med/ mtshan bcas dang mtshan med la khyad med par dper na tshong pa gser gling phyin pa bzhin du/ snang tshad 'od gsal gyi rang bzhin/ gang shar chos kyi sku'i rol ba/ ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngo bo/ gang shar chos sku'i yo lang du —155—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/spyod cing / chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad g.yo ba med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad rlom sems med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad skyes 'gags med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad ro gcig pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad rang bzhin dmigs su med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma la snyoms par 'jug pa'i tshul rnams ni/ bdag lta bu'i blo'i yul las 'das pa'i phyir brjod par mi nus shing / 'di ltar gsung ste/don dam spros bral rtogs pas mnyam bzhag yo 'gul med/ /kun rdzob sgyu mar shes nas chags sdang 'dzin zhen bral/ /snang stong dbyer med rtogs pas dgag sgrub rang sar grol/ /don dam byang sems sgom la dgos pa'i chos gsum yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dran snang chos skur shar ba yis/ /mtshan bcas byas kyang masnoni ma med/ /sems dpa' khyed kyi mnyam bzhag de/ /tshong pas gser gling phyin pa 'dra/ /—156—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/rjes thob tu chags snang skye ba'i yulo gnyis la bden zhen spang ba'o phyagalen stan pa ni/yid du 'ong ba'i yul dang phrad pa na/ /dbyar gyi dus kyi 'ja' tshon ji bzhin du/ /mdzes par snang yang bden pa med lta zhing / /zhen chags spong ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ / sdug bsngal sna tshogs rmi lam bu shi ltar/ /'khrul snang bden par bzung bas a thang chad/ /de phyir mi mthun rkyen dang 'phrad pa'i tshe/ /'khrul bar lta ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab te/ de yang 'di ltar thos so/ /dus lan cig sa skyar 'khrug pa byung nas 'jam dpal dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan pa sku mched dbus phyogs la bros nas 'byon dgos pa byung ba'i dus/ sems dpa' chen po la bla ma rin ye bas nga la ni 'di lta bu yong ba ha cang mi rigs bsam nas zhe sdang dang sems la mi ran pa che rab yong gin 'dug nyid la byung ngam ma byung gsungs pa'i lan du spyir 'jig rten gyi bde sdug dang chags sdang —157—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/sogs phal cher rang gi las snang yin zhing / de yang snang ba bden med rang gi sems/ sems nyid spros bral yin par shes pa'i go ba ra ri cig yod pa 'dis de lta bu la yang chags sdang gi rtog pa ma skyes gsungs zhes thos shing / des na phyi nang gi chos thams cad snang rdo ba'i dus nyid na nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon bzhin du gsal stong du gdod nas zang thal du rtogs pa dang / sems can thams cad la mnyam pa nyid du byams pa'i stobs kyis chags sdang mi mnga' zhing / 'khor dang long spyod dang gnas la sogs pa gang la yang bdag tu 'dzin pa med de/sems dpa' chen po'i gsung na re/ 'o skol gyi chos rdzong nas chos gzhan gyis dngos po khyer kyang ma byin len du mi 'gro ma byin lan du 'gro ba la bdag tu bzung ba zhig dgos pa yin te/ 'o skol gyis bdag tu bzung ba med pa'i phyir gsungs zhing 'di ltar yang gsung ngo / /chos rnams thams cad rang gi sems snang yin/ /sems la bde sdug du mar snang ba 'di/ /sos ka'i dus kyi 'ja' tshon ji bzhin du/ /so sor snang yang bden pa yod min zhing / /sems kyi chos nyid yod med mtha' las 'das/ /zhes gsung ngo / /chags sdang skye ba'i yul rnams kyang / /nam mkha' ji ltar rtag pa yis/ /—158—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/sems dpa' khyed kyi rjes thob des/ /zhen med sgyu ma mkhan po 'dra/ /de lta bas na byang chub kyi sems gnyis thugs la 'khrungs pa'i phan yon bsngags pa la sbyar bar bya'/ /rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer las/byang chub kyi sems gnyis kyi phyag len bstan pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //—159—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/de dag gi bslab bya pha rol tu phyin pa drag la bslab pa ston pa las dang po sbyin pa'i pha rolo tu phyin pa'i phyag len ston pa ni/byang chub 'dad pas lus kyang gtang dgas na/ /phyi rol dngos po rnams la smos ci dgos/ /de phyir lan dang rnam smin mi re ba'i/ /sbyin pa gtong ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab te/ de yang dang por za zing gi sbyin pa btang ba'i tshul ni 'di ltar lho sgo ru nad pa nyam chung yun ring pa na ba bza' rgyu med pa gcig la bsod snyoms mdzad pa'i rtsam pa bong khal cig yod pa byin pas sa steng 'chi ba'i 'dre med par byas zer nas ngu yin 'dug de la snying rje drag po skyes gsungs/ lan cig sa skya na sprang po 'chi la khad cig 'dug pa la/ma shi bar nam la khyis za bar 'dug zer nas sems las 'dug pas/ bya bral ba cig la rngan pa byin nas bsrung du bcug pas/ de'i nub mo shi 'dugasbyin pa de gnyis rgyu chung yang yi+od tshim pa byung gsungaso pas bshad nyan mdzad dus bshad sar bas bshad slang zhus pas nang la 'dang gsungs nas nang du phebs pa dang khyod rang de nas gang dga' ba cig khyer song gsungs pas/ brum rtse bzang po yod pa khyer song gsung pa dang / yang bro pas gnang sbyin zhus pa —160—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/dang / khyo rang 'di nas gang dga' ba cig khyer gsungs pas/ gsol sder khyer song gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang na bza' la sogs pa gang yod gnang zhid /grwa skor ba la sogs la gzhan snang rgyu med na yol ba bla bre nas kyang bregs kyin gnang zhes thos so/ /thengs gcig nyan pa'i gser slong ba byung nas slong du byung pa la gzhan ster rgyu med par chos stan gyi brum rtse cig yod pa byin pas/ slob dpon gyis tshor nas khong tsho la nas khal cig byin nas brum tshe blangs te khyer byon nas stan gcig pu de las med pa gsungs nas 'thab tu byung gsungs/yang rtse gdong du chos bar la byon dus nyi ma dpal bya ba'i cam rtse cig sku slu byas nas khyer ba la kho la sems las chen po 'dug pas/ sems dpa' chen po rang la cam rtse gnyis yod pa'i cig kho la gnang ste/ de dus mkhan chen bsod nams grags pa bo dong du byon pa dgun cig srod tho rangs gnyis ka chos gsan du byon pas/ cam rtse cig las med pa des grang po byung yang slob dpon la g.yar na yong ste/ 'thab tu yong bsam nas g.yar ma nus gsungs/ grwa pa'i dus su rtsam pa ched po med kyang sprang po la sder mas bcus kyin gnang tsa na/ de bzhin mdzad nas nyid rang la gsol rgyu mi yong zhus tsa na nam zad tsa na lta rgyu cig yod gsungs nas/ rang nyid dbul song yang gnas kyi slong ba po'i sems spong mi srid ces thos so/ /dngul chur nye gnas med pa'i shul du gser slong la byang dang ra nas yong ba'i mi gsum tsam cig slong du byung ba la na bza' ber thul cig dang rtsam pa gang yod gnang 'dug zer/ yang sprang po cig slong du byung ba la phrug cam cig rdzun la gnang ba la bzang po ster rgyu yod bzhin du mi ster —161—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/ba dgongs te cam tshe blangs nas ber thul cig gnang bas phyi lo yang snyogs nas slong du byung ba la phyug gi ring 'gag cig gnang gsungs/ yang thengs cig nye gnas med pa'i shul du sprang po cig slong du byung ba la gzhan gnang rgyu med par/ nye gnas na re/ ra lpags kyi sbud pa bzang po zhig yod pa yang gnang byung bas de gnad pos byung zer/ de la sogs pa'i rnam grangs du ma thos te brjod kyi mi lang ngo / mdor na rten mchod na bza' dbu zhwa/ zas nor gang slong yang mi ster mi srid do/ /rang re la dgos ched yod cing rang re la phan par nges na/dbu dang spyan slong yang mi ster ba mi srid do/ /dbul dang nad sogs sdug bsngal gyis nyen dang / /'phongs pas sdig la 0〈cog la de zlog phyir/ /gter mdzod byang sems sbyin pa khyad 'phags yin/ /zhes sogs dang /tshe 'dir lan dang phyi mar rnam smin dang / /re ba med pa'i spyin pa thub pas bsngags/ /zhes gsung ngo / /chos der mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa btang pa'i tshul ni/bde gshegs bstan pa rgyas par bya phyir dang / /'gro la snying rje chen pos kun slangs nas/ /zang zing med pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa mdzod/ /ces pa dang /—162—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/'gro ba 'jigs pas nyen pa mthong gyur na/ /snying rje'i shugs dang thabs la mkhas pa yis/ /'jigs pa bsal nas zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ de yang 'di ltar thabasdo rnga5/ /lo nyi shu rtsa grangs su khor yug tu sku mtshams dam po mdzad pa de grol ba'i rjes shig la/ dngul chur dge 'dun dang skye bo'i tshogs chen po la sems bskyed blo sbyong dang skyes rabs dang byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa gsungs pa'i dus su/ lha'i me tog kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa tsam 'bab ces grag go /yang thengs cig byang chub sems dpa'i spyod 'jug gsungs pa'i dus su me tog char snga ma bzhin du babs pa la/ sems dpa' chen po'i gsung na re/ 'o skol la ni 'di lta bu 'byung ba'i yon tan ci yang med/ chos 'di zab drags pas 'di'i yin mchi gsung ba la/ khams pa chos blo bya bas langs nas phyag 'tshal te/ chos rje rin po che de mi gsung bar zhu chos rang gi yin na/ ngas yang spyod 'jug tshar kha yar bshad de/ me tog gi char nyag ma cig kyang ma babs zhus zer/ de khong gi de yin bsams pa cig byung ngo / /de nas yun ring rab song ba'i skabs cig la gser yig pa dhar me kir ti byung nas bo dong du gdan drangs te dge 'dun dang skye bo'i tshogs rgya mtsho lta bu la chos kyi sbyin pa mdzad de 'gro ba dpag tu med pa smin cing grol bar byas nas yang sku mtshams dam po la bzhugs yod pa'i skabs su chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pas gdan 'dren pa la as phud dben shri byung nas/ sa skyar gdan drangs te/ gong ma'i gnang —163—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/bzhin phul nas/ khyed bla ma'i yang bla mar 'dug khyed kyi bka' bla mas mi gcog pas/ bla ma zhal ta byed pa la 'byon dgos zer nas nan chen po zhus kyang zhal bzhes ma mdzad pa la/ sa skyar gros pas zhu ba byas te da res ma byon na gser yig pa 'di nas mi 'degs par 'dug pas dbus thug ci nas kyang 'byon par zhu zhes zhus pa dang / dben shris nged kyang bla ma gdan ma 'drongs bar la 'dir sdod/ nyin re la sems can brgya re tsam bsod pa 'di snying mi rje ba e yin/ khyed gar bzhugs kyang sems can gyi don las med pa la/ nged hor yang sems can yin yod zer bas/ spyan chab shor te/ nyin gcig gis hor 'degs snganen/ sems can mang po la phan par 'dug dgongs te/ sa skya gros pa dang dben shri 'dzoms pa la zhal bzhes mdzad de/ sa skya ru dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang skye bo'i tshogs khri phrag mang po la chos gsungs nas 'gro ba dpag med pa'i don mdzad ces grag go /de nas dgung lo drug cu re bdun bzhes pa'i dus glang lo zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu drug la bo dong nas btegs te/ dpal sdings dang chu mig dang zha lu la sogs pa rnams su'ang dge 'dun dang skye bo'i tshogs chen po la chos kyi sbyin pa mdzad nas/ mkhan chen bu ston pa dang zhu 'brog par lhan du byon pa'i lam khar mdzo mo gcig yod pa la phyag phyi ba rnams kyis zan mang po byin nas/'brangs drags nas na ba la/ mkhan pas khro bo'i drag sngags la sogs pa bgrangs gyin byin brlabs byas kyang ma phan par mdzo mo shi bas/ sems dpa' chen pos mdzo mo'i spyi bo nas then then mdzad cing nga'i ma rgan de snying rje —164—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/gsungs zhing yun ring bshums pa la mkhan pas bla ma pa dang gshegs par zhu gsungs pa dang / drung pa rdzun la gshegs par zhu/ 'o skol dub pas mi 'gro gsungs nas yun ring po'i bar du bshums shing bzhugs zer/ rjes la mkhan chen pa'i gsungs te/ mdzo mo'i don grub/ dud 'gro cig la de kun las tshogs bsags pa mi yong gsungs zer/ de nas ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis zhu 'brog lha khang nas bsdu ba byas te/ rin spungs phebs pa'i dus/ de nas mi mthong sa na sus kyang zhus pa med par ngur smig gi sgrol ma rang byon bzhugs sa de ri 'di'i mdun na bdog gam gsungs nas mkhyen byung zer/ de nas si tu byang rgyal bas rdzong rnams su rim pa bzhin rgyu zhabs tog byas nas/ dbus kyi sa cha bsam yas la nyin lam gnyis tsam yod pa'i la ka cig tu phebs pa dang /sprin dkar po cig la tshad btsugs nas pha gi'i thad na gang yod gsungs pa la/sa sna ba cig na re/ pha gi'i thad na bsam yas yod zer bas de'i tshod cig 'dug ngo mtshar che/ gsungs pa la slob dpon yon tan 'od kyis ci gda' lags zhus pas/ rgyu mtshan 'dra brda'i gsungs zer/ de na si tu byang rgyal gyis yar lung sne gdong du spyan drangs te/ gus pa chen pos ni bkur/ sgo mang pos ni zhabs tog byas/ gtsug gi nor bu lta bur ni mchod nas/ sne gdong dang khra 'brug dang / rtse thang la sogs pa rnams su dge 'dun dang skye bo'i tshogs chen po rnams la chos gsungs pa'i dus/ lha'i me tog char bzhin du babs pas thams cad rang dbang med par dad par byas nas 'gro ba dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad cing / 'chi nges pa'i mi mang po'i srog yang thar bar byas nas zla ba —165—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/lnga pa la lha sar byon te/ jo bo rin po che'i drung du gser chab gsol dkar me phul/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi don du gsol ba rgya chen po btab ste/ lha sar phyogs thams cad dge ba'i bshes gnyen ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa rnams kyi skar ma tsam 'dus pa dang / skye bo'i tshogs chen po lus pa rnams/thugs skyed la sogs pa gsungs pa'i tshe/ lha'i me tog char bzhin babs pas thams cad dad par byas cing 'gro ba dpag tu med pa smin grol la bkod nas/gung thang dang gsang sde dang zul skyo dang / snye thang la sogs pa chos gang gsungs thams cad me tog gi char babs pas thams cad dad par byas nas phan bde la bkod pa kun la thun mong du grub bo/ /sems dpa' chen po'i drung du mtshur ston rin yes gsang phu dang gzhan du chos gsung dus/ me tog gi char babs pa las kyang / lha sa ru chos gsung dus me tog gi char 'bab phul che ba 'dug zhus pas/ gnas kyi khyad par yin mchi gsungs zer/ de nas yang si tu byang rgyal pas yar lung su gdan drangs te/ dpags shi dbang phyug gis brang khar nor dang bcas pa phul nas/ bsam gtan gling du bzhugs pa'i si tu 'khor dang bcas pas zhabs tog rgya chen po bsgrubs te/ rtse thang ba la sogs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma dang / skye bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa la chos kyi 'khor lo skor zhing / de'i dus si tu ba la sems dpa' chen pos/ btsun pa rnams la khral dmag dang bu lag 'gel ba 'di bstan pa la gnod pas 'di mi mdzad par zhu gsungs pas/ chos tshul bzhin du byed pa'i btsun pa rnams la ni zhabs tog ngas phar byed kyin yod/ de ma yin pa'i mdar zhing 'debs phur —166—
