rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/'brog 'dzin las su tshong khe skyed pa 'di rnams la khral mi 'gel na de nas su la 'gel du 'dug zer nas byung bas 'o skol gyis kyang zer sa ma rnyed gsungs/de nas gdan sa thel dang bsam yas la sogs rnams su yang chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor ba la me tog gi char snga ma bzhin babs pas thams cad dad par byas nas phan bde la bkod cing / si tu bas 'bul ba rgya chen po bsgrubs pa rnams dang gzhan yang dbus phyogs nas byung ba'i phyag rdzas rnams sa skya thog drangs pa'i dgon pa rnams su ja skol btang / bshad nyan dang sgom sgrub la brtson pa rnams dang khyad par ma nus pa rnams la gnang zhing / thams cad chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pas tshim par mdzad do/ /de nas yang mtshal pas gdan drangs nas/ si tu dge legs pa dpal bzang po yab sras kyi sbyin bdag mdzad nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang skye bo'i tshogs chen po la chos kyi 'khor lo skor bas/ de dus rims nad chen po byung ba yang rgyun chad cing / btson pa mang po yang thar bar mdzad ces grag go /mdor na dbus phyogs kyis don du gnyer ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang skye bo'i tshogs thams cad chos kyi sbyin pas tshim par byas nas lha sar jo bo rin po che'i drung du dkar me phul gser chab gsol bstan pa dang sems can gyi don du gsol ba rgya chen po btab nas/ si tu byang rgyal ba la sogs pa thams cad kyis dbus phyogs su gzhug pa'i zhu ba nan chen po byas kyang ma bzhugs par/gtsang phyogs la byon te yar la stag tshang du spyan drangs te/ bla ma khyung po dang bla ma dbang gi thog drangs de'i dge 'dun dang skye bo'i tshogs chen po la chos kyi —167—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/'khor lo rgya chen po bskor zhing lam na yod pa'i sgom grwa bshad grwa grong khyer la sogs pa thams cad du chos kyi sbyin pa rgya chen po btang ste/ mdor na de'i res dbus gtsang gnyis char du chos dang zang zing dang mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pas tshim par mdzad nas/ yos lo zla ba bcu ba'i tshes gcig la ri gru 'dzin dngul chu'i chos rdzong du phyag phebs zhes grag go /chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs sbyin pa yis/ /'gro ba'i dgos 'dod re ba skong bar mdzad/ /sems dpa' khyed kyi sbyin pa'i phar phyin de/ /yid bzhin nor bu rgyal mtshan rtse mchod 'dra/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i phyag len ston pa ni/tshul khrims med par rang don mi grub na/ /gzhan don sgrub par 'dod pa gad mo'i gnas/ /de phyir srid pa'i 'dun pa med pa yis/ /tshul khrims bsrung ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab te/ de yang 'di ltar sems dpa' chen po 'dis ni/ so sor thar ba'i sgor zhugs nas bslab pa nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum la nyes lhung dri ma'i skyon gyis ma gos/ smon 'jug byang chub mchog tu —168—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/sems bskyed nas/ rang bde 'dod pa'i rnam par rtog pa thams cad spangs nas sgo gsum gzhan don 'ba' zhig bsgrubs/ rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas ma dag pa'i rnam rtog thams cad spangs te/ snod cud dag pa'i 'khor lo gzigs pas/ sku la tshul khrims dri zhim po ldang te/ gzim khang gi nang thams cad kyang dri zhim pos khyab pa yod cing / gsol 'phro'i na bza' dang dbu zhwa la sogs pa gzhan la gnas bsnams kyi dri zhim po yang zla re tsam gyi bar du mi yal bar yong gin 'dug go /dgung lo lnga bcu bdun pa'i bar du sha yang gtan nas mi gsol ba la/de lo bla ma dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / bla ma dkon rgyal ba gnyis la lung mang po mdzad pa'i dus sku khams zi ba byung bas/ khong rnam gnyis kyis sha gsol bar nan chen po zhus pas/ de phyin chad la phan par dgongs nas gsol ba yin ces grag go /tshul khrims gsum dang bslab gsum sdom gsum la/ /dri mas ma gos tshul khrims dri zhim ldang / /sems dpa' khyed kyis tshul khrims phar phyin te/ /nyi zer phog pa'i pad ma gzhon nu 'dra/ /—169—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i phyag len ston pa ni/dge ba'i longs spyod 'dod pa'i rgyal sras la/ /gnod byed thams cad rin chen gter dang mtshungs/ /de phyir kun la zhe 'gras med pa yi/ /bzod pa sgom pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab ste/ de yang sems dpa' chen po 'di nyid la gzhan gyis gnod pa che chung ci byas kyang de'i lan du phan 'dogs pa ma gtogs pa thugs su rgyud 'khrug pa mi srid de/ 'di ltar rtogs ldan rje 'bul ba bya bas dngul chur yong nas dang po gzim khang la 'dzegs nas sku mtshams bzhig nye gnas la gri bton nas dza sdigs rnams byas/ de'i rting la gser yig pa dang dben shrī'i rtsar rdzun ci rigs byas pa la brten nas/ gser yig pas sems dpa' chen po la bzang btson gyi rnam pa byas pa'i dus na sems dpa'i gsung na re/ sngon la rtogs ldan dang dben shri gnyis kar la tshig ngan re tsam re shor te/ de ma kha dran pas zin nas bshags pa byas khong tsho gang dga' byas la btang gsungs/ dus phyis rtogs ldan dngul chur byung nas phrad ma thag skad cig snga ma la dmu rgod 'di kun ma byung na dga' ba la bsam pa cig byung ba yin te/ skad cig phyi ma la de bzhin byas na sems can blo spangs par yang 'gro/—170—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/dus phyis gnod pa byed pa kho las ma byung ba la gnod lan du phan 'dogs pa'i dam bca' yang 'gal 'gro/ kho byung ba legs nga kho gang dag byed dgos bsam nas/ chos kyang gang 'dod zer byin/ lto gos kyang ci rigs pa byin/ mig legs shos nas ltos/ ston pa zla bzang la yang kho 'gegs pa la sogs ma byed byas pa'i rgyu mtshan de bzhin yin gsungs/ma tsom bdag gi bshe+os la sgo gsum gyis/ /gnad pa byas pa mthang thas dran gyur na/ /bzod dang snying rje stobs kyis gnod byed la/ /ci nus dngos sam bsam pas phan gdags bgyi/ /zhes sogs gnod lan du phan 'dogs par dam bcas pa bzhin mdzad do/ /gnod byed rlung gis zhabrugs par mi nus shing / /zhe sdang me lces bsregs pa zhi bar byed/ /sems dpa' khyed kyi bzod pa'i phar phyin de/ /mi 'khrug 'pho ba med pa'i rgya mtsho 'dra/ /—171—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i phyag len ston pa ni/rang don 'ba' zhig sgrub pa'i nyan rang yang / /mgo la me shor bzlog ltar brtson mthong na/ /'gro kun don du yon tan 'byung gnas kyi/ /brtson 'grus brtson pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab ste/ de yang 'di ltar go cha'i brtson 'grus kyis sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las sgrol bar dam bcas nas/ sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus kyis dbu yang sngas la mi 'jog cing / sku rnam snang gi chos drug dang nam du yang mi 'bral ba'i ngang nas/'od gsal chos kyi sku las ma g.yos bzhin/ /mtshan med dag la mtshan bcas 'di dag gis/ /mi gnod gda' zhing thabs shes zung 'brel phyir/ /brtsol ba cung zad yod kyang byed pa spro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nyin zhag phrugs gcig la chos spyod kyi rim pa 'di mdzad do/ /nang phyogs bzhengs nas sku khrus mdzad do/ /phyag brgya rtsa re phul ba'i yan lag bdun nas rgyas par mdzad nas smon 'jug gi sems bskyed bsdus pa re len cing gtor ma'i rim pa la tsha gong du dkar cha bzhi/ tsha ba —172—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/gsol nas brgya rtsa mi g.yo ba dang / g.yu gu/ sgrol ma nyer gcig dang / bul gtong / bar do'i gtor ma la sogs rnams mdzad nas/ yang smon 'jug sems bskyed bsdus pa re blangs nas bskor ba brgya tsa re mdzad pa'i bar de la/ma ni khri tsho gnyis gnyis/ yum sgrub sgrol ma tshar bcu gsum re/ bhe sha tse nyer gcig rnam rgyal gyi gzungs tshar gcig dgongs mo bde mchog gi mngon rtogs gzhung nas bshad pa bzhin bsgoms nas snying po stong phrag re bzlas pa dang / gzim khar yan lag bdun pa phul nas smon 'jug gi sems bskyed bsdus pa re len pa rnams mtshams kyi dus su 'chag med yin/ gzhan nges pa med gsungs/ des na gnas lugs kyi don rtogs nas/ chos spyod kyi rim pa nyams su len tshul 'di ni/ sa lam bgrod pa'i dbang du byas na/ nyi ma dang zla ba lta bus 'gro ba'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / de gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul lta bus 'gro ba'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / zhes mdo nas gsungs pa de ltar yin pa nges so/ /srid pa'i bde la chags rdul chen pos kyang / /mi ldog brtan pa'i sems kyis skad cig kyang / /g.yel ba med par thabs shes zung 'jug gis/ /lam la 'bad pa sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus yin/ / grangs med bskal bar skad cig re re la /grangs med sems can tshogs rnams sgrol ba'i phyir/ /—173—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/dpag med sdug bsngal chen po khur blangs kyang /rlom med chog par mi 'dzin brtson 'grus yin/ /zhes sogs ga༄/nga ngo / /snying rje chen po'i shugs kyi rab bskul nas/ /go cha sbyor ba chog par mi 'dzin pa'i/ /sems dpa' khyod kyi brtson 'grus phar phyin de/ /rta bdun rgyal po gling bzhi phyin pa 'dra/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i lag len ston pa ni/zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis/ /nyon mongs rnam par 'joms par shes byas nas/ /gzugs med bzhi las yang dag 'das pa yi/ /bsam gtan sgom pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab ste/mtha' yas 'gro la snying rje che skyes nas/ /bdag nyid bde 'dod sdug bsngal bral 'dod ltar/ /'gro ba kun kyang de ltar 'gyur 'dod blo/ /bcos min sgom pa bdag gzhan snyam pa ste/ /—174—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/brtse chen stobs kyis gzhan gyi sdug bsngal kun/ /bdag la smin 'dod bdag gi bde dge rnams/ /gzhan la smin 'dod bcos ma min pa'i blos/ /bdag gzhan rje ba'i byang chub sems mchog yin/ /shes bya'i gnas lugs blo las 'das pa'i phyir/ /yin min la sogs yid byed rnams spangs nas/ /spros med ngang la 'dzin med gnas pa 'di/ /don dam byang chub sems kyi mnyam bzhag yin/ /rjes la snang ba thams cad sgyu ma bzhin/ /snang yang bden pa med par shes byas nas/ /zhen med ngang nas gzhan don byed pa ni/ /don dam byang sems rjes thob nyams len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sems dpa' chen po 'dis skye ba dpag tu med pa'i gong rol nas/ sems can thams cad la ma'i bu gcig pa yid du 'ong ba la byams shing brtse ba ltar/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa'am bdag pas gzhan gces par sgom pa kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ting nge 'dzin dang / zhi gnas lhag mthong zung du 'jug snang ba dang stong pa zung du 'jug thabs dang shes rab zung du 'jug pa don dam byang chub sems kyi ting nge 'dzin gnyis goms par byas pa —175—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin gyi gsung skor/la brten nas/ 'di ltar chos thams cad mi shes pa dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad 'gyur ba med par mthong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad snang bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad mun pa dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / me tog bkram pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / pad ma bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / le lo thams cad bral ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / ri rab 'dra ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / bdud kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / 'jig rten gsum la mngon par ma zhen pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad ro gcig pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma la snyoms par 'jug tshul dang / spyan lnga dang mngon par shes pa drug dang / stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi la sogs yon tan brgya phrag du ma mnga' tshul rnams ni/ bdag lta bu'i blo dman pa'i yul la 'das pa'i phyir/ brjod par mi spobs shing / zhing khams gzigs tshul dang / mngon par shes pa mnga' tshul gsungs pa gcig gnyis gcig brjod na/de yang 'di ltar thos te/ bshad nyan mdzad pa'i dus na'ang / rmi lam du dag pa'i zhing khams gang 'dod pa lta ba dang / de na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' grangasamed pa la chos nyan nus par zhig yod ces mkhan byang rtse ba la gsungs ces thos so/ /chos gsungs pa'i tshe na yang lung —176—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/'dren la sogs pa'i tshig nam thogs dus spyan nam mkha' la cher mdzad pas shar re gsungs nas yong ba 'dug pas yid dam gyi lhas shod pa yin nges par 'odug snyam pa'i nges shes chen po byung zhing / thams cad kyi mthun snang du grub ba/ /sngar snga mo'i dus su ston pa zla bzang kyis sa skyar don gcig la phyin dus mkhan byang rtse ba bsnyungs nas da res rang sku gshegs pa 'dra zer yin 'dug pa thos nas ston pas tshur dngul chur slebs dus drung du zhus pas/ de nyin thugs khral po mdzad yin 'dug zer/ sang tsha ba'i dus su/ mdang ngas rmi lam cig bzung nas mkhan byang rtse ba la byin brlabs dang dbang bskur yang bya/ rten 'brel brtags pas da res mi lto ba'i rigs su 'dug gi gsungs zer/ dus phyis bsnyung ba'i dus su rmi lam du phyin pa'i zhing khams de rnams kyi bkod pa ji ltar mthong ba bzhin yi ger bkod pa cig byed bsam pa yin na'ang mtshams kyis dus dge sbyor res sems brid nas ma grub/ mtshams grol nas chos nyan rnams kyi 'dod pa skong skong nas brel drags pas lag len la ma thebs gzhan gyi bskul mkhan yang ma byung bas lan gsungs zer/ mngon par shes pa gsungs pa'i tshul ni/ mkhan byang rtse ba la nga'i 'di bden te nyams pa'i rnam rtog cig byung ba/ chos gsungs pa'i 'phros la mi la la'i rnam rtog la nga'i 'di kho na bden snyam pas 'dug te/ de yang bag min gsung bas 'jigs chum pa ci byung gsung / slob dpon seng ge dar la sku 'gag gcig gnang ba mthong bas slob dpon bde bzang gi rtog pa la yang sku 'gag cig gnang na snyam pa byung —177—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/bas/ khong gi gnas khang sleb pa dang / sku 'gag cig skyel mi btang bas/ ngo tsha ba la tshugs pa ma byung zer/ lo tsā ba nam bzang gis shing thog cig 'bul ba mthong bas shing thog la bro ba ci 'dras yod bsam pa byung bas/ bro ba ci 'dra bdog gam legs po gda'o gsungs nas/ khong gis mdun du skur byung bas khong la kha skyengs po byung zer/ mkhan po zang phug pa'i rtog pa la/ gzim mal na g.yi dkar gyi gdan cig 'dug pa mthong ba dang / 'di nga la yod na bla bre byed pa yin te snyam pa byung ba dang / gdan de gnang nas nyid cag rang re la gang dga' ba mdzod zer nas byung zer/ gzhan yang dngul chu ba la dmag yong ba'i dus mngon par shes pa gsungs pa dang / gser yig pa byung ba'i res mngon shes gsungs pa dang / bla ma thub pa la mngon shes gsungs pa dang / nye gnas ston pa la mngon shes lan mang por gsungs pa dang / slob dpon yon tan 'od la gsungs pa dang / jo nang pa'i dge slong blo gros bzang po la mngon shes gsungs pa dang / dpal ldan bzang po yul du 'gro ba la mngon shes gsungs pa dang / bdag rang gi yang semasakyi rnam rtog mkhyen nas gsungs pa la sogs pa'i rnam grangs su du ma zhig thos te yi ge mang dogs nas 'jigs nas ma bris so/ /gzung 'dzin zhi bde brlabs kyis bskyod mi nus/ /ting 'dzin bang rim mngon shes drug gis mdzes/ /sems dpa' khyod kyi bsam gtan phar phyin te/ /rin chen bzhi las grub pa'i lhun po 'dra/ /—178—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i phyag len ston pa ni/shes rab med na pha rol phyin lnga yis/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par mi nus pas/ /thabs dang ldan zhing 'khor gsum mi rtog pa'i/ /shes rab sgom pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab ste/ de yang 'di ltar sems dpa' chen po 'dis ni thos bsam gyis shes rab kun rdzob bden pa'i gnas lugs thams cad gtan la phebs pas ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i shes rab chen po dang ldan zhing / rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po'i ngo bor gyur pa'i mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po gnyis zung 'jug tu bsgoms pa la brten nas/ don dam bden pa chos kyi sku mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i shes rab chen po dang ldan pas/ chos thams cad skye mched pa'am rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i mkhyen gnyis kyi 'od zer chen pos/ mi shes pa'i mun pa thams cad bcom nas gdul bya'i phan bde'i lo tog smin par mdzad nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snang bas phyogs thams cad khyab par mdzad cing / 'di ltar yang gsung ngo / khres rab stong pa nyid kyi rtsi yis ma zin na thabs kyis chu kun la ji tsam 'bad cing —179—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/snying rje kun ji ltar che yang 'khor ba las ma 'das/ 'khor ba las ma 'das byas nas bzhag pas yang mi yong / thabs kyis cha yin pas med thabs med/brtse ba snying rje chen po dang bral na/ shes rab kyis bdag med pa'i don mngon sum du rtogs/ lta ba kun ji ltar mtho yang nyan rang gi lam las ma 'das/dper na bya nam mkha' la 'gro ba la gshog pa g.yas kyang dgos te g.yon kyang dgos pa ltar/ thabs shes rab zung du ma 'brel na gang rung cig gis sangs rgyas thob par mi nus te/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha'i zhal nas/snying rje dang bral stong pa nyid zhugs gang / /des ni lam mchog rnyed pa ma yin te/ /'on te snying rje 'ba' zhig sgom byed na'ang / /'khor ba 'di gnas thar pa thob mi 'gyur/ /gang yang gnyis po sbyor bar nus pa de/ /'khor bar mi gnas mya ngan 'da' mi gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa yin gsungs/ de ltar thabs kyi cha la 'bad gyur kyang / /gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab mi ldan na/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par mi 'gyur bas/ /bden gnyis gnas lugs 'di ltar sgom par bya/—180—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/rang bzhin med pa kun rdzob rang bzhin yin/ /mtha' las 'das phyir nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /rkyen las skyes phyir skye ba med pa ste/ /rten 'brel yin phyir rang gi ngo bos stong/ /dam pa'i don ni spros pa'i mtha' dang bral/ /smra bsam brjod med 'phags pa'i ye shes kyis/ /'ga' yang mthong med tshul gyis mthong ba yin/ /de ltar chos nyid spros dang bral ba las/ /mnyam bzhag mi gnas tshul gyis gnas byas nas/ /rjes thob chos kun sgyu 'drar shes pa yis /ye shes tshogs ni rab tu rdzogs par 'gyur/ /zhes kyang gsung ngo / /mkhyen brtse'i bsil zer rab tu 'phros pa yis/ /ma rig mun pa'i tshogs kun legs bcom nas/ /gdul bya kun da'i tshal rab rgyas mdzad de/ /rang byung ye shes ze 'bru gsal bar bya/ /—181—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/mkhyen gnyis ldan pa'i sems dpa' khyed nyid kyi/ /dri med zla ba'i dkyil 'khor shar ba 'dra/ /de lta bas na/ pha rol du phyin pa drug bsgoms pa'i phan yon bsngags pa la sbyar bar bya zhing / /rgyal sras rin po tshe'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer las/pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi le'u ste drug pa'o// //

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/mdo nas gsungs pa'i chos bzhi la bslab pa las dang po rang gi 'khrul pa la brtag pa'i phyag len ston pa ni/rang gi zhabrul ba rang gi ma brtag na/ /chos pa'i gzugs kyis chos min byed srid pas/ /de phyir rgyun du rang gi 'khrul ba la/ /brtags nas spong ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab ste/ de yang rang gi 'khrul pa la brtag pa'i tshul ni 'di ltar gsungs te/ rang la rang gi gros 'di 'debs so kemakhas pa dang btsun pa dang bzang ba'i yon tan gang yang med bzhin du/ rang bzang por re ba'i rlom stangs can/ /rang skyon ri rab tsam yang mi mthong zhing //gzhan skyon rdul phran tsam la'ang rtog /rang don zhe la bzhag nas gzhan don byed par smra/ /chos par rdzus nas tshe 'di'i che thabs 'ba' zhig sgrub pa khyod kyis snang yang rang gi spyod pa la ma brtag par rang gis rang bslus sngar yang sdug bsngal mang po myong zhing / da dung 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal las grol ba'i gdeng med pa 'di khyod rang gis nyes pa yin zhing / da yang gtan gyi bde ba thob par 'dod na dben pa'i gnas su sdod la blo bla ma dang dkon mchog kho na la gtod/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad spongs la chos brgyad —183—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/can gyi mi dang ma 'grogs/ rang 'dod 'khri ba chod la gzhan don gyi go cha skye/nga rgyal dang khong yus spongs la dman cha zung / skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis mdzad spyod bsams la dka' thub kyi dran skyed ces sogs gsung ngo / /byang sems kyi nyes pa mi gleng ba'i phyag len ston pa ni/nyon mongs dbang gis rgyal sras gzhan dag gi /nyes pa gleng na bdag nyid nyams 'gyur bas/ /theg pa che la zhugs pa'i gang zag gi /nyes pa mi smra rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab ste/ de yang sems dpa' chen po 'di ni/ chos kyi gsung gleng dang gzhan la phan pa'i gsungs tsam la rtogs pa/ don med kyi smra brjod mi gsung zhing / khyad par du gzhan gyi nyes pa gleng ba gtan nas mi srid cing 'ga' zhig gis nged kyi bla ma bzang / khyed kyi bla ma mi bzang zer ba la/ chos zab mi zab dang / lta ba log ma log sogs gzhan gyi nyes pa gleng ba gsan na/ dmigs su bkar nas mi gsung kyang / chos gsung ba'i dus su/ spyir long gtam la snying po med/ mi dge ba 'phel dogs su gzhan la smad pas rang mi mtho ba'i steng du/ nyes pa 'phog chags sdang 'phel/ khyad par chos dang gang zag la sde rigs su phye nas smod pa 'di rang 'jigs gsung /—184—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/smra ba mang pos mi dge skye srid cing / /de ma skyed kyang don med du 'da' bas/ /rang sa gzhan la phan nges ma rtogs pa/ /smra brjod spong ba brtson 'grus grogs su gces/ /gsungs sa/ /sbyin bdag gi khyim la chags pa spong ba'i phyag len ston pa ni/rnyed bkur dbang gis phan tshun rtsod 'gyur zhing / /thos bsam sgom pa'i bya ba nyams 'gyur bas/ /mdza' bshes khyim dang sbyin bdag khyim rnams la/ /chags pa spong ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs pas ltar phyag len la btab te/ de yang 'di ltar thos so/ /'jam dpal dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan pa sku mched kyi yum bsnyung ba'i dus/sems dpa' chen po dngul chu nas gdan drangs te/ tshe dbang dang gtong len gyi dmigs pa mdzad pas re zhig nad las grol bar mdzad cing / ma gcig pa'i dgongs pa la/ zla ba cig bzhugs pa'i zhu ba byed dgos bsam nas/ dbang gi 'bul ba yang ma byas par nang phyogs spos phor khyer nas gdan 'dren du phyin tsa na/ tho rangs kha gsang nas dngul chu bzhud 'dug ces grag go /lan —185—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/cig dar sdings pa'i ma gcig yum sras gsum g.yog mo dang bcas pa mjal du byung bas/ nye gnas kyi sras mo yin pa ngo ma shes par/ g.yog mo dang sras mo mnyam por za ma ngan ngon las ma drangs pas/ 'dis sras mo ngo ma shes par 'dug ko long yong las che brda' cig btang na snyam pa sha shar nas/ ga re gang byung la thong zhog snying po med bsam nas bzhag gsung / skabs cig tu rang res gzhan gyi dad rdzas dang 'bul ba'i rigs ye mi len pa yun ring po byas kyang /de'i rjes la 'bul ba cher byed pa la gdab lan chung ngu gter/ 'bul ba chung ngu byed pa gdab lan cung drag tu ster bas kyang yun ring rab cig byas/ da lta ni tig tig med/ gang byung la bzhag gsung / yar lung pa'i bskor rab kun gyis 'bul ba chen po rim pa mang po byas te/ rang res gdab lan ja sun cig kyang blud pa med gsung /rtsub mo'i tshig spong ba'i phyag len ston pa ni/rtsub mo'i tshig gis gzhan sems 'khrug 'gyur zhing / /rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod tshul nyams 'gyur bas/ /de phyir gzhan gyi yid du mi 'ong ba'i/ /tshig rtsub spong ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab te/ de yang 'di ltar sems dpa' chen —186—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/po'i gsung na re/ 'o skol gyi su la'ang tshig ngan smra mi nus gsung zhing / ji 'dra cig la yang / bla ma'am slob dpon nam dge bshes dbon po'i ston pa'am/dpon la sogs pa'i zhe sa ma bcug par ming nas 'bod pa mi srid cing / dus gtan du 'grogs pa'i nye gnas la'ang / ston pa zla bzang gsung ba ma gtogs ming rkyang pa nas 'bod pa'i srol med do/ /nyon mongs pa spong tshul gyi phyag len ston pa ni/nyon mongs goms na gnyen pos bzlog dka' bas/ /dran shes skyes bus gnyen po'i mtshan bzung nas/ /chags sogs nyon mongs dang por skyes ma thag /'bur 'joms byed pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len btab ste/ de yang 'di lta thos so/ / thengs gcig rgun 'brum/ chang la ka ra dkar po btab pa cig drangs pas/ de res gsol nas/ rting la drangs pas ha cang yang ro zhim drags 'dug pas/ ha cang ro zhim pa dang dang mngar ba'i sred pas mthung na yang nyes par 'gyur ba yin gsungs nas mi gsol bar 'dug zer ro/ /'khrul dang skyon brjod zhen chags rtsub tshig dang / /nyon mongs mun pa'i tshogs kun legs bcom nas/ /—187—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/yang dag thar lam legs par gsal bar mdzad/ /bstan pa'i sgron me khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dran shes bzhin dang ldan pa'i sgo nas gzhan don sgrub pa'i phyag len stan pa ni/mdor na gang du spyod lam ci byed kyang / /rang gi sems kyi gnas skabs ci 'dra zhes/ /rgyun du dran dang shes bzhin ldan pa yis/ /gzhan don sgrub pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab ste/ ched par dang por mdo rgyud nas ji ltar bshad pa bzhin skyes bu dam pa'i mtshan nyid tshang bas gzhan don sgrub tshul ston pa ni/ bdag byang chub la nan tan byed pas gzhan yang byed du 'jug pas te/ de bas dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhes bya'o/ /zhes pas/ mgon po byams pathag/bshes gnyen dam pa dul zhing nyer zhi ba/ /yon tan lhag pa brtson bcas lung gi phyug /de nyid rab tu rtogs pas smra mkhas ldan/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid skyo ngal spangs pa bsten ces dang /—188—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/byang chub sems dpa' thos mang dang / /bden mthong smra mkhas brtse ba can/ /skyon med skyes bu dam pa ni/ /chen po yin par shes par bya/ /zhes dang /brtse dang snyan par smra ba dang / /bstan pa nyid dang lag bskyang dang / /dgongs pa zab mo nges 'grel ba/ /'di dag blo ldan rnams kyi brtags/ /zhes pa dang / rdo rje 'chang gi dbang ler/ dang por yang dag bsten bya bla ma dag kyang dam tshig ldan zhing rdo rje theg par lhag par gnas/ /de nyid bsgoms shing ma chags dri ma dag dang rnam par bral zhing bzod pa'i ngang tshul lam la zhugs/ /slob ma rnams la lam ni sbyin byed dmyal ba'i 'jigs pa 'phrog cing de nyid las ni tshangs spyod ldan/ /bdud rnams la ni rdo rje dbyug pa de yang 'dzin ma'i gzhi la rdo rje sems dpa' rab grags pa'o/ /zhes sogs kyi don thams cad gong du brjod zin cing / des na skyes bu dam pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad tshang bas/ rim gro dang bkur sti dang / mchod pa byas shing bsten par byas pa rnams kyis 'di phyi thams cad kyi don grub pa yin no/ /dad mos kyis chu gtsang gis gang ba'i gdul bya'i snod du sku gnyis kyis gzugs brnyan gsal bar mdzad pas gzhan don bsgrub tshul ston pa ni/—189—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/ji ltar be+e ḍūr sa gzhi gtsang ma la /lha dbang lus kyi gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar/ /de bzhin 'gro sems sa gzhi gtsang ma la/ /thub pa'i dbang po sku yi gzugs brnyan shar/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mkhan chen byang chub rtse mo'i gsung na re/ ngas skabs 'ga' rer spyan ras gzigs su mthong yin yod gsungs zer/ da yod pa'i rtags su khong gi bla ma'i mos gus de 'dra ba gzhan la yod par mi 'dugakhong mnga' ris na bzhugs pa'i dus zhu yig gi lan gsung yig dang na bza' cig bskur bas rgyang grags tsam gyis nas khong rang gi dbu mdzad pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyis snam sbyar gsol/ rol cha khyer nas bsu ba mdzad phyag mang po phul byas zer/ bsnyung gzhi yod pa la phan par 'dug gsungs nas gsang chab gsol ba dang / bshes khu rgyun du mdzad/ chos gsungs pa'i dus su chos rje spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi zhal nas gsungs te lung 'dren thams cad kyang sems dpa' chen po'i gsung sgros 'ba' zhig la mdzad cing / bdag gi byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dum pa 'di rje rin po che la brten nas byung ba yin gsungs nas mtshan brjod pa'i tshe yang phyag thal mo sbyar nas spyan chab 'byin cing / sems dpa' chen pos kyang gzhan la ma gnang ba'i bla med dang yo ga'i dbang bka' ci rigs dang / sbyor ba yan lag drug gi khrid rdzogs par yang mkhan chen pa la gnang 'dug go /nyams myong phun sum tshogs pa yod pa'i rtogs ldan cig dang lab byung bas/ khong na re ngas skabs 'ga' rer rje rin po —190—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/che'i mgur yan chad de bcu gcig zhal du mthong ba de 'dra byung / bde bar gshegs pa'i dus jo nang na yod pas shākya thub pa'i rnam pa ru nam mkha' la byon pa mthong zer/ yang khams pa'i bya bral ba cig chos nyan 'phro la gangs te se la 'gro 'dod pa byung ba'i nub mo rmi lam du sems dpa' chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi rnam par byon nas/ khyod gar 'gro ba yin/ chos nyan 'phro 'di nyon la rgyug gsungs pas/ zla bo byung yang 'dres shol nas bsdad zer ba dang / sems dpa' chen po rang gi gsung na re/ nyang stod pa yin pa'i bya bral ba cig gis 'dir khrid zhus nas bsod snyoms la song nas log byung bas/ khong na re dmar khrid zhu dus khyed thugs rje chen po zhal gcig phyag bzhi bar mngon gsum du mthong ba cig byung de'i byin brlabs yin pa 'dra/ bsod snyoms la phyin dus/khyed thugs rje chen por spyi gtsug tu bsgoms tsa na khyi rnams log gis song zer/de kun 'o skol thugs rje chen po dngos su mthong zer nas dag snang chen po gda' gsungs/ bya bral ba nam mkha' 'od zer bya ba rdor gling na mtshams la yod dus/ rmi lam du/ sang rong gi 'phags pa wa ti 'di mar byon par yod khyod mjal du e 'gro zer nas byung bas/ gnyid sad nas de ci yin snyam nas yod tsa na/ yon bdag gis sang chos rje rgyal sras pa 'di na mar 'byon pa yod zer ba'i brda' skyel mi cig btang nas byung zer ba dang / yang dbus pa'i dge bshes bla ma'i mos gus chen po byas pa cig ngang lab zhib po byung bas/ dang po dngul chu phyin pa'i dus su mjal kha ma byung par skug dgos pa byung ba'i nub cig rmi lam du chu chen po cig la ma thar bar lus 'dug pa la/ mi dkar po —191—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/cig byung nas thag pa skya nar ba gcig btang byung ba la 'chang pas pha rir then pa rmis pas bla ma 'dis bdag kyang 'khor ba'i chu bo las sgrol bar 'dug snyam pa byung zer/yang nub cig bla ma spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam par gtso 'khor gsum mdun gyis nam mkhar sprin dkar po'i go bar nas rgyang byung ba la/ stod pa cig shar te 'phro la gnyid sad zer/ dus da nas bzung nas bla ma la spyan ras gzigs dngos kyi 'du shes skyes shing mos gus thun mong ma yin pa tshud las/dge sbyor 'phel ba'i skabs cig tu bla ma'i snang ba dang 'bral med du song tshad pa cig yang byung ba yin te/ phyis lod du song dred nas de 'dra mi 'dug zer/dus phyis khong gis sems nyid ngal so'i khrid zhus pa'i dus nyin cig sems de yang rang bzhin gyis gnas pas byung zhing sems dpa' chen po'i zhal ras g.yon pa'i logs la sku mdog zhal ras dang mthun pa la thugs rje chen po khar sa pa ni'i rnam pa gtsug tor dang bcas bzhengs pa cig de'i nyin nas mthong zer/ de nas zhag gcig gnyis song ba'i dus su slob dpon 'jam dkar ba dang gral lhan du byung bas/ chos rje'i zhal ras g.yon logs 'di la lha'i rnam pas 'dug te e gzigs byas pas/ zhal ras ma ltas nas/ nyid rang gi rnam rtog yin mchi nyid kyis kyang rdzun ma zer a zer nas byung / khong rang gis rgyun du mthong bas mos gus kyis khyad par du 'dug snyam pa cig byung zhes grag go /yang chen po dpal rgyal bas tshe dpag med kyi dbang bskur zhus dus ye shes 'bebs pa'i skabs su sems dpa' chen po'i zhal ras dkar tsher re —192—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/yod 'phro la/ dbu skra'i mtshams nas dmar khrig khrig yong zhing / cung zad song ba dang / zhal ras li khri'i mdog ltar dmar la dngas par mthong bas/ bla ma sangs rgyas 'od dpag med dngos kyi 'du shes skyes ces grag go /kame ma pa rang byung rdo rje'i bu chen rmi lam dang rtsa rlung la mnga' brnyes pa'i rtogs ldan spro bo bya ba la bdag gi mjal du phyin dus/ sems dpa' chen po'i gsung gleng byung bas/ khong gi gsung na re/ sngar gi byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan de dang / skyer sgang de gnyis kyang thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa dngos yin par 'dug da lta khyod kyi bla ma bo dong thogs med de thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa dngos yin pa'i rgyu mtshan nga'i rmi lam du yang byung gsungs/ khyod kyang bla ma de la mos gus tshul cig yin par 'dug lar yang khyod kyi bla ma de ri chen po cig gi steng na thugs rje chen po'i rnam par byas nas nga la yang ma ṇi pad me'i chos ston gsung yin 'dug pa rmis gsungs/ lar yang thugs rje chen po zer tsa na/ mdog dkar dkar byas pa'i gyang logs na bris pa de la zer ba ma yin/sems can thams cad la ma bu gcig pa lta bu'i 'du shes mnga' ba/ stong pa nyid snying rje'i rba klong 'brug pa khyod kyi bla ma de 'dra cig la zer ba yin/ nga yang rkang pa dang mig mi bde ba min na de dang cig mjal nas thugs rje chen po'i chos skor 'dra ba zhu 'dod de gsungs/ nga'i rtsa ru gtsang phyogs la 'gro zer ba'i slob bu byung tshad la thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa bo dong thogs med la mjol gcig khyung po rnal 'byor gyi skye ba nga'i grogs po khyung po ba tshul khrims mgon la mjol cig gsungs/ de la sogs pa'i rnams grangs mang po thos te/ mang —193—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin gyi gsung skor/pas 'jigs nas ma bris shing / bdag rang la mngon par shes pa gsungs tshul dang / dag snang gi mthong snang byung tshul than thun yod pa rnams ni/ bdag skrag par gyur dogs pa'i phyir 'dir ma bris so/ /las can rnams kyi sangs rgyas dngos su mthong / /dag snang can gyi spyan ras gzigs su mthong / /rmongs pa yis kyang bshes gnyen dam par mthong / /sprul sku bsam mi khyab la phyag 'tshal lo//'bad med lhun grub kyis 'phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pas gzhan don sgrub tshul ston pa ni/ji ltar nor bu 'bad med par/ /rang gi 'di ni ston pa ltar/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni gzo med par/ /de bzhin mdzad pa nges par bstan/ /ji ltar mkha' la 'jig rten gyi/ /bya ba rgyun mi 'chad par snang / /de bzhin zag med dbyings kyis kyang / /rgyal ba'i mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ dmigs med ngang nas zhen med gzhan don la/ /—194—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/brtson par byas pas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'grub/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ sems dpa' chen po 'di'i sku gsung thugs kyis phyogs thams cad du khyab cing rgyun mi 'chad par mdzad de/ gsung rab kyi 'phrin las kyis rgya nag po'i yul du rgyal po yab sras kyis phyag tu yang phal che ba phebs nas gzigs pas shin tu dad par gyur te/ 'di pa mdzad pa'i bla ma de gdan 'drongs na/ nged hor mi thams cad tshogs bsags pa yin zer nas/ mjal ba med kyang rtag tu mtshan brjod cing gsol ba 'debs pa dang / gsung rab rnams kyi lung yod pa rtsad bcad nas lung len pa/ khyad par du rgyal bu chen po de ni blo gros kyi nor bu ldan pa cig yod par 'dug pas/ mdo sde rgyan gyi ṭīk+ka sems dpa' chen pos mdzad pa de/ gser yig pa 'ga' zhig la lung thob nas gdan drangs te/ ṭīk+ka de'i steng nas mdo sde rgyan smra ba la mkhas pa tsam yod ces/ dpags shi rnams gleng ngo / /de lta bu'i rgyal bu chen po des rgyal sras lag len la 'grel pa legs po brtsams nas rgya nag gi phyogs thams cad dar bar byas yod ces kyang grag go /gzhan yang rgya gar bal po mdo stod smad/ mi nyag gi yul/ dbus gtsang mnga' ris skor gsum la sogs pa thams cad du sems dpa' chen po gsung rabs rnams kyis phebs nas/ 'bri ba dang klog pa dang / 'dzin pa dang /tshul bzhin du yid la byed par gyur to/ / zhes grag go /des na sems dpa' chen po 'di'i mtshan thos pa thams cad kyang tha shal cig ma rtogs pa ba spu g.yo zhing mchi ma 'byin par byed la/ sku mthong pa tsam gyis tshe 'di'i snang ba dang —195—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/bral nas blo sna chos la 'gyur zhing / thugs dran pa tsam gyis snying rje dang ting nge 'dzin 'bad rtsol med par skye zhing khrid btab pa'i dus su phal che ba sngon 'gro'i dus nas sgom rang babs su skye ba kun gyis mthun snang du grub cing /dus phyis zla ba dgu sku mtshams dam po la bzhugs nas/ zla ba gsum gsum sku mtshams sengs te/ phyogs thams cad nas 'dus pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma dang / tshe blos btang ba'i bya bral ba rnams kyi skar ma tsam dang /gzhan yang mi chen gyi rigs la sogs pa skye bo'i tshogs chen po dang / mdor na tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bu la chos kyi sbyin pa mdzad cing / de'i dus su gzhan gyi phul ba'i sna lo dang / sha khyi dang tshe thar gyi lug yod pa kun kyang dus re rgyug ste 'dus nas chos nyan yin yod pa la thengs cig snar thang nas khrid zhu ba la byung ba'i btsun pa cig gis khos bla mas gsungs pa bzhin ma byas par/ shes pa phar spro ba dang / tshur bsdu ba dang / de ma khad nas rlung bsgoms 'dug pas/ kho smyo nas tshogaso chos gsung pa'i dus su sgren mor shor byung ba la kho 'dzino du phyin pa rnams la rda rgyab nas 'gra sa ma byung skabs su/ gna' ma drung nas chas nyan yin yod pa har te langs nas kho'i phyir rgyugs song ste/ har har langs yin te kho la brdungs tsa na khos ra co nas bzung yin phyir 'bul byed kyin tshogs chos ma grol gyi bar du khong gnyis 'dzin yin 'dug gzhug khos dran pa rnyed nas 'dug pa la/ sems dpa' chen po'i gsung na re/ da rang khos dro ma bteg mchi/nyid kyi gos cig g.yog nas khrid shog gsungs/ kho'i tsar bdag gi phyin pas dran pas rnyed nas ngo tsha zhing 'dug drung du khrid phyin pa dang / rje btsun ma tshar —196—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/cig gsungs nas byin brlabs mdzad do/ /de ring nyid kyi gegs sel de gna' mo mos byas/ mos kyang go cang gsung ba la/ khos ngus pas/ sgrol ma gyis la skad chen po thon la ngus gsung bas/ gna' mo des rje btsun ma'i 'phrin las byas pa yin par 'dug /lar bla ma la byin rlabs dang thugs rje yod tsa na dud 'gros kyang mi'i gegs sel nus par 'dug snyam pa byung zhing / de lta bu'i ya motshan che cig byung ba de dus kyis tshogs pa thams cad la mngon sum du grub ba/ /bla ma khyung po'i slob ma gsum gyis bogs 'don gyi gdams pa cig zhus zer yin 'dug pas/ tshe 'di blos thong sems can la byams snying rje sgoms bla ma la gsol ba dungs pa thob la spros pa med pa'i ngang la yengs pa med par zhogs gsungs/ de yang sems dpa' chen po 'di ni 'byor pa dang ldan pa'i mi chen rnams las kyang / snyom chung chos don du gnyer ba rnams la mnyes cing khyad par du khrid zhu ba rnams la mnyes te/ khrid zhu ba 'di rnams dus rgyun du rang bsgom pa ma byung yang khrid zhu ba'i rin de la 'jur po re sgom par 'dug de stobs kyi phal cher la nyams myong dga' rab skye yin 'dug pas/ gdul bya skyong ba'i dus khrid 'bogs pa 'di 'gro don chung rgyu mi 'dug gsungs/ phyogs phyogs nas kyi mjal 'phrad pa dang / bsnyen bkur ba nang na yod pa'i dus su/ khrid pa rnams 'tshogs nas gda' zhus na/ do zhag mtshams grol ba'i skabs 'dir gal che shos 'chad pa 'di yin pas/ gzhan rnams dum pas sgor byon/ khrid pa tsho la shog gis gsungasanas/ chos gsungs / 'gron —197—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/po mang po rang nang na yod na stan khyer 'o skol rang sgor chos 'chad du bya'o gsungs nas phyir byon nas chos gsung ngo / /da lta'i slob dpon tsho la ltas de lta bu'i mdzad spyod rang dka' bar gda'o/ khrid tshar ba'i rjes thams cad du mi la ras pas dwags po lha rje la gdams ngag zab shos rang cig yod pa 'gro khar sbyin zer ba'i gtam rgyud gsungs nas thams cad la sgom skyes 'dug pas snying rus skyed la sgom dgos pa yin/ sgom chen po bya ba stan thog tu sdod tshugs pa rang cig dgos gsungs/yang dgon pa 'drongs khar khong gis gsung na re/ nga shi nas khyod sgom chen pho mo rnams kyis rab kyi lo dgu dgu 'bring gi lo gsum gsum tha mas kyang zla ba gsum gsum ri la bsdad nas sgrub pa ma byas na/ nga dang dam tshig med gsungs nas zhal chems bzhag 'dug de bzhin du thams cad kyi rgyun du sgom pa byung na ni shin tu legs/ ma tha la yang srod tho rangs dran tsam re ma byas na dam tshig med pa yin gsungs pas/ sems dpa' chen po'i drung du khrid zhus pa rnams kyis kyang ye ma sgom par rgyang skyungs rang byas na dam tshig la 'gal 'gro nyen yod pas 'bum gsum gdon dgos pa yod do/ /mdor na slob bu'i rigs kyang / rgya gar rgya nag bal po hor yu gur sog po/ 'ga'/ mdo stod smad/ dbus gtsang / ya rtse mnga' ris la sogs pa'i mi rigs dang / skad rigs mi cig pa grangs med pa cig smin cing grol bar mdzad cing / sems dpa' chen po 'di'i rnam par thar pa dang / 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab cing brjod kyi mi langs te/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems la ltas na skye ba dpag —198—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/tu med pa'i gong rol nas byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kho na la sbyangs pa 'dra ba yod/ ting nge 'dzin dang mngon pa shes pa mnga' tshul la ltas na/ skye ba dpag tu med pa'i gong rol nas ting nge 'dzin kho na bsgoms pa 'dra yod/ rmi lam la dbang thob pa la ltas na skye ba dpag tu med pa'i gong rol nas/ sgyu lus rmi lam kho na la goms par byas pa 'dra ba yod/ yi dam lha'i zhal gzigs pa'i ltas skye ba dpag tu med pa'i gong rol nas bskyed rim kho na la goms par byas pa 'dra ba yod/ sku tshe 'dir yang dang po bshad nyan mdzad pa'i dus kyi slob ma ston chen thon pa la ltas na/ sku tshe rangs pa bshad nyan mdzad pa 'dra ba yod/ sku mtshams dam po bcad pa'i lo grangs la ltas na sku tshe rangs pa dben pa brten pa 'dra ba yod/ phyag dang skor ba mdzad pa'i grangs chad la ltas na sku tshe rangs la phyag dang bskor ba kho na mdzad pa 'dra ba yod/ ma ṇi dang rje btsun ma la sogs pa'i grangs chad la ltas na sku tshe rangs pa bzlas brjod kho na mdzad pa 'dra ba yod/so sor thar pa'i sdom pa phog pa'i slob ma dge tshul dang dge slong la ltas na/ sku tshe rangs pa mkhan slob mdzad pa 'dra ba yod/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i slob ma la ltas na/ sku tshe rangs pa byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa phog pa 'dra ba yod/ bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems 'khrungs nas gnod lan du phan 'dogs pa'i dam bca' byed pa'i slob ma la ltas na sku tshe rangs pa kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi khrid bskyangs pa 'dra ba yod/zhi lhag zung 'jug gi rtogs pa dang ldan pa'i slob ma la ltas na sku tshe rangs pa —199—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/don dam byang chub kyi khrid bskyangs pa 'dra ba yod/ des na sems dpa' chen po 'dis ni mkhyen rab dang thugs rje phun sum tshogs pa'i gru chen por zhugs te/tshogs gnyis kyi rgya mtsho chen po nas don gnyis lhun grub kyi nor bu blangs te/sems can grangs med pa'i dbul ba bsal bar mdzad pa'i tshul bdag gi blos mi 'tshal zhing thams cad kyi gzigs pa de'i yin no/ /tshad med bzhi'i nam mkha' yangs pa las/ /bsdu ba rnam bzhi'i 'od stong dang ldan pa'i/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i tsha zer rab 'phros pas/ /gdul bya'i gling bzhi'i mun pa kun bsal nas/ /thub bstan pad mo'i tshal rab rgyas mdzad de/ /stong nyid snying rje'i ze 'bru gsal ba las/ /phan bde'i bcud dang ldan pa'i sbrang rtsi yis/ /gdul bya bung pa'i tshogs rnams tshims par mdzad/ / dge ba byang chub bsngo ba'i phyag len ston pa ni/de ltar brtson pas bsgrubs pa'i dge ba rnams/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal bsal bya'i phyir/ /'khor gsum rnam par dag pa'i shes rab kyis/ /byang chub bsngo ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ /—200—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/zhes gsungs pa ltar phyag len la btab te/ de yang 'di ltar gsungs te/ dge ba bsags pa byang chub tu ma bsngos na/ yul khyad par can la khong khro skyes pa la sogs pa dge ba mdzad pa'i rgyu 'ga' zhig byung na mdzad cing / byang chub tu bsngos pa'i dge ba ni mi mdzad pas/ rang nyid cig pu'i don du khams gsum gyibade 'bras dang theg pa dman par mi bsngo ste/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba gal che/ bsngo ba'i dpang por rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa bzhugs par bsams la/ bsngo bya sngo byed la sogs pa'i chos thams cad mi dmigs bzhin du bsngo/ bsngo bzhin mi dmigs par shes dgos/de ltar mi shes na yang 'o skol so so'i skye bo mos pas spyod pa yin pas/ 'jam dbyangs kun du bzang po la sogs pas ji ltar bsngos pa bzhin bdag gis kyang bsngo snyam pa byas pas chog gsungs/ bsngo ba'i tshig kyang 'jam dpal dpa' bos zhes sogs rnams gsung ngo / /dus gsum dge ba nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ /khams gsum 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal bsal phyir du/ /'khor gsum dag pa'i tshul gyi bsngo mdzad pa'i/ /bsngo ba mkhas pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de man chad kyis phyag len sum cu so bdun gyis don tshan rnams bstan zin nas/ da brtsam bya bstan bcos kyi don bsdu ba ston pa la/—201—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams la gsungs pa'i don/ /dam pa rnams kyi gsung gi rjes 'brang nas/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi lag le+on su+om cu bdu+on/ /rgyal sras lam la slab 'dad dan du bkad/ /ces pas/ gang gi don du brtsams pa bstan/ /blo gros dman zhing sbyangs pa chung pa'i phyir/ /mkhas pa dges ba'i sdeb sbyor ma mchis kyang / /mdo dang dam pa'i gsung la brten pa'i phyir/ /rgyal sras lag len 99spyol med legs par sems/ /zhes rgyal sras lag len 'khrul med yin par bstan/ /'on kyang rgyal sras spyod pa rlabs chen rnams/ /blo dman bdag 'dras gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ /'gal dang ma 'grel la sogs nyes pa'i tshogs/ /dam pa rnams kyis bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /ces pa khengs skyungs zhing nongs pa bzod par gsol nas/ /—202—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/de las byung ba'i dge bas 'gro ba kun/ /kun rdzob don dam byang chub sems mchog gis/ /srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i/ /spyan ras gzigs mgon de dang mtshungs par shog /ces pas brtsams pa'i dge ba bsngo ba'o/ /mdor bsdu na bdag nyid chen po 'di'i sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad spyod kyis rnam par thar pa rnams la sgro ma btags skur ba ma btab par don la gnas tshod ci dang ci yin pa ma lus par brjod nus kyang / thams cad yon tan kho na brjod par 'gyur gyi skyon gyi gnas skabs su gyur pa mi srid pa'i phyir/ bdag lta bu'i blo dman pa rnams kyi yul las 'das kyang / rgyal ba yang dgon pa'i gdan sa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po bla ma gzhon nu rgyal mtshan gyis zhus pas 'khrungs yul dang rigs rus/yab yum dang / bla ma bsten tshul dang / mdo rgyud po ti mkhyen tshul rnams thams cad rags rim cig sems dpa' chen po rang gi gsungs pa de la gzhi byas/sems dpa' chen po nyid kyi sras kyi thu bo dam pa gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po mkhan chen byang chub rtse mo'i gsung las byung ba rnams dang / gzhan yang bla ma bsten yun ring ba rnams kyi gsung las byung ba ci rigs/ khyad par du lo sum cu rtsa grangs kyi bar lus dang grib ma'i tshul du zhabs tog bsgrubs pa nye gnas ston pa'i ngag las byung ba rnams dang / bdag rang gis mthong thos la sogs —203—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/pa'i rnam par thar pa rnams kyis nang nas che long tsam zhig btus te rgyal sras lag len dang bstun nas bsnyung ba'i tshul ma bstan gong yan chad kyi sku tshe 'di'i rnam par thar pa rags rim cig bkod pa'o/ /de lta bas na mdo nas gsungs pa'i chos bzhi nyon mongs pa spong tshul/dran shes bzhin dang ldan pa'i sgo nas gzhan don bsgrub tshul/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba la bslabs pa'i phan yon bsngags pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer las mdo nas gsungs pa'i chos gzhi nyon mongs pa spong tshul/ dran shes bzhin dang ldan pa'i gzhan don bsgrub tshul/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba brtsam bya bstan bcos kyi don bsdu ba'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// //—204—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams gdul ba dang las tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa stan pa'i phyer zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pa ni/de yang 'di ltar/ bdag cag dbus su 'gro ba'i dus su/ ma shi na zhabs drung du myur du yong par zhu zhus pas/ bde mchog gi thugs dam gyi thang ka dang na bza' gcig gnang nas/ 'o skol rgas drags pas da rang ched pos mi sdod mchi/ nyid log nas yong dus 'o skol rang phrad pa dka' gsungs pas/dus rgyun du thugs sna thung thung gi gsung 'byon pa de/ de dus rang bzhin gsung ba yin snyam pa ma rtogs pa mngon shes gsung ba yin snyam pa ma byung ste/ thog tu khel byung ngo / / bde bar gshegs pa'i sngar lo ngam rings chos rje'i nye gnas dge bshes rgyal bzang bya ba dang / nye gnas ston pa la zhu ba brgyud nas/ sang red sku mtshams gsengs nas zla ba gsum chos gsungs pa de/ mdog gis sa char byon pas gsungs par zhu/ dpon slob du byon pa'i zhabs tog dang mgron po ji tsam byung ba 'dam la byin zer ba gang dgos pa nged rang gis sgrub/ drung du zhus zer nas zhus pas/ khong gi de lta sems nan ltar bzang blo stobs che ste/rang red sang phod da tsam rang khong gis gdan 'dren pa de las thag ring cig tu 'gro nyen 'dug /lar gyi kyang da na so rgas pas/ zla ba gsum gsum po'i mtshams gseng ba 'di la/ g.yeng ba ches 'dug snyam yod pa la/ de na yar —205—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/'gro ba la ga la yod/ khyed la nor yod par 'dug pas/ nga gdan ma 'drongs kyang chos phyogs gzhan dang gzhan du gtong bar zhu gyis/ sang red gzhan du 'gro ba'i gleng mo de kun khong dang gzhan la 'da' ba/ grags pa btegs pa las mi yong gsungs zer/yang de'i zla gong du gdan 'dren pa'i gser yig pa yod pa 'dug zer ba cig thos nas slob dpon yon tan 'od kyi drung du zhus pas/ yong don med mchi/ pho tshod med par byung srid na'ang / de gong du gdan 'dren gzhan cig yod par gda' yi gsung zer/ de'i e sku mtshams la 'jug khar phyag rdzas gang yod thams cad 'dus pa'i dge 'dun dag skye bo'i rnams la 'gyed chen po mdzad cing / byang chub pa'i bstan pa rin po che la bya ba rgya chen po bsgrubs/bostan pa dang se+omaso can gyi don la dmigs pa'i gzhan don kho na mdzad po'i zhar la/ rang dan thab bya thams cad thab/ spangs bya thams cad spangs/ bcam ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po nyid kyis kyang / sku rgyab bsnung ba dang / sman pa 'tsho byed las sman bzhes pa'i tshul bstan pa ltar/ sa mo bya'i lo zla gnyis pa nas bsnyung pa'i tshul bstan te/ lha rje la ston pa dang gsol sman bsten zhu zhus pas/ nga'i bsam pa la sus kyang ma tshor bar shi ba cig byed bsam pa yin gsungs pas/ nye gnas kyis phyis mi thams cad kyis gsol sman bsten pa la sogs pa'i zhu ba gang yang ma byas zer ba'i khag yong lags zhus pas/ de rang mad gsungs nas/ lha rjes phyag rtsa ltas pas gdan 'dren pa'i gser yig pas phebs pa la lta rgyu mi bdog mchi gsungs zer/ de'i dus su nyin cig slob —206—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/dpon nam mkha' seng ge la brgyad stong pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags dang rtag tu ngu gnyis kyi le'u sgrogs gsungs la/ byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma thob tshul gyi skabs su/ nged kyis ting nge 'dzin 'di dag gi ngo bo nyid rang bzhin la ltas na/ gang mnyam par bzhag par bya ba'am/ byang chub tu spyod pa la gang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i chos de gang yang yang dag par rjes su ma mthong /rigs kyi bu 'di ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin te zhes pa'i skabs su/de 'dra cig rang yin gsungs nas/ yun ring po'i bar du ting nge 'dzin la 95grams zhes grag go /de dus drung rang du nyin cig mi lngas sman bla'i cho ga rgyas pa cig skad gsang mthon po'i sgo nas byas pa tshar rting / yun ring po zhig na/ khyed rnams kyis sman bla byas sam ma byas gsung ba la tshar zhus pas/ khyed rnams grabs byed 'dug pa de dran pa yin te/ rjes la mnyam bzhag cig la yengs nas/ khyed rnams kyis cho ga byas pa ma tshor ba 'dug gsungs/ de'i dus sa g.yo ba dang /nam tho rangs kha gzims khang dang stan gyi bar thams cad 'ja' 'od kyis khengs pa la sogs pa'i ltas chen po rnams byung bas thams cad sems ma bde bar/ sku rim la 'jad stong bskor bsags nas 'gyed byed pa dang / sku rim dang gsol 'debs nang mar bsgrubs pa dang / gzhan yang phyogs thams cad du gsol ba 'debs pa dang / khyad par du bdag nyid chen po nyid kyi sras kyi thu bo dam pa mkhan chen byang chub rtse mo dang / chos rje nyi ma gzhon nu gnyis kyi —207—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/bzhugs stan phul me tog gtor nas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don du bzhugs par gsol ba btab pa'i mthu chen po bsten nas/ zla gsum bzhi'i dbang du bsnyung pa dngas par gyur to/ /zhes grag go /de'i dus su sems dpa' chen po'i gsung na re/ khong rnams gnyis la nad pa gzhan dang mi 'dra dang kha med kyang dge sbyor 'phel du song / rig pa dang po yod gsungs zer/ de nas yang zla ba bdun pa nas bsnyun log pa'i tshul bstan te/ spyir yang mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku thob pas/ bsnyun mi mnga' yang /yang dag ji bzhin mthong ba'i phyir/ /skye sogs rnams las 'das gyur kyang / /snying rje'i bdag nyid skye ba dang / /'chi dang na dang rga bar ston/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bsnyung ba'i tshul bstan pa la/ da rung sman dang lha rje bsten pa zhu zhus pas/ na so mthar phyin pa dang nad 'dzin ches pa'i phyir/ phan par dka' bas dgag sgrub med par rang sor glod nas 'jog pa yin/ lar yang rang nyid mi bsgrub pa de la gzhan la yang bstan par mi rigs/ 'o skol gyis dod lo sa skyar phyin dus/ tsibs ri ba yin pa'i rtog ldan cig sa skya'i yang dgon na nad drag pos btab 'dug pa cig na re/ nad la sogs pa lam du 'khyer na ji ltar byed zer ba la/bdag gzhan sgyu lus kyi phung po 'di/ /na na na ste na bas dga'/ /—208—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/sngar bsags kyi las ngan 'dzad pa yin/ /chos spyod kyi bya ba sna tshogs kyang / /sgrib gnyis sbyong pa'i ched du yin/ /na ba med na med de dga'/ /lus sems bde na dge sbyor 'phel/ /mi lus don can byed pa yang / /sgo gsum dge la sbyor ba yin/ /'byor pa med na med de dga'/ /bsrung bsral gyi bya brel de la med/ /'thab rtsol kyi khro zhabrugs ji snyed pa/ /'dzin chags kyi nor las byung bar nges/ /'byor pa yod na yod de dga'/ /bsod nams kyi dge tshogs spel bas chog /'phral phugs kyis phan bde ji snyed pa/ /bsod nams kyi 'bras bu yin par nges/ /myur du shi na shi bas dga'/ /—209—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/rkyen ngan gyis bar du ma chod cing / /mtshams sbyor gyi bag chags bzang 'grogs pas/ /ma nor gyi lam du tshudo par nges/ /yun du gsan na gsan pas dga'/ /nyams myong gi lo thog skyes pa la/ /gdam ngag gi brlan drod ma yal bar/ /yun du bsten pas smin par 'gyur/ /ces bstan pa bzhin du/ 'o skol rang gang byung la dga' ba sgom pa'i man ngag 'di nyams su len pa'i phyir phan pa'i thabs mi tshol/ don la nad ces bya ba grub pa yang med cing / 'byul pa'i blo ngor snang ba 'di/ rgyu 'bras slu ba med par ston pa'am chos pa'i shan 'byed lta bu'am sgrib gnyis sbyong ba'i thabs mchog kyang yin/ dge sbyor gyi bskul lcags lta bur yang 'dug pas/ 'di spong ba'i thabs mi tshol/ phyogs kyi rim gro 'di rnams kyang nga thar la 'chir ma bcug gsung ba la/ drung gi zhal mthong ba dang gsung thos su re ba'i gdul bya dpag med mchis pas da rung sku tshe byin gyis rlob par zhu zhus pas/ phru ba'i nang na med par gzar bur 'byung ba 'di mi rigs pa yin na'ang / phan thogs pa yang mang rab byung / gzhan don gyi las la ches bya ba ma mchis kyang / 'o skol gyi tshod rtsis pa'i zang zing yang cung mang ba tsam yang mi shi yang gzhan don chung du yang mi 'gro mchi gsungs pa las/ drung nas gzhan don gzhan du rgya che yang /—210—

rgyal srasarin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/bdag cag gdul bya rnamasamagon po med par 'gyur bas/ ci nas kyang bzhugs par zhus pas/ nus pa med na lhan cig 'grogs kyang dgos pa chung nus pa byung na myur du 'gro ba thams cad sgrol bar 'dod na/ blo gtad pa'i ltos dang bcas pa khyed rnamasayal bar ga la 'dor/ nga dang phral ba la mya ngan bya mi dogos/ rgyun du gsol ba thob dang kho bo yod mtshungs kyi gsungs zhes grag ga /de'i dus mkhan chen byang rtse bas byon nas gdan bzhugs zhus pas ma bzhes par/ tshur la gdan bzhugs mdzad/ semasadapa' chen po rang gi sngar gyi bzhugs gdan gyi steng du yang stan brtsegasagasungs nas mkhan chen pa bzhugs su bcug rten 'brel mdzad pas/ dngos su gsung ma byon yang bzhugs stan gyi steng du bzhugs gsungasapa de/ chos rgyud zung zer ba'i zhal lta ru go zhes nye gnas ston par gsung ngo / /de dus thams cad la mjal kha cig gtong bar zhu zhus pas da lta'i skabs 'di 'drar phrad kyang rang gzhan gnyis ka la gnod pa las mi yong gsungs zer/de'i dus kyang mtshan bcas kyi thugs dam rnams ye ma chags par mdzad pa dang / gnal bsrung ba'i phyir/ dkon brtsegs bsgrags pa'i dus/ mgur ma blangs pa'i dus su/ shugs chen po bshumasapas/ do zhag mtshan bcasakyi thugs dam rnams kyang glod pa dang / khyad par du snying rje'i dmigs pa mi mdzad par zhu/ glo bur du gser ma byung dogasayong bar gda' zhus pas/ 'o skol gyi mtshan med la mtshan bcas kyi dge sbyor gyis mi gnod par gda' zhing thabs —211—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin gyi gsung skor/shes rab zung du 'brel ba'i phyir/ rtsol ba cung zad yod kyang byed spro bar 'dugasnying rje'i dmigs pa ched kyis ma bzung kyang 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal dran tsam ngang shugs kyis skye bar 'dug byung rgyal du btang na nyid cag rnams yang bar dogs nas dran 'dzin chen po byas pa yin/ 'chi khar 'pho ba yang sgom pa la 'di 'dra'i 'phro la shi na legs pa yin mod gsungs zer/ de dus spyir bskyed rdzogs gnyis la brtan pa thob pa/ khyad par du sgyu lus rmi lam la dbang 'byor ba'i mkhas sgrub chen po/ sems dpa' chen po'i thugs la bla ma rdor gzhon pa bya ba dngul chu na sku mtshams dam po la bzhugs pa'i chu skyel la zhu ba bskur nas/drung nas bskur pa 'di la gsol ba thebs mi thebs kyi rmi lam gcig bzung nas lan cig yig ger btab la bskur bar zhu zhus pas/ da res rang gsol ba thebs snyam pa mi 'dug lhag pa'i yi dam lha dpag tu med pa 'du ba dang /dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro sa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / lha dang lha mo du mas mchod pa'i tshogs mtha' yas pa rnams kyis bsu ba dang / chos rje nyid kyang zhing gzhan du gshegs pa la thugs spro ba rnam 'gyur la sogs gtan tshigs su du ma zhig 'dug te/ zhib tu bshad na ci rigs kyi blor mi shong pa'i rgyu mtshan cig 'dug pas mi 'chad de tsam gyi go mod gsungs zer/ de dus jo nang gi sgrub pa mo rlung ltas rtag po yod zer ba cig na re yang / sems dpa' chen po bsnyung pa 'di la/ khong rang gis zhing 'dir bzhugs pa'i rten 'brel mdzad na gsol ba thebs tsam du 'dug ste/ sems dpa' chen po khong rang yang bzhugs pa'i thugs dgongs mi mdzad pa thugs thag btungs 'dug pas/ sku rim kyang —212—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/gal che ste de bas kyang drung la rang gi rten 'brel gtso che zer ba thos nas/ drung du zhus pas/ 'o na rlung ltas kyang re rtags yod par 'dug 'o skol la sdod pa'i mtshams rang med gsung zer/'o na 'di ltar gyis gsungs pa'i zhal ta gsungs par zhu zhus pas/ sngon gyi dus na dpon chen kun dga' bzang po la g.yog po rnams kyis kha chems 'jog par zhus pas/ kha chems khams 'di bzang du song tsa na byed zer ba'i gtam cig 'dug ste/ de bzhin du 'o skol gyis khams 'di bzang du 'gro rgyu cig mi yong / slob dpon rgyal mtshan dar gyis kyang don gyis na/ kha chems 'dra ba'i yi ge cig bskur 'dug kha chems 'jogs pa skabs su babs dug na'ang /nad kyi gdung lus kyi shed zad pa'i skabs 'dir tshigs bzhi po re tsam pa dang lab pa la yang cung gal yong gin 'dug lar gyis 'o skol khams bzang dus su'ang chos dang 'jig rten gyi bya ba gang la'ang / khrigs ka 'di ltar yin gyi tig tig med par/ gang byung la gtong gin yod pa de yin mod/ nga 'chi kha dang shi ba'i rjes la 'di ltar byed kyi khrigs ka de bas kyang ga na 'ong / gal te kha chems la nyan mkhan yod na sngar khams bzang dus rang gis shes tshod dpe mkhyud med par bstan/ rtsom pa yang che chung ci rigs pa byas shing khyad par du tshigs bcad che chung mang dag cig yig ger bkod pa/ de rnams kha chems yin/de ma gtogs do zhag 'brel med tshigs su smras pa la song med/ de la bsams nas phrad kyang 'di las gzhan pa smra rgyu med/ shi yang kha chems gzhan 'ga' ma mchis so/ /byas pa de ka yin/ nyid cag rang rnams kyang blo dkon mchog la —213—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin gyi gsung skor/gtod tshe 'di dang ma 'dres pa'i chos re gyis/ semasacan gyi don du chos tshul bzhin du byed pa thamasacad rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i rgyud 'dzin yin pa la/'o skol gyi lta mos kyang ci 'tshal/ desan kun gyi chos rgyud kyang legs par zung / khyad par du ston pa zla bzang rang yang dge sbyor la 'bad pa thon/ bya bral ming btags yin pa'i phyir/ longasaspyod med na legs pas/ nga'i rjes su bre gang btang rgyu ma byung kyang bzod/ nus pa byung tshad kyis snyom chung la byams su byed pa dang / khyad par du da lta rang resaskyong dgos yin yod pa'i ma nus pa 'di rnams bskyang ran legasapo gyis/ sdug ge rnams snying rje ba yin/ la'ang rgyu'i dngos gzhi de ka yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /nang gcig phyag mdzub g.yas pa nam mkha' la ker mdzad nas/ mdang kha che paṇa chen shākya shri dpon slob la 'bul ba dang bsnyen bkur bzang po grub yod do gsung ba la/ drung nas 'bul ba mdzad pa'i dus na kha che paṇa chen gang na bzhugs lags zhus pas/ byamaba'ipa mgon po'i drung na bzhugs mchi gsungasazer/ de la 'phrosapas/ rmi lam 'dzin pa 'di la sngar nas byang cha chen po cig yod/ zhing khams grangasamed pa lta ba dang / de na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa la chos nyan pa la sogs pa 'bad rtsol mi dgos par yod pa cig byung / bar skabs cig tu 'grib 'dug pa yin ta/ ding sang na ba 'dis rmi lam song tshud 'dug ma 'gags pa'i snang ba 'di mtshar che bar skabs su 'grib pa de yang / gso de ka 'dra de skyes pa des yang lan nam gsungs/ lar blo chos su song ba re byung na 'jig rten gyi bsod nams chen po skad zer ba 'di —214—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/kun la byung na rang legs par 'dug te/ 'bad rtsol gyis ma bsgrubs par byung na longs spyad du rung ces sogs kyi dgag sgrub mang po bshad 'dug na'ang /'byor na'ang 'byor pa lam du slongs/ rgud na'ang rgud pa lam du slongs pa 'di la ci dru'i cu gal cig 'dug gsungs zer/ zla ba bcu pa'i tshes brgyad kyi tho rangs/ slob dpon dpal ye la dmar rtsong slong la mdun rgyab cig bsgyur gsungs te/ de bzhin byasapas/ phyag thal mo sbyar nas yun ring po bshums pa'i bar skabs cig tu gsung mang rab byon pa'i tshig 'bru gang yin ma go nas/nang par rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ nga bsnyem ma nyal byas pa de'i mdun na rje btsun byon 'dug pas/ rje btsun ma'i 'dun du nga nyal bsdad pas mi yong / rtsor langs la gsol ba gdab dgos bsam nas de lta byas pa yin gsung ba la rje btsun ma rnal 'byor ma lags sam sgrol ma lags zhus pas/ spyan nam mkha' la cher mdzad nas/ sgrol ma sgrol ma ces lan gnyis gsungs pas/ rje btsun ma gsung 'byon gi gda' lags sam zhus pas/ hā de 'dra mi 'dug ste/ 'o skol dngos kyi sems can gyi sdug bsngal ma bzod nas rje btsun ma la byas pa med pa'i yus mang po btsongs gsungs de dang dus mtshungs pa/ nyang stong du si tu 'phags pa'i sar bu mo grong pa'i chos kyi ma gos pa cig la/ lhab kha babs nas dang por mig gi yul rgyal 'pham 'chad pa'i 'phro la/ de 'dra rnams ta cha med de/ nyi ma nub phyogasaya gi nasabla ma rgyal sras thogs med bya ba zla ba bcu pa'i tshes brgyad la rje btsun ma sgrol mas g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing khams su gdan drangs nas 'gro ba 'dug zer nas byung zhes grag go /—215—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/de dus nyin cig da rung yug cig 'chi na mi 'chi bar 'dug kyang rtsa kho ni btul 'dug rtsa la yang 'jungs mi 'dug gsung nas phyag rkyang byung ba labaltas pas rtsa btul btul 'dug ste/ de la brten nas bsnyung g.yog pa cig gis/ bla ma la mos gus che rab yod kyang sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes med pa'i rtags sam/ 'on kyang gsung 'di rnams 'byon pa'i rkyen du/ rtsa btul ched po mi sdod pa yin zer/ gal te mi 'dod pa thog tu babs nas sku gshegs na/'pho ba la sogs pa thugs dam gyi gsal 'debs 'di ltar gyis gsung ba'i zhal ta thugs la 'dog mi mtshams ma lags sam zhus pas/ he nyid ni mi 'dod pa thog tu babs nas shi na zer yin 'dug ste/ shi yang mi 'dod thog tu bab pa min/ 'di kho yong ba'i grabs cig sngar du tshar mi rgan gyi las thabs zin/ pho lo bdun cu don lnga lon 'dug tshe yang thung thung min/ mtshams grol nas mi mang po 'tshogs pa dang chos ston pa'i 'phro yang med pas na ba'i dus kyang snga/ 'chi ran 'di 'dra cig yang 'dug snyam pa'i blo'i lhag ma yang lus pa med/ do cig nas ston ston 'di 'gro don re dga' re yong gin 'dug te/ 'gro don chung ngu yang mi 'grobyang chub kyi sems gnyis po 'di dang nam yang 'bral ma myong / na ba'i rkyen gyis rmi lam sor chud byas pa dang 'dra bar/ ci yin cha med cig la khar sing lcid po na ba nas bzung ste ding sang gi bar du/ lus la shed med kyang lhag par du byang chub kyi sems gnyis 'phel ba'i skabs 'di 'jog pa'i 'chi ba rnyed dka' yang / bdag gis 'bad med du rnyed pa dkon mchog drin yin/ de lta bu'i ngang nas 'chi ba de ka 'pho ba zer ba yin/ gzhan —216—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/gsal 'thebs bya rgyu med/ byas kyang dga' ru e gtong yang mi shes de'i sangs rgyas rjes dran sogs/ sus kyang g.yeng par 'gyur ba med/ ces pa de rang khyed rang rnams yang ma 'gal bas mdzod gsung zhing de nas kyang zla ba phyed dang gnyis bzhugs zhes grag go /zhing khams gang du skye ba zhes zhus pas/ 'gro la phan par 'gyur na dmyal bar 'gro ba yang shin tu spro mi phan na dag pa'i zhing yang mi 'dod lags zhus/ de dus dgong cig maṇ+ḍal dang mchod pa sna lnga khyer shog gsung nas/bdud rtsi phyag mdzub kyis gtor zhing phud mchod rgyas pa re mdzad/ yang phyag thal mo sbyar zhing dbu dud pa re mdzad/ mchod pa rnam lnga phyag rgya dang bcas pa lan lnga bskyar yin 'bul/ drung na 'khod pa rnams la yang mchod pa phul gsung nas spyan chab 'byin gyin 'dug pa'i nang par rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ yi dam 'dra byon pas khyed rnam pas yang mchod pa phul byas pa yin/ gzhan bshad rgyu tsam mi gda'i gsung nas/ zhib cha gsung du ma gnang zhes grag go /slob dpon yon tan 'od bsnyung g.yog kyi re mod la yod pa'i skabs su nub cig srod kyi cha la ma dag pa'i las snang thams cad 'gags nas/ zhing khams rnam par dag pa mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba dngas shing thogs med pa nam mkha'i dbyings ltar rgya khyon dang rtsa gnas gzhal bar mi nus pa 'dug gsung gin phyag nam mkha' la yug yug mdzad de/ btegs na spar spar gyis byed/ reg na bde ba bskyed pa la sogs pa mtshar du che ba cig gi dbus na/ rang re 'dug pa de'i khor yug kun gyi tshogs grangs med pas bskor 'dug de dus rtsa na yod pa'i gnad yin —217—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/na bla ma rgya ma ba rnam pa gsal bar 'dug gzhan yang 'od gsal gyi snang ba za zi lang long brngod kyis mi lang pa cig 'dugate/ da ste mgyogs por 'gro bar 'dug gi gsung zer/ de'i nang phyogs slob dpon dpal yesaglang ri thang ba bde bar gshegs kha bzhin du/ dag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig tu gda' lags sam zhusapas/ da lta za zi'i snang ba sna tshogs gcig la yengs nas 'gro yin 'dug te/ de thams cad la mngon zhen bya rgyu med/ rmi lam sgyu ma dang 'dra gsung zer/ bde bar gshegs la khad pa'i dus der yang sngar nas nyal ba dang mnyes pa la ma goms par/ tsog tsog por sdod pa 'di ka bde bar 'dug gsungs nas dang po bsnyung ba'i mgo brtsams nas phyis bde bar gshegs kyi bar du/sku rnam snang gi chos bdun dang nam yang mi 'bral ba'i ngang nas/ bcu dgu'i nub mo nas gsungs gcad mdzad de/ spyan la yang 'gyar 'gyur med par/ 'od gsal chos sku las ma g.yos bzhin du/ gdul bya rtag 'dzin can gdul ba dang / las tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa dang / zhing khams gzhan du gdul bya rgya che bar dgongs te/ sangs rgyas 'das nas lo gsum stong lnga brgya dang gsum song ba'i dus/ sems dpa' chen po nyid kyis dgung lo bdun cu don lnga bzhes pas/ sa mo bya'i lo zla ba bcu pa tha skar gyi zla ba'i tshes nyi shu/res gza' spen pa'i nyi ma'am/ skar ma lag la yod pa'i dgong mo'i cha/ gzim khang chos rdzong gi spu shu la nyi ma nub pa dang mnyam du/ 'chi med rdo rje lta 'a'i sku bshig nas/ chos sku zhi ba chen po'i dbyings su gshegs pa'i tshul bstan nas/de'i tshe bar do na gnas pa'i sems can grangs med pa'i don mdzad de/ de'i —218—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/nub mo yang / dngul chu'i steng gi bar snang thams cad 'ja' tshon sna lnga dang /'od zer gyi rang bzhin gyis khengs te/ sgra chen po grags pa dang / dri zhim po'i ngad pas khyab pa dang / sa chen po g.yos pas sman bla'i tsag khri'i steng nas gser sku lhung pa tsam byung zer cing / lha'i me tog gi char kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa lta n+da/ bab ces grag go /de'i dus su mi thams cad mya ngan gyis gdungs pas ngud mo'i sgra chen po 'byin pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ gna' mo dang sha khyi la sogs dud 'gro yis kyang mya ngan chen po byas te/ bsnyung ba'i tshul bstan pa nas gna' mo dang sha khyi gnyis ka ri la rgyang bcad nas gzims khang tho phyir la ma 'khor ba la/ bde bar gshegs pa'i nyin mor byung nas ched dang / don gyis gzims khang la skor ba mang po byas te/ gdung la gsol ba 'debs pa'i skabs su/ gna' mo de yang na ba med par gzim khang gi 'og na 'pho ba btab pa bzhin byas nas shi 'dug zer/ sha khyi de yang de nas ring por ma lu+on pa shi 'dug go /sems dpa' chen po de nyid bde bar gshegs nas zhag lnga nyi ma drug song ba'i nub mo/mtshams dam po la yod pa'i sgrub pa po dag snang can 'ga' zhig gis spyan gzigs khar sa pa ni spyan drangs te bde ba can gyi zhing du gshegs par mthong ba dang / la las rje btsun ma sgrol mas bsu ba byas nas/ g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing khams su gshegs pa mthong ba dang / la la dag gi kha che paṇa chen gyi gdan drangs te/ dga' ldan du gshegs par mthong ba dang / 'ga' zhig gis ni/ lha dang lha mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pasabasusate/ po tar lar gshegs —219—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/pa mthong ba dang / la la dag ni mchod rten dkar po bar snang khengs pa zhig gi bang rim la rim gyis 'dzegs nas byon te/ rdo rje dril bu'i sgra sil sil sgrog bzhin du/ 'o skol 'og min du 'gro yong gsung nas/ mchod rten dang bcas pa nam mkha' la gshegs par mthong ba la sogs pa'i mthong snang mi 'dra ba du ma zhig 'dug jo nang gi sgrub pa mo tshul bzang bya ba'i nyams snang la spyan ras gzigs kyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gcig 'dug pa bzhigs nas shar phyogs la bzhud pa'i snang ba byung zer ro/ /gang zhig mya ngan 'da' ba'i tshul ston tshe/ /la ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang / /khyad par 'khor lo bde mchog sgrol ma sogs/ /yi dam dpag tu med pa'i lha tshogs dang / /mi pham mgon dang paṇa chen shākya shrī sogs/ /chos dang zang zing mchod pas mnyes byas nas/ /ma 'ongs zhing khams gdul bya dang bcas pa/ /gzigs shing gshegs par mdzad pa de la 'dud/ /de nyid kyi sku gdung ring bsrel gyi snying po can rnams sku gsung thugs kyi rten du gyur tshul ston pa ni/ de yang 'di ltar bde bar gshegs nas zhag bdun nas spur bzhus te/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa byang chub rtse mos thog drangs pa'i/ bu chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen dpag tu med pa 'dus nas/ phyi —220—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/nang gi dkyil 'khor mang po'i zhal phye ste/ gdung la mchod pa yun ring por phul nas/ sa skya'i thog drangs pa'i dgon sde thams cad du ja skol la sogs gshegs rdzongs rnams legs par bsgrubs pa'i skabs su/ gdung khang zhal phye ba la de dus sku byon pa ni ma mthong zer zhing / ring bsrel dngas shing 'od 'tsher ba mu tig gi mdog lta bu byas pa ni mang po mthong zhing / rang rang so so'i lag du phyin nas bde mchog dang / spyan ras gzigs dang / don zhags dang sgrol ma la sogs pa byon 'dug zer ba thos shing dngos su mthong ba ni med do//bdag rang la bde bar ma gshegs gong du gnang ba'i zhal chems cig la/ dung g.yas su 'khyil pa la nyi zla'i gzugs kyis brgyan pa byon pa ni thams cad kyi mthong ba de yin no/ /de nas sku gdung ring bsrel thams cad/ rgya nag yan/ rgya gar tshun chod/ thams cad du khyab par byas te/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po khu dbon dang / rgyal po chen po yab sras kyis thog drangs pa'i che 'bring chu gsum/ mtho dman 'bring gsum gyi phyag tu theng ste/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten du gyur to/ /khyad par du chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang gu shri rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rnam pa gnyis kyis/ dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lang khang du/ nang rten de bzhin gshegs pa sman bla be+eḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal po'i sku/ sprul sku mthong ba don ldan bzhengs nas de'i khri rgyab rin chen dpung par bzos te/ khri rgyab la sman bla'i lha tshogs thams cad tshang bar bkod cing / legs par grub pa dang sems dpa' chen po nyid kyi sku gdung ring bsrel —221—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/dpag tu med pa dang / bka' 'bum dang na bza' la sogs pa bzhugs shing bzung 'bum dang / rgya bod kyi mkhas grub phal mo che'i dbu skra dang / gdung ring bsrel dpag tu med pa nang du bzhugs te/ khyi lo zla ba dgu pa'i tshes brgyad la/zung khar rin chen sdings su/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rab tu gnas pa mdzad nas/ yang gdan drangs te/ yang ga'i gru la byon pas/ chu phar tshur gnyis ka 'ja' 'od kyis 'brel ba byung zhing / dpal sdings la sogs pa'i gdan drangs pa rnams su 'ja' 'od dang me tog char bab zhing mdor na yang lam 'gro ba dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad nas/ bo dong e'i kun dga' ra ba na/ e pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis bzhengs pa'i phyi rten rnam rgyal gyi gser 'bum dang bcas pa'i drung na mchod pa'i sprin tshogs dpag tu med pas spras te/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyis mchod pa'i yul du bzhug so/ /de'i rjes la yang mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa byang chub rtse mos zhal lta dang bdag rkyen dngos gzhi mdzad/ dbus phyogs nas skud gser lhag ma ni brgya dang nyi shu byung ba'i phal cher kyang sku la gsol te/ bstan pa'i gtso bo'i sku mi tshad ma sprul sku 'dzam gling brgyan/ sems dpa' chen po rang gi sku 'dra dngos su byon pa 'dra ba bzhengs te/ sems dpa' chen po rang gi sku gdung ring bsrel dpag tu med pa dang / dbu zhwa na bza' la sogs zhal gsol sder dang / gzhan yang rgya bod kyi mkhas grub mang po'i dbu skra gsung ri srel dang /gzungs dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa byang chub rtse mos/ chos rje nyi ma gzhon nu gnyis kyi rab tu gnas pa —222—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/mdzad de/ ri bo po ta la dang mtshungs par 'gyur pa dngul chu'i chosardzong na/mchod pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spras te/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba thamasacad du mchod pa'i yul du bzhugs so/ /de yang bdag nyid chen po dang po bsnyung ba nas brtsams te/ bde bar gshegs nas spur sbyangs su/ gdung la gsol ba 'debs pa sogs gshegs rdzongs byed pa'i dus thams cad dang / mthar phyi rten dang nang rten bzhengs nas rab tu gnas dus mchod pa la sogs pa thams cad kyi dus su 'dir/gang gis sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor gshig byas nas/ /dag pa'i zhing gzhan gshegs par gyur pa'i tshe/ /spyan ras gzigs dang rje btsun sgrol ma la sogs/ / yi dam dpag tu med pa'i lha tshogs dang /dpa' bo dpa' mo lha dang lha mo'i tshogs/ /bsu ba'i phyir du nam mkha' sprin bzhin stibs/ /ri dang bcas pa'i sa chen rnam par gsol/ /lha rnams kyi ni rnga bo che dag kyang / /zab cing snyan pa'i sgra chen sgrog par gyur/ /tsan dan phye mal bsgos pa'i me tog rnams/ /nam mkha'i nang nas lding zhing 'bab par byed/ /—223—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/mtshan mos dus kyang 'od kyi du ba yi/ /ston ka'i zla bzhin rab tu gsal bar snang / /ser bu dal dbus ldang ba'i rlung gis kyang / /ljon shing sna tshogs me tog dri zhil thul/ /rab tu gus pas de la mchod byed 'dra/ /lha'i bu dang bu mor bcas rnams kyang ri/ me togo sogs kyis gu+os par mchod pa yi/ /thal ma sbyar ba pad ma kha 'bus 'dra/ /sprin chen rnams kyis bla re bris pa ni/ /lha bzo mkhas pas bris pa'i sa ṭa 'dra/ /bar snang 'ja' tshon sna lngas khengs pa ni/ /la la dar gyi yol ba bkram pa 'dra/ /la la 'ja' tshon lding khang phub pa bzhin/ /la la me bya'i 'jug ma bkram pa bzhin/ /la la me bya'i gdugs legs phub pa'am /za 'og bla re lta bur rnam pa mdzes /de bas na gdul ba'i don du/ mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan —224—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/pa'i bsngags pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer las zhing khams gzhan du gshegs pa'i tshul bstan tshul dang / de nyid kyi sku gdu+ong ring bsrel rnams sku gsung thugs kyi rten du gyur tshul gyi le'u ste brgyad pa'// //rtsol bral gang gi yon tan rgya mtsho'i gting / /rtsol bcas blo'i dpag par mi nus kyang / /rtsol bas legs bshad 'phreng bas mchod pa 'di/ /rtsol med thugs rje che la dad pa dang / /gzhan la thar pa'i sa bon bskrun phyir dang / /rang gi dad pa'i dran pa gso phyir du/ /gang gi yon tan rgya mtsho'i chu gter nas/ /chu thigs tsam zhig blangs te brjod pa la/ /'ogal dang ma 'brel nyes po gang mchiso pa/ /bla dang ldan pa rnams la bzad par gsal/ /de las byung ba'i dge bas 'gro kun gyi/ /kun mkhyen go 'phang myur du thob par shog / —225—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/chos sku kun tu bzang po'i mkha' dbyings las/ /gzugs sku'i dkyil 'khor rab tu rgyas pa yi/ /mkhyen rtse'i tsha zer 'gro ba'i dpal du shar/ /ma rig mun sel chos rje'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bu sdug chu yis khyer ba'i ma bzhin du/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal mthong thos dran gyur na/ /spyan chab si ti'i rgyun ltar 'bebs mdzad pa'i/ /byams dang snying rje 'byongs pa de la 'dud/ / thabs kyi gru chen shes rab zags ldan can/ /gang gis bzung ste 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /sems can thams cad sgrol bar dam bcas nas/ /byang chub sems mchog bskyed pa de la 'dud/ /snying rjes gzhan gyis dbang du gyur pa yis/ /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bdag la len byed cing / /bdag gi bde dge gzhan la gtong mdzad pa'i/ /kun rdzob byang sems 'byongs pa de la 'dud/ /—226—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/dran snang thams cad chos skur shar ba yis/ /gzung 'dzin mtshan ma'i sprin tshogs mkha' la yal/ /ci ltar spyad kyang phyag rgya chen mo'i klong / /don dam byang sems 'byongs pa de la 'dud / / dpag bsam shing dang nor bu rin chen ltar/ /chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs sbyin pa yis/ /'gro ba'i dgos 'dod re ba skong mdzad pa'i/ /sbyin pa'i gter chen bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /tshul khrims gnyis dang bslab gsum sdom gsum la/ /nyes lhung dri ma'i tshogs kyi ma gos pas/ /dge sbyong mchog gyur rgyal sras rdo rje 'dzin/ /tshul khrims mthar phyin bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /chos nyid zab mo'i don la mi skrag cing / /gnod pa byas kyang khro bar mi byed la/ /sdug bsngal rnams kyis 'khrug par mi 'gyur ba'i/ /bzod pa'i rgya mtsho bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /—227—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/snying rje chen po'i shugs kyis rab bskul nas/ /'od gsal chos kyi sku las ma g.yos bzhin/ /nyin mtshan chos kyi bya bas dus 'da' ba'i/ /brtson 'grus mthar phyin bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /phyi dang nang gi dben pa rab brten nas/ /ting 'dzin brgya phrag kun la snyoms 'jug cing / /mngon shes yon tan kun la dbang 'byor ba'i/ /bsam gtan mthar phyin bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /chos kun skye ba med par rtogs pa'i blo/ /dmigs med snying rje che dang 'brel pa'i mthus/ /srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i/ /shes rab mthar phyin bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /gdod nas rnam dag 'od gsal chos kyi sku/ /ma skyes mi 'gag spros pa'i mtha' dang bral/ /dbyings rig dbyer med so sor rang gis rig /chos sku mngon du gyur pa de la 'dud/ /—228—

rgyal sras rin po che'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer/dag pa'i gnas su mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku/ /rgyal sras rnams la theg chen ston pa'i gsung / /bde stong zung 'jug zag pa med pa'i thugs/ /nges pa lnga ldan mnga' ba de la 'dud/ /grangs med zhing du grangs med sku sprul nas/ /grangs med gsung gi grangs med chos bstan la/ /grangs med sems can tshogs rnams smin mdzad pa'i/ /grangs med sprul pa 'gyed pa de la 'dud/ /mkhyen rtse'i gangs ri'i ngogs nas legs 'ong pa'i/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ /phan bde'i lo tog smin par mdzad pa yi/ /'phrin las mthar phyin bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos 'grel pa 'grel bshad rnams/ /blo gsal mkhas pa'i tshogs su legs par bshad/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i tshul la rab mkhas pas/ /bshad rgyud bstan pa rgyas pa de la 'dud/ / —229—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ nyan po ba btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyi gsung skor/sku gsung thugs kyi dben par rab brten nas/ /rgyud sde'i snying po stong nyid snying rje la/ /bstan pa'i snying po sgrub pa lhur blangs pas/ /sgrub rgyud bstan pa rgyas mdzad de la 'dud/ /bstan pa'i snying po bshad sgrub gnyis po yis/ /bstan pa'i rin chen phyogasabacur gsal mdzad pas/ /bstan 'dzin rnams kyis gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa'i/ /bstan pa'i bdag po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /le lo can rnams myur du bskul bya'i phyir/ /'chi med rdo rje lta bu'i sku bshegs nas/ /ri bo gru 'dzin dngul chu'i chos rdzong du/ /mya ngan 'das tshul bstan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdul bya'i don du zhing gzhan gshegs pa ni/ /sku gzugs ring bsrel mang pos zhing 'di yi/ /gdul bya'i tshogs gnyis 'phel zhing rgyas mdzad phyir/ /sku gzugs ring bsrel sprul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /—230—
